IN THE MEANTIME MY ASTHMA SYMPTOMS ESCALATED UNTIL I HAD TO GO TO AN URGENT CARE CLINIC. I DO NOT THINK IT IS REASONABLE TO EXPECT PEOPLE TO RUN 10 LOADS ON A MACHINE THAT IS EMITTING FUMES WHICH TRIGGER ASTHMA ATTACKS.

incident_description: I PURCHASED A TOY FOR MY 12-MONTH-OLD GRANDDAUGHTER AND SAW THAT IT CONTAINED SEVERAL SMALL PARTS. THIS IS A CHOKING HAZARD.

CARY, NC?A CARY MOM IS CALLING FOR SAFER LABELS, TAMPER PROOF PACKAGING AND WARNINGS AFTER HER SON INGESTED HARMFUL CHEMICALS, MISTAKING IT FOR CANDY. 

[REDACTED] RANG IN THE NEW YEAR A FEW HOURS EARLY ON DEC. 31. HE AND HIS YOUNG COUSINS CELEBRATED THE START OF 2023 AT THE AGE-APPROPRIATE TIME OF 8 P.M. AND FINISHED THE NIGHT WITH GAMES AND PRIZES. 

?WE WERE DOING THESE GAMES AND EARNING PRIZES AND ONE OF OUR FAMILY MEMBERS BOUGHT SOME [REDACTED],? [REDACTED] EXPLAINED.

THE 9-YEAR-OLD GRABBED A PACKET, BUT THE [REDACTED] WEREN?T DOING WHAT THEY NORMALLY DO. 

?I ATE IT AND GOT NO FLAVOR; THEY ARE SUPPOSED TO POP IN YOUR MOUTH. WHEN I DIDN?T GET FLAVOR, I JUST PUT MORE IN MY MOUTH AND THAT?S WHEN IT STARTED TO BURN,? HE SAID. 

[REDACTED] MOTHER [REDACTED] NOTICED HER SON WAS IN DISTRESS AND WHEN SHE TOOK A CLOSE LOOK AT [REDACTED] CANDY WRAPPER, SHE REALIZED THAT IT WASN?T CANDY AT ALL. 

INSTEAD, [REDACTED] HAD EATEN LUCKY?S MYSTICAL DRAGON FLAMES, A CHEMICAL DESIGNED TO CHANGE THE COLOR OF FIRE.

THE PACKAGE FOR LUCKY?S MYSTICAL DRAGON FLAMES IS LIKE [REDACTED] IN SIZE AND SHAPE AND THE CONTENTS INSIDE ARE SIMILAR TOO. HOWEVER, INSTEAD OF SUGAR LUCKY?S MYSTICAL DRAGON FLAMES IS MADE OF DANGEROUS CHEMICALS.  

?IT CONTAINS CHLORIDE, POLYVINYL AND COPPER,? [REDACTED] EXPLAINED. ?WE CALLED POISON CONTROL, AND THEY IMMEDIATELY CALLED A PHYSICIAN WHO CONSULTED WITH TOXICOLOGY.?

[REDACTED] RECEIVED AN URGENT CALL BACK FROM THE TOXICOLOGIST TELLING HER TO QUICKLY GET TO THE HOSPITAL. 

DOCTORS ADMITTED [REDACTED] TO [REDACTED] WHERE HE SPENT THE NIGHT, AFTER LAB RESULTS INDICATED HE HAD BEEN POISONED. 

?THE LIVER SPECIFIC LAB RESULTS WERE ALL ELEVATED, SO IT SHOWED THAT THERE WAS SOME TOXICITY IN HIS BODY,? [REDACTED] SAID. 

AFTER A NIGHT IN THE HOSPITAL, [REDACTED] LEVELS RETURNED TO NORMAL, BUT [REDACTED] WAS LEFT FRUSTRATED AND CONCERNED OVER WHAT SHE BELIEVED WAS THE TOXIC CHEMICAL?S KID FRIENDLY PACKAGING.

?IT HAD A CARTOON DRAGON BLOWING OUT FLAMES, IT?S CALLED LUCKY?S MYSTICAL DRAGON FLAMES. THERE WAS NOTHING ALARMING ON THE FRONT PACKAGE THAT WOULD MAKE A CHILD OR EVEN IN ALL FAIRNESS AN ADULT SAY ?WOAH WHAT IS THAT.? IT DOESN?T NEED TO BE ALLURING TO CHILDREN,? [REDACTED] SAID.

IN FACT, THE ADULT WHO ACCIDENTALLY BOUGHT THE LUCKY?S MYSTICAL DRAGON FLAMES TOLD [REDACTED] THAT IT WAS IN A BIN WITH THE [REDACTED] CANDY AT THE STORE, SHE NEVER REALIZED IT WAS ANY DIFFERENT.  

ACCORDING TO THE FEDERAL HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCES ACT, HAZARDOUS HOUSEHOLD PRODUCTS MUST HAVE PRECAUTIONARY LABELING TO HELP CONSUMER?S SAFELY STORE AND USE PRODUCTS. IT MUST ALSO CONTAIN THE WORDS ?DANGER, CAUTION, OR WARNING,? DEPENDING ON THE SEVERITY OF THE PRODUCT. IN ADDITION, IT MUST ALSO INCLUDE THE PRINCIPAL TYPE OF HAZARD THE PRODUCT PRESENTS. FOR EXAMPLE, ?HARMFUL IF SWALLOWED,? ?CAUSES BURNS,? ETC.

LUCKY?S MYSTICAL DRAGON FLAMES IS SOLD ON [REDACTED]. THE PACKAGE SOLD THERE HAS A ?HARMFUL IF SWALLOWED,? LABEL ON THE FRONT, BUT [REDACTED] CHEMICAL PACKAGE DID NOT. ONLY WHEN YOU FLIP THE PACKAGE OVER DO YOU SEE WARNINGS LIKE ?CAUTION, IRRITANT AND HARMFUL IF SWALLOWED.? 

THE PACKAGING HAS FOOLED OTHERS BEFORE. IN 2018, MINNESOTA POISON CONTROL PUT OUT A WARNING AFTER SEVERAL KIDS WERE SICKENED BY THE VERY SAME PRODUCT. [REDACTED] SAYS THE TIME FOR CHANGE IS NOW.

?I DON?T WANT IT TO TAKE A CHILD DYING FROM THIS FOR SOMETHING TO BE DONE,? [REDACTED] SAID. 

[REDACTED] HAS REACHED OUT TO MANUFACTURER OF LUCKY?S MYSTICAL DRAGON FLAMES MULTIPLE TIMES AND HAS NOT HEARD BACK.

AN INDUSTRY PERIODICAL, ?THE FABRICATOR?, CITES INTERNATIONAL STANDARDS ORGANIZATION (ISO) STANDARD 12100:2010 (REVIEWED AND CONFIRMED IN 2022) SAFETY OF MACHINERY ? GENERAL PRINCIPLES FOR DESIGN ? RISK ASSESSMENT AND RISK REDUCTION, SAYING WHEN SHARPNESS IS NOT DESIRABLE FOR SAFETY REASONS, FOLLOW A HIERARCHY FOR MAKING SAFE PRODUCTS:

            I.	IN THE CASE OF THE DISCHARGE AIR LOUVER, THERE ARE 100 SIX-INCH LONG METAL FINS PROJECTING THEIR SHARP EDGES UPWARD IN A 20-INCH DIAMETER CIRCULAR ARRAY (SEE REVISED ATTACHMENT ?LENNOX 13ACX AIR CONDITIONER DISCHARGE AIR LOUVER SHARP METAL EDGES REVISION A?). 600 INCHES IS 300 TIMES THE 2-INCH TEST SAMPLE DESCRIBED IN UL 1439. THIS IS EQUIVALENT TO 50 FEET OF SHARP METAL EDGE CONCENTRATED IN AN AREA OF 314 SQUARE INCHES (1.9 INCHES PER SQUARE INCH). THIS AMOUNT OF METAL EDGE, LIKELY TO BE SHARP, PRESENTS AN UNREASONABLE RISK OF PERSONAL INJURY.
           II.	THE CPSC HAS PREVIOUSLY (APRIL 24, 1978) WARNED OF SHARP EDGES ON HEAT REGISTER LOUVERS. NOTE THERE TOO, CONTACT WITH SHARP EDGES OF A LOUVER IS INCIDENTAL TO HOMEOWNER ACTIVITY, NOT LIMITED TO HEATING SYSTEM MAINTENANCE BY SERVICE PERSONNEL.
           III.	FROM AN ABRIDGED EXCERPT OF FEDERAL HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCES ACT (FHSA) (CODIFIED AT 15 U.S.C. ??1261-1278), SEC. 2. [15 U.S.C. ? 1261] - DEFINITIONS(S) AN ARTICLE MAY BE DETERMINED TO PRESENT A MECHANICAL HAZARD IF, IN NORMAL USE OR WHEN SUBJECTED TO REASONABLY FORESEEABLE DAMAGE OR ABUSE, ITS DESIGN OR MANUFACTURE PRESENTS AN UNREASONABLE RISK OF PERSONAL INJURY OR ILLNESS . . . (3) FROM POINTS OR OTHER PROTRUSIONS, SURFACES, EDGES, OPENINGS, OR CLOSURES, . . .
      B. THE LOUVER ACTS AS A GUARD FROM MOVING MECHANICAL PARTS OF THE FAN BUT POSES ITS OWN STATIONARY HAZARD. CONTACT WITH THE STATIONARY SHARP EDGES ARE NOT PREVENTED WITH A GUARD OR WARNED AGAINST.
      C. HAZARD COMMUNICATION IS TO INFORM AND REMIND THOSE WHO INSTALL, OPERATE, AND MAINTAIN THE AIR CONDITIONER ABOUT POTENTIAL HAZARDS AND HOW TO AVOID THEM. OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE MANUALS COMMUNICATE HAZARDS WITH SIGNAL WORDS SUCH AS DANGER OR WARNING. LABELS ARE PART OF A SYSTEM OF SUCH COMMUNICATION, PROVIDING VISUAL ALERT. THE LABELS MUST BE SUITED TO THE SAFETY COMMUNICATION NEEDS, TAKE INTO ACCOUNT THE CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PEOPLE TO WHOM THEY ARE COMMUNICATING, AND COMPLY WITH THE LATEST SAFETY STANDARDS FOR THE PRODUCT. HAZARD COMMUNICATION DEFICIENCIES MAY RESULT IN INCREASED RISK OF ACCIDENTS. ABSENCE OR DEFICIENCIES MAY BE ?FAILURE TO WARN? OR ?INADEQUATE TO WARN?. BASIC ELEMENTS TO COMMUNICATE HAZARD:
           I.	SIGNAL WORD: DANGER OR WARNING
           II.	PICTOGRAM
           III.	HAZARD STATEMENTS
           IV.	PRECAUTIONARY STATEMENTS: UNLIKE THE ?CAUTION! BEFORE ATTEMPTING TO PERFORM ANY SERVICE OR MAINTENANCE TURN OFF THE ELECTRICAL POWER AT DISCONNECT SWITCH? ALSO ON PAGE 1, THE CAUTION SHARP SHEET METAL - IS NOT REPEATED IN THE HOMEOWNERS INFORMATION (SEE ATTACHMENT ?LENNOX 13ACX INSTRUCTION EXCERPTS P 1 V 14?). THE INSTRUCTIONS DO NOT EXPLAIN THE DIFFERENT TYPES OF LABELS USED, INCLUDING IMPORTANT!, NOTICE!, !CAUTION, AND !WARNING, OR THE HIERARCHY OF THE SERIOUSNESS OF THE CONDITION. NOT ALL INCLUDE A PICTOGRAM, THE NATURE OF THE ISSUE AND THE ACTION TO BE TAKEN. THE ACTION TO WEAR GLOVES IS WITHOUT THE CUT-RESISTANCE RATING. incident_description: ON SATURDAY, JANUARY 28, 2023 AT APPROXIMATELY 10:30 A.M., I UNPLUGGED MY CONAIR 1875 HAIRDRYER FROM THE OUTLET AND NEXT THING I REMEMBER - I WAS FLAT ON MY BACK AND HAD BLACKED OUT FOR A FEW SECONDS......I DIDN'T KNOW WHAT HAPPENED. I PURCHASED A POWERHORSE 13000ES GENERATOR IN 2020 FROM NORTHERN TOOL TO POWER OUR HOME DURING POWER OUTAGES. THE GENERATOR WORKED GREAT FOR US DURING POWER OUTAGES UNTIL DURING A VERY COLD POWER OUTAGE PRIOR TO CHRISTMAS 2022. THE TEMP WAS AT LEAST -20 AND WE EXPERIENCED A PROLONGED POWER OUTAGE. I TRIED TO START THE GENERATOR BUT IT WOULD NOT START. THAT MADE ME EXAMINE THE SYSTEM AND DISCOVERED THE FUEL VALVE WAS LEAKING. (TURNING THE VALVE OFF STOPPED THE LEAK) I AM VERY HAPPY THAT THE GENERATOR DID NOT START, OTHERWISE I WOULD NOT HAVE NOTICED THE LEAK AS IT WAS NOT DAYLIGHT. THE RESULT OF A LEAK ON A RUNNING GENERATOR WOULD NOT HAVE A HAPPY ENDING. I HAD TO WAIT UNTIL AFTER CHRISTMAS TO CONTACT NORTHERN TOOL AND POWERHORSE TO REPORT THE PROBLEM, BUT THEY HAVE NOT YET RESPONDED TO ME. AS TEMPERATURES WARMED TO ABOUT FREEZING (32), I CHECKED THE VALVE AND IT NO LONGER LEAKED. I THEN RAN THE GENERATOR TO CHECK IT ALL OUT AND THE LEAK DID NOT APPEAR.  MY OBSERVATION AT THIS TIME IS THAT THE FUEL VALVE IS CONSTRUCTED OF A MATERIAL THAT CANNOT WITHSTAND AN EXTREMELY COLD TEMPERATURE. UNFORTUNATELY, THAT IS EXACTLY THE TIME WHEN WE NEED THE GENERATOR THE MOST. I AM SO THANKFUL THAT I DISCOVERED THE LEAK BEFORE WE EXPERIENCED A FIRE OR EXPLOSION. SINCE THE VALVE IS WORKING PROPERLY AT THIS TIME (NOT FREEZING TEMPS), DON'T PLAN TO REPLACE IT WITH A VALVE WITH THE SAME DEFECT.

I EXPERIENCED LONG-TERM CHEMICAL EXPOSURE FROM AN UNUSED CHEMISTRY LAB KIT MADE BY SCIENCE INTERACTIVE. IT WAS STORED IN ITS ORIGINAL BOX IN A SHARED BEDROOM UP ON A SHELF IN THE CLOSET. WITHOUT MY KNOWLEDGE, THE LIQUID CHEMICALS WERE EVAPORATING AND FORMING GASES, CAUSING ME RESPIRATORY ISSUES FOR MONTHS STARTING AROUND FEBRUARY 2023. I HAD IT FOR A YEAR AND A HALF WHEN THE RESPIRATORY ISSUES STARTED BECAUSE OF THE KIT. I EXPERIENCED COUGHING IF I HAD BEEN NEAR WHERE THE KIT WAS STORED, SUCH AS SITTING AT MY DESK, AND I WOULD ALSO GET A BURNING SENSATION IN MY LUNGS. DURING THESE MONTHS THE BURNING FEELING WOULD LAST AROUND HALF AN HOUR AFTER LEAVING THE AREA AND WOULD BECOME A LIGHTER IRRITATION AFTER MORE TIME PASSED. I NOTICED THAT THE SYMPTOMS WOULD ONLY START WHEN I WAS IN MY ROOM AROUND THAT AREA. NOT KNOWING THE CAUSE, I GOT AN AIR PURIFIER FOR THE DESK, WHICH DIDN'T HELP. I ALSO SEARCHED FOR MOLD, AND I CONTACTED A TESTING COMPANY. I SUSPECTED A CHEMICAL WAS CAUSING THE SYMPTOMS, BUT I DIDN'T SUSPECT THE KIT AT THAT POINT BECAUSE NOTHING INSIDE HAD BEEN OPENED. I WAS CONCERNED AND TRIED TO AVOID THE AREA WHILE ALSO TRYING TO FIGURE OUT THE CAUSE. I THEN STARTED TO CLEAN OUT THE ROOM. IN MAY I EMAILED SCIENCE INTERACTIVE ASKING HOW TO DISPOSE OF THE UNUSED LAB KIT.

ON MAY 31ST I OPENED THE BOX AND SAW THAT THE CHEMICALS HAD BEEN EVAPORATING BECAUSE THERE WAS LITTLE LIQUID IN THE BOTTLES. I WAS SCARED BUT QUICKLY TOOK A FEW PICTURES TO SHOW A PROFESSOR AND THEN CLOSED THE BOX. MINUTES LATER I STARTED COUGHING AND EXPERIENCING THE FAMILIAR BURNING SENSATION, SO I THEN KNEW THIS WAS WHAT HAD BEEN CAUSING MY RESPIRATORY ISSUES. I MESSAGED A PROFESSOR AND BROUGHT THE KIT TO CAMPUS WITH THE HELP OF HER INSTRUCTIONS. EVEN AFTER REMOVING IT, I CONTINUED TO EXPERIENCE THE BURNING SENSATION FOR MANY DAYS. I EMAILED SCIENCE INTERACTIVE EXPLAINING THE SITUATION AND ASKED TO SPEAK WITH SOMEONE ABOUT THEIR PRODUCT'S SAFETY OR A CHEMISTRY EXPERT. THERE WERE SO MANY LIQUID CHEMICALS IN THE KIT THAT I WAS CONCERNED NOT KNOWING WHAT HARMFUL CHEMICALS COULD BE FORMED WITH THEM EVAPORATING AND REACTING WITH EACH OTHER. THE REPRESENTATIVE IGNORED MY REQUEST AND JUST SAID TO DISPOSE OF THE KIT "TO PREVENT FURTHER DISCOMFORT.? THIS SITUATION HAS BEEN EXTREMELY UPSETTING. SCIENCE INTERACTIVE MUST DISCLOSE THE POSSIBLE GASES THAT COULD BE FORMED FROM THE STORAGE OF THE CHEMICALS IN THEIR KIT SO THAT I KNOW WHAT HEALTH EFFECTS COULD RESULT AND CAN INFORM HEALTHCARE PROFESSIONALS.

BECAUSE THERE WERE NO INSTRUCTIONS FOR STORAGE OF THE KIT, I HAD ASKED THE PROFESSOR WHEN I DROPPED THE CLASS IF THE UNUSED KIT COULD BE KEPT LONGER. I ORIGINALLY INTENDED TO RETAKE THE CLASS, AND HE TOLD ME IT SHOULD BE FINE TO STILL HAVE IT FOR IF I WAS GOING TO RETAKE THE CLASS AT A LATER SEMESTER. WHEN I ALSO ASKED AGAIN ABOUT IT THIS YEAR THE PROFESSOR SAID THAT SIMILAR BOTTLES OF CHEMICALS WERE STORED IN THE SCHOOL LAB FOR MANY SEMESTERS WITHOUT PROBLEMS AND THAT THE CHEMICALS DON'T ORDINARILY AGE. I DON'T KNOW IF HE COULD HAVE ANTICIPATED THAT THE CHEMICALS WEREN?T SEALED WELL, BUT I WOULDN'T HAVE BROUGHT IT INTO MY HOME AROUND ME AND MY FAMILY IF I HAD KNOWN. IT WAS KEPT AROUND ROOM TEMPERATURE, BUT IT WASN'T A STRICTLY CONTROLLED ENVIRONMENT, AND THERE WERE NO WARNINGS THAT IT NEEDED TO BE. I'M VERY WORRIED ABOUT WHAT HEALTH EFFECTS THIS COULD HAVE. AFTER OPENING THE KIT AND EXPERIENCING THE BURNING SENSATION FOR DAYS, I SINCE HAVE STARTED HAVING REOCCURRING ACID REFLUX, SOMETHING I DIDN?T HAVE BEFORE, ALONG WITH INCREASED LUNG SENSITIVITY. I ALSO HAVE A HARD SWOLLEN LYMPH NODE FOR MONTHS THAT I DIDN?T HAVE BEFORE. REPRESENTATIVES FROM BOTH SCIENCE INTERACTIVE AND THE COLLEGE DIDN?T ADDRESS MY CONCERNS, IGNORING MANY OF MY QUESTIONS OR GIVING VAGUE RESPONSES. THIS WAS DIFFICULT TO WRITE ABOUT BECAUSE IT?S SUCH A SHOCKING SITUATION THAT HAS LEFT ME VERY SHAKEN. ON SEPTEMBER 4, 2023, I CALLED THE FUTON SHOP TO NOTIFY THEM OF THE SITUATION, STATING THAT MY CHILD COULD HAVE BEEN SERIOUSLY INJURED. THE FUTON SHOP HAD THE MANUFACTURER SEND ME FOUR ADDITIONAL SMALL SLATS IN A SEPARATE SHIPMENT THAT I AM SUPPOSED TO ATTACH TO THE SLATTED PART OF THE FRAME TO "FIX" THE PROBLEM. NEITHER THE FUTON SHOP NOR THE MANUFACTURER HAS PROVIDED PROOF THAT THEY ADEQUATELY RESEARCHED THE SAFETY ISSUE AND THAT ME ADDING THE FOUR SMALL SLATS TO THE DEFECTIVE FRAME WILL MAKE IT "ZERO ISSUES AND BE MADE STRONGER." WE FEEL THAT CONSUMERS NEED TO KNOW ABOUT THIS POTENTIAL HAZARD AND BE EDUCATED ON THE TYPES OF WINDOWS THAT SHOULD BE INSTALLED IN HOMES TO PREVENT THIS PROBLEM FROM HAPPENING.

THE LIGHT WAS NOT TURNED ON UNTIL WE HAD GUESTS.  WITHIN A FEW MINUTES OF OUR GUESTS TURNING THE LIGHT ON, THEY NOTICED A STRONG ELECTRICAL BURNING SMELL.  WE SEARCHED THE ROOM FOR THE CAUSE OF THE SMELL AND FOUND THE ECOSMART LIGHT WAS THE SOURCE.  WE UNPLUGGED THE LIGHT AND FOUND THE LIGHT BULB VERY HOT TO THE TOUCH.  ONCE THE BULB HAD COOLED DOWN, WE REMOVED IT AND OBSERVED THE BASE HAD BLISTERED AND THE PLASTIC BULB HAD BEGUN TO MELT.

WE TESTED THE LIGHT USING BOTH AN INCANDESCENT BULB (100-WATT) AND ANOTHER ECOSMART (14-WATT) BULB AND THERE WERE NO ISSUES, INDICATING THE FIRST ECOSMART LIGHT BULB WAS DEFECTIVE.

WHILE THERE WE NO INJURIES FROM THIS EVENT, WE WERE FORTUNATE THE LIGHT WAS IMMEDIATELY TURNED OFF AND THE BULB REMOVED BEFORE A POTENTIAL FIRE OCCURRED.

I TRIED TO CONTACT HOME DEPOT TO LET THEM KNOW OF THE ISSUE WITH THIS PRODUCT, BUT MY ATTEMPTS TO IDENTIFY A CONTACT POINT AT HOME DEPOT'S ATLANTA HEADQUARTERS WAS NOT SUCCESSFUL; I WAS REFERRED BACK TO THE LOCAL STORE AND WAS NOT CONFIDENT THE STORE WOULD ELEVATE THIS PROBLEM TO THE APPROPRIATE PERSONNEL.

incident_description:
I DID NOT HAVE AN INCIDENT TO REPORT, HOWEVER I SEE THE POTENTIAL FOR INCIDENTS DUE TO A  MANUFACTURING DEFECT. 
THE NUMBERS ON MY LG RANGE, MODEL # LREL6323S /01 ARE WASHING OFF OF THE CONTROL PANEL MAKING IT DIFFICULT TO ACCURATELY SET THE BURNER HEAT. OR THE BURNER MODE. (THIS MODEL OF STOVE HAS SOME DUAL SIZED BURNERS THAT ONE PORTION OF THE DIAL CONTROLS AN INNER BURNER FOR USE WITH SMALLER DIAMETER PANS, AND AN OUTER BURNER RING FOR USE WITH  LARGER PANS. THE CONTROL PANEL HAS THE NUMBERS INDICATING THE PORTION OF THE BURNER AND HEAT RANGE THAT THE BURNER KNOB IS SETTING IT TO.) I FEEL THAT THIS CREATES A HIGH POTENTIAL FOR BURNS AND COOKING FIRES DUE TO AN INABILITY TO ACCURATELY SET THE BURNER HEAT.  
I CONTACTED THE SELLER, AND THE MANUFACTURER TO TRY TO GET A DECAL / STICKER KIT TO RE-APPLY THE NUMBERS. I WAS TOLD THAT; A. IT IS A "COSMETIC" ISSUE AND NOT COVERED BY WARRANTY.
                             B. THE ONLY FIX THAT THEY HAVE IS TO REPLACE THE CONTROL PANEL. COSTING APPROXIMATELY 250 US DOLLARS FOR THE PART. LABOR AND  SERVICE CALL FEES OVER & ABOVE PARTS APPLY.

THERE ARE SO MANY TIMES IT IS NECESSARY TO STOP SUDDENLY INCLUDING CARS, PEDESTRIANS, DOGS ECT. THIS IS A RIDICULOUS CONCEPT.

WHAT HAPPENED THAT MADE YOU WANT TO REPORT?

WHILE ASSEMBLING THE JETSON BICYCLE FOR MY DAUGHTER, I NOTICED A POTENTIAL MANUFACTURING DEFECT. THE BRAKE CALIPERS WERE MOUNTED ON THE INSIDE OF THE FRAME, WHICH CAUSED THE BRAKES TO ACTIVATE DURING A SHARP RIGHT TURN WITHOUT ANY MANUAL INPUT. THIS DEFECT WAS PRESENT IN TWO SEPARATE PURCHASES OF THE SAME BICYCLE.

WHAT TYPE OF PRODUCT(S) WERE BEING USED?

THE PRODUCT IN QUESTION IS A JETSON BICYCLE. JETSON LIGHT RIDER X 20" WHEEL LIGHT-UP BIKE, INCLUDES LIGHT-UP FRAME AND WHEELS, 3 DIFFERENT LIGHT MODES, EASILY ADJUSTABLE SEAT HEIGHT, 20" RUBBER TIRES, BLUE, JLRX20-BBL
JETSON LIGHT RIDER X 20" WHEEL LIGHT-UP BIKE, INCLUDES LIGHT-UP FRAME AND WHEELS, 3 DIFFERENT LIGHT MODES, EASILY ADJUSTABLE SEAT HEIGHT, 20" RUBBER TIRES, BLUE, JLRX20-BBL

WHO WAS USING THE PRODUCT(S)?

MY DAUGHTER WAS THE ONE WHO TESTED THE BICYCLE AFTER THE INITIAL ASSEMBLY.

HOW WERE THE PRODUCT(S) BEING USED?

THE BICYCLE WAS BEING USED FOR A TEST RUN AFTER ASSEMBLY. UPON BRINGING THE BIKE BACK INSIDE THE HOUSE, I MADE A SHARP RIGHT TURN TO ENTER THE LIVING ROOM, WHICH LED TO THE INADVERTENT BRAKE ACTIVATION DUE TO THE MISPLACEMENT OF THE BRAKE CALIPERS.

WERE THERE ANY INJURIES THAT HAPPENED OR MAY HAVE HAPPENED WHILE USING THE PRODUCT?
FORTUNATELY, NO INJURIES OCCURRED DURING THE TEST RUN. HOWEVER, THE DEFECT POSES A SIGNIFICANT SAFETY RISK, ESPECIALLY TO CHILDREN WHO MIGHT NOT BE ABLE TO REACT IN TIME IF THE BRAKES WERE TO ACTIVATE UNEXPECTEDLY.

HOW DID ANY INJURIES OCCUR?
NO INJURIES HAVE OCCURRED AS OF NOW. HOWEVER, IF LEFT UNCHECKED, AN UNEXPECTED ACTIVATION OF THE BRAKES DURING A SHARP RIGHT TURN COULD CAUSE A RIDER TO BE THROWN OVER THE HANDLEBARS.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:
AFTER DISCOVERING THE ISSUE, I CONTACTED JETSON'S CUSTOMER SERVICE. INITIALLY, THEY ADVISED ME TO RETURN THE BIKE TO AMAZON. HOWEVER, I EMPHASIZED THE POTENTIAL SEVERITY OF THE DEFECT AND INSISTED ON ESCALATING THE MATTER. I RETURNED THE BIKE AND REQUESTED A REPLACEMENT, HOPING IT WAS AN ISOLATED INCIDENT. YET, THE SECOND BIKE ALSO HAD THE SAME DEFECT. THIS LED ME TO BELIEVE IT MIGHT BE A MORE WIDESPREAD MANUFACTURING PROBLEM. DESPITE MY ATTEMPTS TO ESCALATE THE ISSUE WITHIN JETSON, I HAVE NOT SEEN ANY PROGRESS FROM THEIR SIDE IN ADDRESSING THE MATTER. GIVEN THAT THE BICYCLE WAS ON SALE DURING AMAZON PRIME DAYS, I AM DEEPLY CONCERNED ABOUT THE NUMBER OF POTENTIALLY DEFECTIVE UNITS IN CIRCULATION. I PLAN TO LEAVE A REVIEW ON AMAZON TO WARN OTHER CONSUMERS, BUT I BELIEVE JETSON NEEDS TO INVESTIGATE THIS MATTER URGENTLY TO PREVENT ANY POTENTIAL INJURIES.

I OWN A SAMSUNG FRENCH DOOR REFRIGERATOR MODEL RF263BEAESG\AA. AT THE END OF DECEMBER 2022, THE ICE MAKER IN THE FRIDGE PORTION OF THE APPLIANCE WAS COMPLETELY ICED UP AND WAS NOT PRODUCING ICE. IT COULD NOT EVEN BE PULLED OUT. WHEN THE ICE MAKER FREEZES UP, IT ALSO CAUSES ICE TO BUILD UP BEHIND THE TWIN COOLING PLUS UNIT WHERE THE EVAPORATOR COILS ARE THAT THEN CONTROL OVERALL COOLING TO THE FRIDGE. AS A RESULT, THE FRIDGE STOPS COOLING AND FOOD CAN BE HELD INSIDE AT UNSAFE TEMPERATURES. WATER ALSO POOLS UNDER THE CRISPER DRAWERS THAT CAN CAUSE MOLD DUE TO LACK OF EVAPORATION. I HAD TO REMOVE ALL FOOD TO TURN OFF POWER TO THE FRIDGE AND LET THE FRIDGE COMPLETELY DEFROST WITH THE DOORS OPEN. AT THE BEGINNING OF JANUARY, THE ICE MAKER WAS FIXED PER SAMSUNG BUT THE TECH TOLD ME THE ISSUES WITH FREEZING BEHIND THE TWIN PLUS COOLING UNIT WOULD CONTINUE. IN SEPTEMBER 2023,  I NOTICED MY DRINKS WERE NOT AS COLD AS THEY SHOULD BE. ICE HAD ONCE AGAIN COMPLETELY BUILT UP BEHIND THE PANEL. ON OCTOBER 12, 2023, I REMOVED ALL PERISHABLE FOOD AND SET IN A COOLER. I THEN TURNED THE POWER OFF TO THE FRIDGE TO LET THE ICE DEFROST COMPLETELY. ON OCTOBER 13, THE ICE HAD DEFROSTED, BUT I ALSO NOTICED MOLD HAD DEVELOPED FROM THE LACK OF COOLING BETWEEN THE GLASS AND PANEL FOR THE WATER FILTER. I CLEANED IT OUT, AND RESTARTED POWER TO THE FRIDGE. WHILE THE FRIDGE IS SUCCESSFULLY COOLING TO DATE, THE FACT THAT IT WILL CONTINUE TO BUILD UP ICE, PREVENT COOLING, AND CREATE MOLD OR OTHER UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENTS FOR FOOD IS UNSATISFACTORY.

I PURCHASED THE LOUISVILLE LADDER EVEREST ALUMINUM 10-12 FT ATTIC LADDER (MODEL AL228P ) FROM HOME DEPOT TO REPLACE A FOLDING ATTIC LADDER IN MY GARAGE. LOUISVILLE LADDER HAS CONFIRMED THAT I PURCHASED THE CORRECT RESIDENTIAL LADDER FOR MY CEILING HEIGHT.


I HIRED AN EXPERIENCED LICENSED BUILDING CONTRACTOR TO INSTALL THE LADDER WITH THE HELP OF HIS ASSISTANT. TO ACCOMMODATE THE NEW LADDER, THE CEILING OPENING HAD TO BE ENLARGED AND THE TRIM REPLACED.


UPON COMPLETION OF THE JOB, THE CONTRACTOR SHOWED ME HOW DIFFICULT OPENING AND CLOSING THE FOLDING LADDER WAS AND SHARED THAT THE LADDER HAD SCRATCHED HIS THROAT WHILE FIGURING OUT HOW TO OPERATE IT. HE NOTED THAT THE INCLUDED POLE DID NOT HELP SLOW DOWN THE RATE AT WHICH THE LADDER UNFOLDED OR FOLDED. 


HE SHOWED ME THE INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS, WHICH HE HAD CLEARLY READ BECAUSE IT  CONTAINED NOTES ABOUT MEASUREMENTS AND REQUIRED CLEARANCES THAT HE HAD WRITTEN IN PENCIL IN PROVIDED SPACES. ON THE VERY LAST PAGE OF THE INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE THE APPENDIX, THERE WAS A PAGE THAT WAS TITLED ?EVEREST ALUMINUM 12? FOLDING ATTIC LADDER OPENING AND CLOSING INSTRUCTIONS.? INITIALLY, I DIDN?T RECOGNIZE THIS PAGE AS RELEVANT TO THE LADDER I PURCHASED SINCE THE PAGE WAS REFERRING TO A FIXED LENGTH, 12 FT LADDER. FOR THE FIRST TIME, THE LAST PAGE OF THE INSTRUCTIONS NOTED THAT 2 PEOPLE AND A SEPARATE FREESTANDING LADDER ARE REQUIRED TO SAFELY OPERATE THIS ATTIC LADDER. THE CONTRACTOR WAS STUNNED AND SAID HE?S NEVER HEARD OF SUCH A THING. EVEN AFTER BEING TOLD THIS LATE-BREAKING UPDATE, IT WASN?T IMMEDIATELY OBVIOUS HOW 2 PEOPLE WOULD SAFELY OPERATE THE LADDER AND WE HAD TO CAREFULLY FOLLOW THE STEPS TO UNDERSTAND HOW TO ACCOMPLISH THIS.


I REVIEWED THE INSTRUCTIONS AGAIN AND SAW THAT THE FIRST PAGE CONTAINS 15 WARNINGS, THE FIRST 3 IN BOLD PRINT. NOT ONE OF THOSE WARNINGS ADDRESSED THE SAFE OPERATION OF THIS LADDER AND WARNED THAT USING THE LADDER WOULD REQUIRE TWO ABLE BODIED PEOPLE, ONE ON THE GROUND AND ONE ON A SEPARATE LADDER. I ALSO RECHECKED THE PRODUCT INFORMATION ON THE HOME DEPOT WEBSITE AS WELL AS THE LOUISVILLE LADDER WEBSITE, AND THIS MATERIAL DESIGN FLAW WAS NOT DISCLOSED.


I CONTACTED LOUISVILLE LADDERS WITH MY CONCERNS. MY AC UNIT IS LOCATED IN THE ATTIC ABOVE MY GARAGE AND ACCESS TO THAT SPACE IS CRITICAL. FOR PEOPLE LIKE MYSELF WHO ARE FREQUENTLY HOME ALONE, THIS LADDER IS NOT SUITABLE. LOUISVILLE LADDERS FAILED TO DISCLOSE UPFRONT CRITICAL FACTS NECESSARY TO MAKE THAT DETERMINATION.


WHEN I CALLED LOUISVILLE LADDERS, THEY ASKED FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION AND PICTURES, WHICH I SENT - INCLUDING A PHOTO OF MY CONTRACTOR?S SCRATCHED THROAT AND TWO VIDEOS SHOWING HIS EFFORTS TO OPERATE THE LADDER ON HIS OWN.  [REDACTED], A CLAIMS MANAGER FOR LOUISVILLE LADDERS, REJECTED MY REQUEST FOR COMPENSATION TO REPLACE THE LADDER. SHE STATED (INCORRECTLY) THAT ONE OF THE 15 WARNINGS ON THE FIRST PAGE INSTRUCTED THE INSTALLER TO READ ALL THE INSTRUCTIONS BEFORE BEGINNING, SO LOUISVILLE LADDERS WAS NOT RESPONSIBLE. THIS STATEMENT IS ABSOLUTELY FALSE - ONE OF THE WARNINGS INSTRUCTED THE INSTALLER TO READ ALL THE INSTRUCTIONS ON THE LABEL OF THE LADDER, AND THE LABEL DID NOT ADDRESS OPERATING THE LADDER. 


EVEN WHEN THERE IS A PROMINENT WARNING TO READ ALL THE INSTRUCTIONS, THIS WARNING IS NOT SUFFICIENT. EACH LADDER COMES WITH AN IMPLIED WARRANTY FROM THE MANUFACTURER THAT IT IS FIT AND SAFE FOR THE PURPOSE FOR WHICH IT IS ORDINARILY USED. I HAVE FOUND NO ONE, NOT A SINGLE PERSON, WHO HAD EVER HEARD OF, OR WOULD REASONABLY EVER ANTICIPATE THAT, A RESIDENTIAL ATTIC LADDER WOULD REQUIRE 2 ABLE-BODIED PEOPLE AND A SEPARATE LADDER TO OPERATE. 


I LIKEN THIS SITUATION TO PURCHASING A CAR AND FINDING OUT, AFTER IT HAS BEEN SHIPPED TO YOUR HOUSE AT YOUR GREAT EXPENSE, THAT IT CAN ONLY BE OPERATED WHEN THERE IS A DRIVER AND A SECOND PERSON IN THE PASSENGER SEAT. THIS CAR MIGHT WORK FOR SOME PEOPLE SOME OF THE TIME, BUT THAT KIND OF UNEXPECTED AND EXTRAORDINARY LIMITATION ON USE NEEDS TO BE PROMINENTLY DISPLAYED AND MADE KNOWN BEFORE THE PURCHASE. 


IN CONCLUSION, THE LOUISVILLE LADDER 10-12 FT ALUMINUM FOLDING LADDER IS UNSAFE WHEN USED IN THE MANNER PEOPLE WOULD EXPECT TO USE A RESIDENTIAL FOLDING LADDER, AND THE MANUFACTURER HAS PROVIDED INSUFFICIENT WARNING OF THIS SAFETY CONCERN.

incident_description:
I HAVE A CASPER ESSENTIAL FULL MATTRESS THAT I PURCHASED IN FALL OF 2017. IT HAD A FIRE RESISTANT "FIRE SOCK" THAT COVERS THE MATTRESS. THIS FIRE SOCK CONTAINS FIBERGLASS, WHICH IS SUPPOSED TO BE SECURELY ENCASED SO THAT IT DOES NOT ESCAPE. HOWEVER, AFTER SLEEPING ON THE MATTRESS FOR 6 YEARS, I DISCOVERED THAT IT HAS BEGUN LEAKING FIBERGLASS FIBERS. 

I HAD IT KEPT IN A WATERPROOF ANTI-BEDBUG MATTRESS PROTECTOR FOR THE LAST 3 YEARS, WHICH I REMOVED ON 10/2/2023 IN ORDER TO WASH IT. AFTERWARDS, I DISCOVERED FIBERGLASS FIBERS ALL OVER MY BEDROOM, AND I REALIZED THAT THE FIRE SOCK HAS BEGUN BREAKING DOWN AND THAT MY MATTRESS PROTECTOR HAS PREVIOUSLY BEEN CONTAINING THEM. THE SURFACE OF THE MATTRESS WAS COVERED IN SHINY STRANDS POKING OUT OF IT.

THERE ARE A FEW INJURIES I'VE SUSTAINED AS A RESULT OF THIS. MY SKIN IS VERY IRRITATED FROM WHERE IT'S BEEN EMBEDDED WITH FIBERGLASS, AND EVEN AFTER CLEANING I AM CONSTANTLY ITCHY. I BREATHED IN FIBERGLASS AND HAVE DEVELOPED A SORE THROAT, COUGH, AND SNEEZING. MY VOICE SOUNDS ROUGH, LIKE I'VE BEEN SMOKING (I HAVE NEVER SMOKED). I'VE ALSO EXPERIENCED EYE IRRITATION.

IN ADDITION TO THE INJURIES, I HAVE HAD TO UPEND MY ENTIRE BEDROOM TO CLEAN OUT THE HAZARDOUS FIBERGLASS. I'VE ALSO HAD TO THROW AWAY ALL OF MY BEDDING AND MUCH OF MY CLOTHING. I AM STILL IN THE PROCESS OF CLEANING UP, BUT I MAY NEED TO THROW AWAY SOME UPHOLSTERED FURNITURE IN THE ROOM. OF COURSE I AM ALSO GETTING RID OF THE MATTRESS.
ECOFLOW DELTA PRO.  INFINITY CABLE TO DELTA PRO IS UNSAFE.  JUNCTION GOT HOT AND BURNED OFF.

WE WENT TO USE OUR SUNDANCE ODESSA HOT TUB AND FOUND THE TEMPERATURE WAS APPROXIMATELY 107 F WHEN THE SETPOINT WAS 95 F. NO INJURY OCCURRED. ON SUNDANCE'S WEBSITE I FOUND AN ACTIVE RECALL DESCRIBING A SIMILAR EVENT, BUT FOUND MY UNIT WAS NOT SPECIFICALLY INCLUDED IN THE RECALL.

THE MACHINE HAD BEEN NOT BREWING FULL CUPS OF COFFEE SO I PURCHASED THE KEURIG DESCALING SOLUTION TO DESCALE IT.  I FOLLOWED ALL INSTRUCTIONS, AND THE MACHINE STILL FAILED TO BREW CUPS OF COFFEE.  I THEN UNPLUGGED AND DRAINED THE MACHINE USING THE TWO DRAIN TUBES IN THE BACK, AND THEN REFILLED THE RESERVOIR WITH THE DESCALING SOLUTION TO DESCALE AGAIN.  WHEN I TURNED ON THE UNIT TO DESCALE ONCE MORE, IT INDICATED "HEATING" ON THE DISPLAY SCREEN.  NOT AFTER LONG, I NOTICED SMOKE BEING EMITTED FROM WHAT I WOULD CALL THE OVERFLOW NOZZLE, A SMALL RUBBER DUMP TUBE INTO THE TOP OF THE RESERVOIR.  I THEN QUICKLY UNPLUGGED THE MACHINE AND BROUGHT IT OUTSIDE, NOT BEFORE IT FILLED THE OFFICE WITH A TOXIC SMOKE, PRESUMABLY CAUSED BY THE INSIDE OF THE BOILER BURNING OFF.

IF I HAD NOT BEEN ATTENTIVE TO THE UNIT, THIS COULD HAVE EASILY CAUGHT OUR BREAK ROOM ON FIRE, IF NOT OUR ENTIRE BUILDING.  

WE HAVE ATTEMPTED TO CONTACT THE MANUFACTURER, BUT THEY ARE UNWILLING TO RESOLVE THE ISSUE AMICABLY.  WE BELIEVE THIS MACHINE IS UNSAFE, AND HAS THE POTENTIAL TO CAUSE BODILY INJURY AND  PROPERTY DAMAGE.

WE WOULD LIKE TO LODGE A FORMAL COMPLAINT INTO THIS UNIT DUE TO THE ISSUE ABOVE, AND THE COMPANY'S LACK OF CONCERN FOR THE SAFETY OF THEIR CONSUMERS.

ON 11/14/2023 AT APPROXIMATELY 8:30PM EST, MY WIFE AND I WERE PUTTING OUR 5 YEAR OLD DAUGHTER TO BED. DURING THIS TIME, WE PLUGGED IN HER VICKS WARM MIST HUMIDIFIER DUE TO HER CURRENT COLD AND EAR INFECTION. NOTE, HER HUMIDIFIER WAS ON TOP OF HER DRESSER, MORE THAN 5 FEET AWAY FROM HER BED. AFTER PUTTING HER TO BED, MY WIFE AND I WENT DOWNSTAIRS. DURING THAT TIME, MY DAUGHTER UNKNOWINGLY WANTED TO HAVE HER HUMIDIFIER CLOSER TO HER BED SO IT COULD HELP HER BREATHE, AND SOUGHT TO MOVE HER HUMIDIFIER CLOSER TO HER BED ON THE FLOOR - SOMETHING WE HAVE DONE BEFORE BUT EITHER MY WIFE OR I WOULD SET IT UP. THE HUMIDIFIER TANK HOLDER PROCEEDING TO FALL AND WATER SPILT ON THE LEFT SIDE OF MY DAUGHTER'S CHEST, PARTS OF HER SHOULDER, AND NECK. SHE IMMEDIATELY SCREAMED, WHICH WE RUSHED UPSTAIRS - THE WATER WAS SO HOT THAT IT BURNT HER SKIN, CAUSING ME TO RUSH HER TO THE ER. THE DOCTOR DETERMINED THAT IT WAS A SECOND DEGREE BURN, AND TREATED MY DAUGHTER FOR THAT. HER CHEST AND PARTS OF HER SHOULDER/NECK HAVE SECOND DEGREE BURNS FROM WATER - WE PUT NO ADDITIONAL PRODUCT IN THE HUMIDIFIER. I DO NOT AGREE THAT THE WATER SHOULD BE SO HOT WITHIN THE TYPE OF HUMIDIFIER TO CAUSE THAT LEVEL OF PAIN, LET ALONE SHOULD REQUIRE A WARNING LABEL IN PLAIN SITE.

UPON INSPECTING THE STEPS THAT WERE STILL IN PLACE, I SAW THAT MOST OF THEM HAD SCREWS THAT WERE VERY LOOSE. THE STEPS THAT HAD GIVEN WAY HAD SCREWS THAT HAD COMPLETELY COME OUT. SO I CONCLUDED THAT THE REASON THE STEPS FAILED IS THAT THE SCREWS HAD LOOSENED OVER TIME.
 
THERE IS NO MECHANISM TO PREVENT THE SCREWS FROM LOOSENING OVER TIME DUE TO NORMAL USE AND/OR DUE TO VIBRATIONS FROM THE ADJACENT HOT TUB. THIS SEEMS LIKE A DESIGN FLAW. THE SCREWS SHOULD USE LOCK WASHERS, SERRATED/STAR WASHERS, AND/OR THREAD LOCK COMPOUND TO PREVENT THIS.

THE INSTALLATION MANUAL ALSO DOES NOT SPECIFY SCREW TIGHTENING TORQUE, BUT IT SHOULD.

I LUCKILY DIDN'T SUFFER INJURY BECAUSE I WAS ABLE TO GRAB THE HANDRAIL AND PREVENT MYSELF FROM FALLING, BUT A LESS AGILE PERSON COULD BE SEVERELY HURT.

MICROWAVE CAUGHT FIRE; THERMADOR'S POOR SAFETY RECORD-KEEPING & FOLLOW-UP LED TO LONG DELAYS 

OUR THERMADOR MICROWAVE'S INTERNAL COMPONENTS CAUGHT ON FIRE AS WE PREPARED DINNER. THERE WAS A LOUD ELECTRICAL BUZZING SOUND AND SMOKE THAT SMELLED LIKE BURNING ELECTRONICS AND RUBBER.

WE QUICKLY STOPPED THE COOKING CYCLE, AND REMOVED THE TRIM SIDING TO UNPLUG THE CORD, WHICH RELEASED A PLUME OF FOUL SMOKE (SEE ATTACHED SCREENGRAB, WITH RED CIRCLE ADDED AROUND RISING SMOKE).


THIS WAS THE SECOND TIME A THERMADOR MICROWAVE OVEN CAUGHT FIRE IN OUR HOME. THE FIRST TIME, THE FIRE DEPARTMENT NEEDED TO COME AND REMOVE THE UNIT FROM OUR HOUSE, BECAUSE ITS COMPONENTS WOULD NOT STOP BURNING (SEE ATTACHED PHOTOS). THERMADOR THEN ARRANGED FOR THE UNIT TO BE PICKED UP AND TRANSPORTED TO THEIR LABORATORY FOR A SAFETY INSPECTION, AND THEY ARRANGED FOR A PRODUCT REPLACEMENT OUT OF SAFETY CONCERNS. 

THIS RECENT TIME, WE AGAIN CONTACTED THERMADOR / BSH GROUP. THE PRIORITY CASES REPRESENTATIVE [REDACTED] INDICATED THAT STANDARD PROCEDURE IN SUCH A SITUATION IS STILL TO ARRANGE FOR AN IN-LABORATORY INSPECTION AND REPLACEMENT. SHE TAGGED THE CASE AS A SAFETY AND PRIORITY ISSUE, AND ARRANGED FOR A HOME VISIT BY A TECHNICIAN.

THE THERMADOR TECHNICIAN [REDACTED] CAME AND TESTED THE UNIT, AND HE WATCHED IT CATCH ON FIRE AGAIN IN FRONT OF HIS OWN EYES (SEE ATTACHED VIDEO). HE SAID THAT THIS WAS NOT AN UNCOMMON PROBLEM FOR THOSE MICROWAVES.

THE TECHNICIAN STATED THAT HE WAS PREPARING A REPORT WITH PHOTOS, TO HELP ARRANGE FOR THE IN-LABORATORY REVIEW AND MICROWAVE REPLACEMENT. HE SAID TO WAIT TO HEAR BACK FROM THE DEPARTMENT RESPONSIBLE FOR SAFETY ISSUES WITH A RESOLUTION. 


BUT APPARENTLY THERE WERE NO GUARDRAILS IN PLACE AT THAT DEPARTMENT TO FLAG PRIORITY SAFETY CASES FOR POST-VISIT FOLLOW-UP ACTION. WE WAITED, BUT WE DID NOT HEAR BACK.  AFTER TWO MONTHS WITH NO FOLLOW-UP, WE CONTACTED THERMADOR TO FIND OUT THE STATUS OF THE PROCESS.

WE THEN NEEDED TO FILL IN A SECOND REPRESENTATIVE, [REDACTED], ABOUT THE SITUATION. AND THERMADOR'S RECORD-KEEPING ABOUT THE UNITS IT DISTRIBUTES WAS SO POOR THAT WE NEEDED TO EMAIL THAT REPRESENTATIVE THE VERY SAME DOCUMENTATION THE COMPANY HAD PREVIOUSLY EMAILED US ABOUT THE UNIT BECAUSE SHE DID NOT ALREADY HAVE IT OR HAVE ACCESS TO IT.  TWO WEEKS LATER, THE REPRESENTATIVE CALLED BACK TO ASK BASIC INFORMATION ABOUT THE COMPANY'S OWN PRODUCT, LIKE WHETHER THAT MODEL OF MICROWAVE WAS A COMBO UNIT.

(THIS SUGGESTS TO US THAT THERMADOR -- INCREDIBLY -- MAY NOT MAINTAIN A COMPREHENSIVE CENTRAL DATABASE OF ITS OWN PRODUCT SAFETY ACTIVITIES OR THE REPLACEMENT PRODUCTS IT DISTRIBUTES AND INSTALLS INTO CONSUMERS' HOMES, DEPRIVING THE COMPANY'S OWN PRODUCT SAFETY PERSONNEL OF THAT IMPORTANT INFORMATION.

THIS CONFUSION FROM THE REPRESENTATIVE ABOUT THERMADOR'S PRODUCT LINE MAY ALSO BE DUE IN PART TO THERMADOR'S APPARENT BADGING OF [REDACTED]-MANUFACTURED MICROWAVE OVENS AS THERMADOR MICROWAVES, ACCORDING TO THE [REDACTED] CERTIFICATION MARK REPORT DISCUSSED IN THE "PRODUCT DETAILS" SECTION ABOVE. THAT COULD PRESUMABLY LEAD TO CONFUSION AND LACK OF PRODUCT KNOWLEDGE IN A COMPANY SEEMINGLY USING A LARGER, CHEAPER COMPETITOR'S PRODUCTS AS ITS OWN.)

AT THAT POINT, WE HAD BACK-AND-FORTH COMMUNICATION WITH THE REPRESENTATIVE, TO ARRANGE FOR A LABORATORY SAFETY INSPECTION AND UNIT REPLACEMENT. BUT THE REPRESENTATIVE SUDDENLY STOPPED REPLYING. WE SIMPLY GOT RADIO SILENCE. AFTER A LENGTHY PERIOD WITH NO RESPONSE (EVEN LONGER THAN HER PREVIOUS DELAYS IN RESPONDING TO MESSAGES), EVENTUALLY WE LEARNED FROM ANOTHER EMPLOYEE THAT THE REPRESENTATIVE, WHO WAS OUR POINT-OF-CONTACT IN THE COMPANY, HAD BEEN TRANSFERRED TO A DIFFERENT DEPARTMENT.  APPARENTLY, COMPANY POLICIES DID NOT REQUIRE HER TO CONTINUE COMMUNICATING ABOUT THE PRIORITY SAFETY CASES THAT SHE HAD BEEN ASSIGNED ONCE SHE GOT A NEW ROLE IN THE COMPANY ? EVEN IF SIMPLY TO REPLY TO CONSUMERS ABOUT HER CHANGE OF POSITION AND ANY HAND-OFF OF THE CASES. ALLEGEDLY WE SHOULD HAVE BEEN LEFT A GENERIC ANSWERING MACHINE MESSAGE ASKING US TO CALL THE COMPANY, YET WE RECEIVED NO RESPONSE TO MULTIPLE EMAIL MESSAGES CONTINUING TO TRY TO FOLLOW UP.

A THIRD THERMADOR REPRESENTATIVE CREATED A NEW CASE TICKET AND WE WERE SUPPOSED TO GET A TIMELY RESPONSE, WHICH WE STILL HAVE NOT YET RECEIVED.

(WE'LL BE GLAD TO PROVIDE COPIES OF EMAIL MESSAGES, CALL LOGS, ETC., AS USEFUL TO THE CPSC.)

THE CAUSE OF THIS PROBLEM IS THE LACK OF POSITIVE POSITIONING OF THE BLADES WHICH WILL COLLIDE UNLESS THEY ARE MOUNTED ABOUT 90 DEGREES OUT OF PHASE.  UPON REPLACING THE BLADES, I TORQUED THE BOLTS AS SPECIFIED (50 FT-LB) WITH A HIGH-QUALITY TORQUE WRENCH AND THEY WERE EASY TO ROTATE WITH ABOUT 40# OF FORCE AT THE TIP.  I THEN INCREASED THE TORQUE TO 55 AND THEN 60 FT-LB.  I COULD STILL ROTATE THE BLADES.  SO WHEN A BLADE HITS AN OBSTACLE, IT CAN ROTATE SUCH THAT IT CAN HIT THE OTHER ONE.  SOME OF THE 42" DECKS (BUT NOT MINE OBVIOUSLY) HAD AN INDEXING MECHANISM TO AVOID ROTATION.  THESE DECKS SHOULD BE RECALLED AND REPLACED WITH ONES THAT DON'T ALLOW THE BLADES TO ROTATE RELATIVE TO THE MOUNTS AND CRASH INTO EACH OTHER.  LUCKILY, THE SHRAPNEL DIDN'T HIT ANYTHING OF IMPORTANCE.

I AM A FIRE INSPECTOR WITH ONE OF MY DUTIES BEING TO INSPECT SMOKE ALARMS IN R2 OCCUPANCIES. OVER THE LAST FOUR YEARS I HAVE HAD REPEATED EXPERIENCE WITH FIRST ALERT P1210 SMOKE ALARMS THAT CAUSE CONCERN.

1. WHILE CALIFORNIA REQUIRES BATTERY POWERED SMOKE ALARMS SOLD IN THE STATE TO LAST AT LEAST 10 YEARS, I'VE SEEN MANY EXAMPLES OF P1210S DYING IN AS LITTLE TIME AS A YEAR OR TWO.
2. EVEN WORSE, I'VE COME ACROSS MANY EXAMPLES THAT DIED WITHOUT PROVIDING ANY WARNING TO THE APARTMENT TENANT. NO CHIRPING WARNING THAT THE BATTERY IS GETTING LOW. I GO TO TEST THEM AND THEY ARE JUST DEAD.
3. THE INSTALLATION OF THE ALARM INTO THE BRACKET CAN BE TROUBLESOME, I'VE SEEN MANY EXAMPLES WHERE THE ALARM WAS INSTALLED IN THE BRACKET BUT IT DIDN'T ACTIVATE AS IT WAS SUPPOSED TO. THE LABELING ON THE DIACTIVATION SWITCH IS CONFUSING AS WELL.
4. ABOUT HALF OF THE P1210 ALARMS I TESTED WOULD DO A CHIRP CHIRP CHIRP INSTEAD OF THE FULL ALARM. AT FIRST I THOUGHT THAT WAS A LOW BATTERY INDICATION, BUT FINALLY AFTER COMING ACROSS SO MANY THAT DID IT I CALLED FIRST ALERT. APPARENTLY THAT 3 CHIRP MEANS THE ALARM HAS GONE OFF BEFORE. SO ABOUT HALF OF THE P1210S THAT I'VE TESTED HAVE HAD FALSE ALARMS. MANY OF THESE ARE IN LOCATIONS AWAY FROM THE KITCHEN WHERE YOU MIGHT EXPECT A HIGH NUMBER OF FALSE ALARMS.

FIRST ALERT AND OTHER SMOKE ALARM MANUFACTURERS NEED TO REALIZE THAT MANY OF THEIR PRODUCTS GET INSTALLED INTO APARTMENTS. THE TENANTS DIDN'T BUY THEM, AND MOST OFTEN DON'T HAVE ACCESS TO THE OWNER'S MANUAL. SMOKE ALARMS MUST BE INTUITIVE AND SIMPLE TO INSTALL AND OPERATE.

BEFORE WE GET TO WHAT HAPPENED, I THINK YOU SHOULD KNOW THAT I AM A MEASUREMENT EXPERT. I AM THE CHAIR OF AN [REDACTED] GROUP THAT JUST REVISED [REDACTED], AND I AM CHAIR OF A GROUP REVISING [REDACTED]. 

NOW I WANT TO REPORT AN UNSAFE MEASUREMENT  DEVICE THAT I CAME ACROSS BY CHANCE. IT IS THE VOLTMETER PART OF A "3-PIECE TECHNICIAN TEST KIT" SOLD BY HOME DEPOT, PART NUMBER 1004 482 497. IT IS MADE BY COMMERCIAL ELECTRIC. THE PROBLEM IS THAT THE READING ON THE DEVICE WAS ZERO WHEN THERE WAS ACTUALLY A VOLTAGE ON THE CIRCUIT I WAS TESTING. THE PROBLEM IS NOT A FAULT IN THE INSTRUMENT, IT IS A DESIGN ERROR. HOME DEPOT LET ME TEST A SECOND SAMPLE, AND THE SAME PROBLEM WAS PRESENT.

A VOLTMETER HAS TWO PROBES. WHEN SWITCHED TO MEASURE AC, IT SHOULD NOT MATTER WHICH WAY ROUND THE PROBES ARE CONNECTED. WITH THIS DEVICE, IT DOES MATTER IF THERE IS A DC COMPONENT ON THE SIGNAL. IN THE CASE I WAS MEASURING. THE READING WAS ZERO WITH THE PROBES ONE WAY ROUND, AND NOT ZERO THE OTHER WAY ROUND. 

I AM AWARE THAT THE CONDITION OF HAVING SOME DC ON AN AC CIRCUIT IS UNUSUAL, BUT THAT'S WHAT THERE WAS IN MY WORK. (I VERIFIED IT WITH MY OSCILLOSCOPE.)

IF A USER IS UNAWARE OF THE POSSIBILITY OF THERE BEING AN AC POTENTIAL EVEN THOUGH THE METER DISPLAYS ZERO, THAT COULD BE DANGEROUS.

THE DESIGN ERROR WOULD NOT BE EVIDENT IN THE ABSENCE OF DC ON THE CIRCUIT, BUT THE FACT OF A MISLEADING INDICATION COULD LEAD TO AN ELECTRIC SHOCK. (FRANKLY, I THINK HOME DEPOT SHOULD PULL THE METER OFF THE SHELF UNTIL THE DESIGN IS FIXED, BUT I CANNOT FIND A WAY TO CONTACT THEM THAT SEEMS LIKELY TO ACHIEVE THAT OUTCOME. HOME DEPOT WILL SURELY LET ME RETURN THE METER FOR A REFUND, BUT THAT IS SCARCELY THE END OF THE STORY.)

victim_1_severity: No First Aid or Medical Attention Received
incident_description:
I AM REPORTING A BRAKE FAILURE (BOTH FRONT AND BACK BRAKES) THAT APPEARS TO BE DUE TO A DESIGN FLAW IN THE BRAKES USED FOR THE SCHWINN TWINN TANDEM MOUNTAIN BIKE, MODEL S7962AZ.  THE BRAKES FAILED WHILE MY WIFE AND I WERE RIDING THE BIKE.  THIS COULD HAVE RESULTED IN A SERIOUS INJURY, BUT ONLY MINOR INJURIES RESULTED; ALTHOUGH THE BRAKES FAILED WHILE RIDING DOWN A STEEP HILL, I WAS ABLE TO STOP THE BIKE BY DRAGGING MY FEET ON THE PAVEMENT.  IN DOING SO, I DID SUSTAIN A MINOR BACK INJURY, FROM THE DIFFICULTY INVOLVED IN GETTING THE BIKE TO STOP.
I EXAMINED THE BRAKES CLOSELY TO SEE WHY THE FAILURE OCCURRED.  THE BRAKE IS A CABLE-PULL BRAKE: YOU PULL A BRAKE LEVER MOUNTED TO THE HANDLEBAR, WHICH PULLS A CABLE, AND THAT CABLE IS CONNECTED TO LEVER AT THE BRAKE.  THE LEVER ROTATES, AND CLOSES THE CALIPER, CAUSING THE BRAKE PADS TO PRESS AGAINST THE DISC ROTOR TO STOP THE BIKE.  THE DESIGN FLAW OCCURS WHEN THE BRAKE PADS BECOME WORN.  SPECIFICALLY, WHEN THE BRAKE PADS WEAR DOWN, THE CALIPER MUST CLOSE MORE IN ORDER FOR CONTACT TO OCCUR.  IN ORDER TO CLOSE THE CALIPER MORE, THE BRAKE LEVER MUST BE PULLED FURTHER, CAUSING THE LEVER AT THE BRAKE TO ROTATE FURTHER, WHICH CLOSES THE CALIPER.  WHEN THE LEVER AT THE BRAKE ROTATES PAST A CERTAIN AMOUNT, IT REACHES THE END OF ITS THREADS, AND "POPS" OUT, COMPLETELY DISENGAGING THE BRAKE.  THIS HAPPENED IN BOTH THE FRONT AND THE REAR BRAKE, LEAVING US WITH NO WAY TO STOP.
I CAN REPRODUCE THIS PROBLEM IF YOU NEED TO SEE IT DEMONSTRATED, AND CAN SEND IN A VIDEO.  THIS PROBLEM ONLY SHOWS UP WHEN THE BIKE HAS BEEN USED A LOT, AS THE BRAKE PADS NEED TO BE WORN DOWN.  HOWEVER, ONCE THIS HAPPENS, THE BIKE IS VERY DANGEROUS, AND I'M WORRIED THAT SOMEONE COULD BE SERIOUSLY INJURED UNLESS SCHWINN ADDRESSES THE PROBLEM.

I RECENTLY PURCHASED A QUEEN-SIZE SIENA MATTRESS ON AMAZON.COM. SIENA IS A SUB-BRAND OF RESIDENT HOME, WHICH MANUFACTURES THE NECTAR MATTRESS. UPON SETTING UP THE MATTRESS, I NOTICED A WARNING THAT SAID, 'DO NOT REMOVE THE ZIPPERS. PROPERTY DAMAGE, ETC., CAN OCCUR IF ZIPPERS ARE REMOVED.' IT WAS SOMETHING ALONG THOSE LINES. I KNEW THIS MATTRESS CONTAINED FIBERGLASS AS A FIRE RETARDANT AND HAD RESEARCHED NUMEROUS ARTICLES STATING IT IS SAFE AS LONG AS I DON'T REMOVE THE OUTER COVER. I NEVER REMOVED THE COVER. AFTER PURCHASING IT, I STARTED HAVING A STUFFY NOSE, AND MY CAT BEGAN SNEEZING OCCASIONALLY. I ATTRIBUTED THIS TO SEASONAL CHANGES. OCCASIONALLY, MY SKIN ITCHED, WHICH I ALSO THOUGHT WAS DUE TO SEASONAL ALLERGIES. HOWEVER, THE NEW KITTEN MY HOUSEMATE ADOPTED LIKES TO RUN AROUND THE HOUSE. SHE WENT UNDER MY BED, AND I SAW CRYSTAL-LIKE SHARP MATERIAL PROTRUDING FROM THE BOTTOM BARRIER OF MY SIENA MATTRESS. I IMMEDIATELY RECOGNIZED IT AS FIBERGLASS, HAVING SEEN ENOUGH NEWS AND VIDEOS ABOUT IT ON SOCIAL MEDIA. I USED MY PHONE'S FLASHLIGHT TO INSPECT FURTHER AND REALIZED THAT FIBERGLASS WAS POKING THROUGH THE BARRIER, WITH SOME FIBERS ATTACHED TO THE METAL BED SLATS, ETC. I ALSO FOUND THESE SHARP MATERIALS ON THE FITTED SHEET, ALTHOUGH NOT AS MUCH AS ON THE BOTTOM OF MY MATTRESS. I CONTACTED SIENA BUT HAVEN'T HEARD BACK FOR A FEW DAYS. THEY KEPT ASKING FOR MY CONTACT INFORMATION BUT TO NO AVAIL. I FEEL REALLY FRUSTRATED. I'VE ORDERED A NEW MATTRESS AND WILL REMOVE THIS ONE MYSELF, HOPING THAT SIENA RESOLVES THE ISSUE AND ARRANGES FOR ITS DISPOSAL. I KNOW FIBERGLASS IS SAFE IF THE OUTER COVER IS WELL-REINFORCED, BUT IT SEEMS THAT'S NOT THE CASE WITH SIENA'S PRODUCT. IT APPEARS TO BE A THIN LAYER OF RAYON OR POLYESTER. IT'S FRUSTRATING THAT THEY CONTINUE USING THIS MATERIAL WITHOUT DILIGENT RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT, ESPECIALLY AFTER CLASS-ACTION LAWSUITS CONCERNING THEIR SUB-BRAND NECTAR.

incident_description: WE BOUGHT A DOUGH BOWL CANDLE WITH THREE WOOD WICKS FROM ETSY. THE WICKS ALL BURNED DIFFERENTLY (THE MIDDLE WOULDN'T BURN AT ALL, ONE ON THE END BURNED A LITTLE AND WOULD GO OUT, AND THE THIRD WOULD BURN SLIGHTLY). THIS CAUSED THE WAX TO BE ALL UNEVEN ACROSS THE LENGTH OF THE WOOD DOUGH BOWL. THE UNEVENNESS OF THE WAX AND THE LOW FLAME ON THE WICK MADE IT EXTREMELY DIFFICULT TO SEE THAT THE CANDLE WAS LIT AT ALL. ONE NIGHT, ONLY THE ONE WICK WAS LIT (THE OTHER TWO WOULDN'T LIGHT) BUT IT WASN'T VISIBLE DUE TO THE UNEVENNESS OF THE WAX. THE OTHER TWO WICKS WERE NOT LIT. IT WAS LEFT LIT WHEN WE WENT TO BED BECAUSE WE COULD NOT SEE THAT IT WAS LIT. THE ONE WICK LIT THE SIDE OF THE WOOD DOUGH BOWL ON FIRE AND THE FIRE SPREAD AROUND THE RIM OF THE BOWL. THE ENTIRE BOWL DID NOT BURN BECAUSE THERE WAS STILL WAX IN IT DUE TO THE UNEVENNESS OF THE CANDLE BURNING. SO THE RIM TURNED INTO A WICK BURNING THE WAX STILL IN THE BOWL. WE WOKE UP TO OUR SMOKE ALARMS GOING OFF AND SAW THE ENTIRE BOWL IN HUGE FLAMES ON OUR KITCHEN ISLAND. THE FLAMES WERE AT LEAST TWO FEET HIGH. IF THE CANDLE HAD BEEN ON A FLAMMABLE SURFACE INSTEAD OF OUR MARBLE ISLAND AND IF THERE HAD BEEN ANYTHING ELSE AROUND IT, THERE WOULD HAVE BEEN A MAJOR FIRE IN THE HOUSE. MY HUSBAND USED A TOWEL AND GRABBED THE FLAMING BOWL TO PUT IT IN THE SINK. HE THOUGHT THE WHOLE BOWL WAS ON FIRE AND DIDN'T REALIZE THERE WAS STILL WAX IN IT. THE WAX SPILLED OVER THE EDGE AND BURNED HIS HAND AS HE WAS DROPPING THE BURNING CANDLE BOWL INTO THE SINK TO PUT IT OUT. THIS PRODUCT IS INHERENTLY UNSAFE DUE TO THE UNEVEN BURNING OF THE WICKS CAUSING IT TO BE EXTREMELY DIFFICULT TO TELL IF THE CANDLE IS STILL LIT, AND THE WOOD CONTAINER THAT EASILY CATCHES FIRE.

incident_description:
I BOUGHT A NEW 65? SAMSUNG QLED TV (MODEL QN65Q90TAFXZA) THREE WEEKS AGO. UPON TURNING IT ON FOR THE FIRST TIME THE SETUP AUDIO CAME ON, BUT THE SCREEN STAYED BLACK. AFTER ABOUT 60 SECONDS THERE WERE LOUD POPPING NOISES AND SMOKE STARTED COMING OUT OF THE TOP OF THE HOUSING. I RAN OVER AND UNPLUGGED IT AND GOT MY WIFE TO GRAB ONE END OF IT AND WE RUSHED IT OUTSIDE AS IT CONTINUED TO SMOKE. WE GOT BACK INSIDE AND MY WIFE WAS VERY SHAKEN UP. SHE IS CURRENTLY 13 WEEKS PREGNANT AND BEGAN FREAKING OUT ABOUT WHETHER BREATHING IN THAT SMOKE COULD HAVE HURT THE BABY. MY ENTIRE HOUSE ALSO SMELLED LIKE CHEMICAL SMOKE, SO I OPENED UP ALL THE WINDOWS (IT WAS BELOW FREEZING OUTSIDE) AND TURNED ON A BOX FAN. I THEN CALLED SAMSUNG, AND THEY TOLD ME THAT THIS IS SOMETHING THEY TAKE VERY SERIOUSLY AND I WOULD BE CONTACTED WITHIN 24 HOURS BY THE GROUP THAT HANDLES THIS TYPE OF THING. 

TWO DAYS GO BY WITH NO CALL. I CALL BACK AND THEY TELL ME THAT I WAS SUPPOSED TO GET A CALL AND THEY WILL MAKE SURE I DO, AND THAT I WILL DEFINITELY GET A CALL IN 24-48 HOURS. TWO MORE DAYS GOES BY WITH NO CALL, SO I CALL AGAIN ASKING IF THEY CAN JUST TRANSFER ME TO WHOEVER IS SUPPOSED TO CALL ME. THEY TRANSFER ME AND I SPEAK WITH SOMEONE WHO ASKS ME TO EXPLAIN EXACTLY WHAT HAPPENED, THEN REPEATS EVERYTHING I TOLD HER BACK TO ME TO MAKE SURE SHE HAS ALL THE DETAILS. SHE THEN ASKS WHAT RESOLUTION I?M LOOKING FOR. I TOLD HER I WOULD LIKE A REPLACEMENT SINCE THE TV CAUGHT ON FIRE AS SOON AS I TURNED IT ON, AND I DON?T FEEL SAFE WITH IT IN MY HOUSE GIVEN WHAT HAPPENED. SHE TELLS ME SHE WILL SEE WHAT THEY CAN DO, AND I WILL BE CONTACTED WITHIN 48 HOURS FOR NEXT STEPS.

A FEW HOURS LATER I GET A CALL FROM A LOCAL REPAIR SHOP SAYING THEY HAVE BEEN ASKED TO COME LOOK AT THE TV AND SEE WHAT HAPPENED. I SCHEDULE AN APPOINTMENT AND A FEW DAYS LATER A TECH COMES OUT TO TAKE A LOOK. HE OPENS IT UP AND SURE ENOUGH ONE OF THE CONNECTORS ON A DRIVER BOARD HAD CAUGHT ON FIRE AND MELTED THE CONNECTOR AND BOARD. HE PLUGS THE TV BACK IN AND THE CONNECTOR STARTS POPPING AND FLAMING AND SAYS ?YEP, THAT?S DEFINITELY THE ISSUE?. HE TAKES PICTURES OF EVERYTHING AND PUTS THE TV BACK TOGETHER AND TELLS ME THAT THEY WILL ORDER A NEW BOARD AND ONCE IT?S IN THEY WILL REPLACE THE BOARD AND IT SHOULD BE GOOD AS NEW. I EXPRESSED TO HIM THAT I DON?T WANT THE TV IN MY HOUSE AT ALL. IT STILL STINKS LIKE BURNT CHEMICALS, AND I DON?T TRUST IT. AT THIS POINT I HAVE SEEN THE TV CATCH FIRE TWICE, AND I WANT NOTHING TO DO WITH IT. HE TELLS ME THAT HE HAS NO SAY IN THE MATTER AND I?LL HAVE TO TALK TO SAMSUNG ABOUT IT.

I CALL SAMSUNG BACK AND TELL THEM I WON?T ACCEPT A REPLACEMENT PART AND THAT I DON?T FEEL SAFE WITH THE TV IN MY HOUSE GIVEN THAT I?VE SEEN IT CATCH ON FIRE TWICE NOW. THEY SAID THAT THEY WOULD PUT IN AN INQUIRY TO SEE IF IT WOULD BE POSSIBLE TO GET A REPLACEMENT, AND THAT I SHOULD GET A RESPONSE TO THE INQUIRY IN 48 HOURS. THIS WAS ON FRIDAY. THIS MORNING I GET A CALL FROM SAMSUNG AND THEY SAY THAT DESPITE MY EXPERIENCE THEY ARE ONLY OFFERING TO REPLACE THE BOARD THAT CAUGHT ON FIRE WITH A NEW ONE, AND THAT THEIR POLICY DOES NOT ALLOW THEM TO PROVIDE ANY OTHER RESOLUTION. DESPITE EXPRESSING TO THEM MULTIPLE TIMES THAT WE DON?T FEEL SAFE WITH THE TV IN THE HOUSE, AND THAT WE?RE ALREADY CONCERNED ABOUT THE SMOKE EXPOSURE TO MY PREGNANT WIFE, THEY TOLD ME THAT THEIR POLICY DOES NOT OFFER ANY OTHER RESOLUTION.
I PLUGGED IN THE KEYCHAIN CHARGER AND THE CORD THAT CAME WITH THE PRODUCT AND THEN AFTER TEN MINUTES THE CORD HEATED UP AND STARTED TO MELT.

WE IMMEDIATELY CUT POWER (AT THE CIRCUIT BREAKER) TO THE STOVE'S ELECRICAL CIRCUIT, AND THE FIRE WENT OUT.   THE NEXT DAY, WE REMOVED PART OF THE STOVE'S FRONT COVER TO LET THE MOISTURE DRY.  36 HOURS AFTER THE SPILL, WE RESTORED POWER TO THE STOVE, BUT AN ELECTRICAL FIRE IMMEDIATELY STARTED -- FLAMES LEAPT OUT OF THE OPEN COVER OF THE STOVE.  ACCORDINGLY, WE IMMEDIATELY AGAIN CUT POWER TO THE STOVE'S CIRCUIT. THIS STOVETOP'S POOR DESIGN ENABLED A ROUTINE OCCURRENCE -- SPILLING A MODEST AMOUNT OF LIQUID ONTO THE STOVETOP -- TO START AN ELECTRICAL FIRE WITHIN THE STOVE.   A WEB SEARCH SHOWED THAT A SIMILAR INCIDENT HAD OCCURRED WITH A SIMILAR STOVE FROM THE SAME MANUFACTURER.

I LOADED ONE UP WITH AROUND 200 POUNDS AND THE FIRST TIME I TRIED TO MOVE IT, A WHEEL BUMPED INTO AN EXTENSION CORD ON THE FLOOR.  THE CASTER ASSEMBLY TORQUED OUT OF THE TUBING.  FORTUNATELY I WAS STANDING AT THE CORNER THAT FAILED AND I WAS ABLE TO KEEP THE UNIT FROM FALLING OVER.  I FIGURED IT WAS JUST A DEFECTIVE PART.  I ORDERED A REPLACEMENT PART FROM TRINITY.  I AGAIN LOADED THE SHELVING UNIT, THIS TIME WITH MAYBE 150 POUNDS?  I MOVED IT ACROSS THE GARAGE ONCE AND IT WAS FINE.  WHEN I WENT TO ROLL IT BACK A WHEEL BUMPED INTO A SCRAP OF «? PLYWOOD.  THE CASTER ASSEMBLY IMMEDIATELY TORQUED OUT OF THE TUBING AND THIS TIME THE UNIT FELL OVER.  
I TOOK A CLOSER LOOK AT THE POINT WHERE THE CASTERS CONNECT TO THE TUBING.  THE CASTERS ATTACH TO THE TUBES USING CIRCULAR DONUT SHAPED PIECES PRESSED INTO THE TUBE.  THE THREADS ARE IN THE HOLE OF THE DONUT.  THE DONUT IS TINY, WHEN FULLY PRESSED IN, IT ONLY GOES INTO THE TUBE ABOUT 3/8?.  TO HOLD THE DONUT IN, THE TUBING IS DIMPLED IN THE HOPES THAT THE DONUT WILL ALSO DIMPLE AND THE TWO WILL STICK TOGETHER ? THEY DON?T. I BELIEVE THESE SHELVES ARE AN ACCIDENT WAITING TO HAPPEN.  IF SOMEONE RELIES ON THE INSTRUCTIONS AND LOADS 1000 POUNDS ONTO THE UNIT AND THEN MOVES IT, THE UNIT WILL FAIL.  IF SOMEONE IS STANDING IN THE WRONG PLACE, THEY WILL HAVE 1000 POUNDS SUDDENLY FALLING ON THEM.

incident_description:
I AM WRITING TO DESCRIBE AN INCIDENT AND REQUESTED COMPENSATION FOR A DANGEROUS INCIDENT THAT OCCURRED IN MY HOME ON NOVEMBER 16TH, 2023 INVOLVING A GE (GENERAL ELECTRIC) WASHING MACHINE.

OUR SIX YEAR-OLD MACHINE (MODEL: GTW680BSJ5WS   SERIAL:  HL184019G) EXPLODED FEET AWAY FROM MY SIXTEEN MONTH-OLD SON. THE FORCE OF THE EXPLOSION WAS SUCH THAT IT EXPULSED THE MACHINE FEET OFF THE WALL, WARPED THE SIDES, AND CONCUSSED THE ADJACENT (GE) DRYER. IT ALSO SPEWED BLACK LIQUID AS FAR AS ABOUT SIX FEET ONTO NEIGHBORING FURNITURE AND WALLS.

I CALLED GE CONSUMER RELATIONS AND WAS TOLD A TECHNICIAN WOULD COME TO "EVALUATE" THE DAMAGE ON NOVEMBER 30TH. AS THAT WOULD BE NEARLY TWO WEEKS WITHOUT A RESOLUTION, I REQUESTED A SOONER DATE, AND WAS TOLD SOMEONE WOULD ARRIVE ON NOVEMBER 20TH. THAT MORNING, A TECHNICIAN CALLED, BUT REFUSED TO ARRIVE, SINCE WE TOLD HIM THE MACHINE WAS IRREPARABLE. 

I THEN CALLED GE CONSUMER RELATIONS, AGAIN, AND WAS TOLD, AFTER ESCALATION TO [REDACTED], THAT THE MACHINE WAS OUT OF WARRANTY AND THEREFORE THEY WERE ONLY ABLE TO OFFER A FEEBLE DISCOUNT ON A NEW MACHINE. 

I HAVE TWO SMALL CHILDREN, ONE OF WHICH THE MACHINE COULD HAVE SERIOUSLY MAIMED OR KILLED FROM THE FORCE OF THE EXPLOSION, AND ACCEPTED THE NEW MACHINE OFFER TO MINIMIZE MY TIME WITHOUT A WASHING MACHINE. 

IN THE MEANTIME, I HAVE INCURRED INCONVENIENCE AND EXPENSES TAKING OUR LAUNDRY TO VARIOUS FAMILY AND FRIENDS' HOMES, BUT THE MORE DISTURBING ISSUE AT HAND IS HOW GE'S REPRESENTATIVES HAVE BEEN CHILLINGLY NONCHALANT ABOUT A FAIRLY YOUNG MACHINE THAT EXPLODED WITH PROFOUND FORCE MERE FEET FROM A BABY. [REDACTED] WAS UNABASHEDLY RESOLUTE IN 1) NOT ADMITTING ANY FAULT AND 2) REFUSING, MANY TIMES, TO COVER THE FULL COST OF A NEW MACHINE IN ANY SHAPE OR FORM. [REDACTED] THEN REFUSED TO ADMIT ANY FAULT, AND OFFERED ME A FEEBLE DISCOUNT ON A DOWNGRADED MODEL MACHINE (IT DOESN'T EVEN HAVE A WINDOW!), WHICH WE HAD TO ACCEPT GIVEN THAT WE NEEDED A WASHING MACHINE, AND WE HAD TO PAY $537.00 FOR. I REQUESTED COMPENSATION / A NEW UPGRADED MACHINE EQUAL TO OR BETTER THAN THE ONE THAT EXPLODED AND WAS VEHEMENTLY DENIED.
THE CONSUMER REPORTS THAT THE OUTSIDE GLASS ON THE OVEN RANDOMLY EXPLODED. IT WAS NOT TURNED ON. GLASS WAS EVERYWHERE.

12/14/2023:  THE CONSUMER?S FAMILY MEMBERS CAME HOME AND FOUND THAT THE HOUSE HAD A STRONG GAS ODOR.  THE RANGE HAD NOT BEEN USED THAT DAY.  THE CONSUMER CALLED THE GAS COMPANY, AND THEY DISPATCHED A TECHNICIAN, ON THAT DAY.  THE CONSUMER ALSO CONTACTED A LOCAL PLUMBER AND [REDACTED] SERVICE CENTER, WHO ALSO SENT OUT A TECHNICIAN.  THEREFORE, 3 DIFFERENT PEOPLE CAME OUT AND ALL OF THEM FOUND HIGH READINGS OF GAS, WHICH RESULTED FROM ISSUES WITH 2 OF THE BURNERS.  THE GAS TO THE COOKTOP WAS TURNED OFF.

THE FRONT RIGHT BURNER AND THE MIDDLE BURNER CAUSED THE PROBLEM.  THE [REDACTED] TECHNICIAN GAVE THE CONSUMER AN ESTIMATE OF OVER $700 FOR PARTS AND LABOR, TO REPAIR THE PRODUCT.   THE COOKTOP BLUE STEM BURNER, VALVES, IGNITER AND ORIFICE HOLDER, WERE FOUND TO BE DEFECTIVE.  FURTHERMORE, THE CONSUMER HAS OWNED THE RANGE LESS THAN 2 YEARS.

SHE ALSO NOTED THAT FOR THE PAST 2 WEEKS, SHE AND HER HUSBAND HAVE BEEN WAKING UP WITH HEADACHES.  SINCE THE GAS HAS BEEN TURNED OFF, THEY HAVE NOT EXPERIENCED ANY HEADACHES.

SHE CONTACTED THE MANUFACTURER, BUT THEY WERE NOT WILLING TO ASSIST HER AND SAID SHE WAS OUTSIDE THE WARRANTY PERIOD.
CONSUMER'S MINI SCENT DIFFUSER WAS DEFECTIVE RIGHT FROM START.  MANUFACTURER OFFERED EXCHANGE BUT STATED LONG TIMEFRAME.  CONSUMER WAS CHARGED RESTOCKING FEE.  NO INJURIES.

I WAITED A BIT THEN TURNED IT BACK ON AND INSTANTLY THE BURNING SMELL RETURNED, EVEN WORSE THIS TIME SO I TURNED IT OFF AND UNPLUGGED IT IMMEDIATELY. I AM AN ENGINEER SO I PROCEEDED TO UNSCREW THE BELT ACCESS DOOR BUT IT WOULD NOT COME OFF. MY HUSBAND TOOK A TURN AND APPLIED SOME FORCE AND THE BELT ACCESS DOOR FINALLY CAME OFF. AS AN ENGINEER WHO SPECIALIZES IN ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS AND DESIGN QUALITY I THOUGHT THERE IS NO WAY THIS HAS HAPPENED BEFORE OR BISSELL WOULD HAVE RECALLED THIS MODEL. TO MY ALARM I SAW ON WALMART'S WEBSITE NUMEROUS OTHER REVIEWS DESCRIBING THE SAME THING HAPPENING TO OTHER USERS OF THIS MODEL. THIS DEVICE MUST BE RECALLED UNTIL SUFFICIENT ROOT CAUSE ANALYSIS HAS BEEN COMPLETED WITH CORRECTIVE AND PREVENTATIVE ACTIONS PUT INTO PLACE. THIS DEVICE IS A HAZARD AND MAY RESULT IN SERIOUS INJURY.ÿIT WOULD BE ABSOLUTELY AWFUL IF A CONSUMER WERE INJURED CLEANING THEIR CARPETS. I PURCHASED A SAMSUNG DOUBLE OVEN MODEL:NX60A6751SS OVER THE SUMMER. THIS PARTICULAR OVEN HAS A REMOVABLE PIECE INSIDE THAT ALLOWS IT TO BE USED AS A DOUBLE OVEN OR SINGLE OVEN IF THE PIECE IS REMOVED. THE FIRST TIME I TRIED USING IT, THE FOOD I HAD IN THE TOP OVEN IMMEDIATELY STARTED TO BURN. LUCKILY I SMELLED IT RIGHT AWAY AND REMOVED IT. I ASSUMED I HAD DONE SOMETHING WRONG. THE NEXT TIME I USED IT, I PREHEATED THE OVEN AND PLACED A DISH INSIDE. NOT LONG AFTER, I WAS IN ANOTHER ROOM AND SMELLED SMOKE. THERE WAS A FIRE INSIDE MY OVEN! THANK GOD I SMELLED IT. I GOT IT PUT OUT BEFORE IT SPREAD. AFTER WEEKS AND WEEKS OF GOING THROUGH TROUBLE-SHOOTING AND SUCH, I REALIZED THAT THEY USE A BROILER TO HEAT THE TOP OVEN. EVEN IF YOU PUT THE OVEN ON "BAKE" IT USES A BROILER WHICH BURNS AND CAUSES FIRE TO ANYTHING YOU PLACE INSIDE. SAMSUNG SENDS REPAIR PEOPLE OUT TO FIX IT BUT THEY CANNOT DO ANYTHING BECAUSE THAT IS THE DESIGN OF THE OVEN. AFTER MULTIPLE SMALL FIRES, I CAN NOW ONLY USE THE TINY BOTTOM PORTION OF THE OVEN OR I RISK THE LIVES OF MY FAMILY. THIS PRODUCT SHOULD NOT EVER HAVE BEEN PLACED ON THE MARKET. I HAVE PERSONALLY READ HUNDREDS OF REVIEWS ONLINE OF THE SAME EXACT STORY AS MINE.

WHAT HAPPENED THAT MADE YOU WANT TO REPORT?
THE VOLUME OF CALLS ON IPHONE ARE DANGEROUSLY HIGH, EVEN WORSE FOR PEOPLE WITH HEARING DISABILITIES. IT OBVIOUS THE VOLUME RANGE IS NOT SET RIGHT SINCE WHEN THE VOLUME IS ONLY AT 50% THE QUALITY OF THE CALL IS VERY LOW, CHOPPY. HAVING THIS VOLUME RANGE SET SO HIGH COMPARE TO WHAT IS USED TO BE BEFORE IOS 16 MAKE IT HARD TO MAKE CALLS WITH HEADPHONES AND USE THE INTERNAL SPEAKER (NOT SPEAKER MODE). BEFORE IOS 16 THE IPHONE USED TO LET YOU LOWER THE VOLUME TO NOTHING, IT WAS NICE TO AVOID HOLD MUSIC DURING A CALL. THE MAX USED TO BE AROUND 60DB IT WAS MORE THEN LOUD ENOUGH THEN. NOW ITS JUST UNACCEPTABLE AND POOR QUAILTY.

APPLE IPHONE 13 PRO
WHO WAS USING THE PRODUCT(S)?
MYSELF

TO MAKE PHONE CALLS USING APPLE HEADPHONES AND WITH JUST THE INTERNAL SPEAKER TO EAR
WERE THERE ANY INJURIES THAT HAPPENED OR MAY HAVE HAPPENED WHILE USING THE PRODUCT?
YES, THE VOLUME OF THE CALL COULD NOT BE LOWERED ANY MORE AND RESULTED IN SHARP PAIN IN MY ONE EAR  THAT HAS HYPERACUSIS, MY OTHER EAR IS NORMAL AND EVEN THEN HAD MAJOR DISCOMFORT FROM THE MINIMUM CALL VOLUME THAT IS SET BY IOS TO HIGH.

THE SURPRISING RESULT IS THAT THE IMMEDIATELY FLOPS TO A FULLY OPEN POSITION INSTEAD OF LOWERING AT A CONTROLLED, STEADY PACE. THE DOOR, WHEN CLOSED IN THE OPERATING POSITION HAS NO POSITIVE LATCHING MECHANISM, IT IS JUST A FRICTION FIT DETENT TO STAY CLOSED.  THE FRICTION FIT DOES NOT HAVE TO BE FULLY CLOSED FOR THE DOOR TO REMAIN BASICALLY CLOSED.  THE DOOR CAN BE RELEASED FROM ITS BASICALLY CLOSED POSITION WITH LITTLE PULL EFFORT, WHICH WHEN THE COUNTERBALANCE DEVICE HAS FAILED IS SO SUDDEN THAT IT CANNOT BE STOPPED.  IT OCCURRED TO ME THAT THE APPARENTLY CLOSED DOOR COULD BE RELEASED BY A TODDLER'S PULL AND THE RELATIVELY HEAVY DOOR COULD TRAP A TODDLER BETWEEN THE DOOR AND THE FLOOR, POSSIBLY CRUSHING A SMALL CHILD'S HEAD. THE PRESSURE SWITCH ON MY FURNACE FAILED, SUCH THAT IT WOULD BE STUCK OPEN CIRCUIT EVEN WHEN THE DRAFT INDUCER WAS RUNNING. HOWEVER, THE FURNACE STILL IGNITED AND RAN THE BURNERS FOR ABOUT A MINUTE BEFORE SHUTTING DOWN. IT DID THIS A FEW MORE TIMES BEFORE LOCKING OUT. THE FURNACE SHOULD NOT HAVE IGNITED THE BURNERS AT ALL IN THIS CASE, BECAUSE HAD THE PRESSURE SWITCH BEEN OPEN BECAUSE OF A FAILURE OF THE DRAFT INDUCER OR AN OBSTRUCTION IN THE EXHAUST PIPE, IT COULD HAVE RELEASED COMBUSTION BYPRODUCTS SUCH AS CARBON MONOXIDE INTO THE LIVING SPACE.

ADDITIONALLY, AS A TROUBLESHOOTING STEP, I TEMPORARILY SHORT-CIRCUITED THE PRESSURE SWITCH, AND I DISCOVERED THAT A PRESSURE SWITCH STUCK CLOSED DOES NOT CAUSE A LOCKOUT. IF I LEAVE THE FURNACE POWERED ON AND REMOVE THE SHORT CIRCUIT, THE FURNACE STARTS OPERATION IMMEDIATELY. IN THIS CASE, THE FURNACE SHOULD HAVE RECOGNIZED A FAULTY PRESSURE SWITCH AND LOCKED OUT UNTIL RESET. IF INSTEAD THE PRESSURE SWITCH HAD FAILED BY BEING STUCK CLOSED, AND THEN SUDDENLY OPENED FOR SOME REASON, THE FURNACE COULD POSSIBLY OPERATE WITH AN UNRELIABLE PRESSURE SWITCH.

incident_description:
A FIRE ERUPTED IN MY KITCHENAID STOVE, WHICH WAS PURCHASED/INSTALLED IN NEW CONSTRUCTION IN THE LATE SUMMER OF 2016.  THE OVEN HAD BEEN ON PREHEAT MODE FOR APPROXIMATELY FIVE MINUTES WHEN A MUFFLED NOISE EMITTED AND SUDDENLY A LARGE ORANGE FLAME COULD BE SEEN THROUGH THE ENTIRE OVEN BOX WINDOW.  THERE WAS NO FOOD IN THE OVEN AT THE TIME, THE OVEN WAS CLEAN, AND IT WAS ON PRE-HEAT MODE FOR APPROXIMATELY FIVE MINUTES.  THE PRE-HEAT MODE HAD BEEN SET TO 400-DEGREES, BUT IT HAD ONLY ATTAINED APPROXIMATELY 300-DEGREES AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT.

MY WIFE IMMEDIATELY TURNED OFF POWER TO THE OVEN AT THE UNIT.  I WATCHED THE FLAME FOR A PERIOD OF TIME THAT PROBABLY WAS NO MORE THAN A MINUTE OR TWO.  WHEN I PERCEIVED THE FIRE WOULD NOT EXTINGUISH ITSELF, I READIED THE KITCHEN FIRE EXTINGUISHER AND PREPARED TO OPEN THE OVEN DOOR.  JUST AS I WAS ABOUT TO OPEN THE DOOR, THE FIRE SEEMED TO DIMINISH SO I WAITED.  EVENTUALLY, THE FLAME DISAPPEARED, BUT CONSIDERABLE SMOKE WAS EMITTING FROM THE REAR VENTS ON THE STOVE.  I TURNED ON THE OVERHEAD EXHAUST FAN, WHICH VENTS TO THE OUTSIDE, AND THAT KEPT THE SMOKE FROM FURTHER INFILTRATING THE HOUSE.  THE AIR THAT WAS VENTING WITH THE SMOKE WAS EXTREMELY HOT, SO I WAS UNSURE WHETHER THE FIRE WAS COMPLETELY OUT OR WAS CONTINUING TO BURN BEHIND OR UNDERNEATH THE OVEN.  EVENTUALLY THOUGH, BOTH THE AIR COOLED AND THE SMOKE SUBSIDED, SO I WAS CONFIDENT THAT IT WAS OUT.  I THEN WENT OUTSIDE AND TURNED OFF THE BREAKER TO THE OVEN, WHICH WAS ON A DEDICATED SWITCH.  THE BREAKER DID NOT SEEM TO ME TO HAVE TRIPPED.  

WHEN I WAS ABLE TO OPEN THE OVEN DOOR I SAW THAT THE FIRE HAD BURNED THROUGH THE STEEL PAN ON THE BOTTOM OF THE OVEN BOX AND LEFT A YELLOW RESIDUE TO THE RIGHT OF THE HOLE AS IF UNDER PRESSURE.  IF YOU LIKE, I HAVE PICTURES OF THE HOLE AND THIS RESIDUE AVAILABLE.

ON DECEMBER 12, 2018, MY HUSBAND AND I PURCHASED THROUGH LOWE?S A SAMSUNG REFRIGERATOR (SAMSUNG 24.52-CU FT SIDE-BY-SIDE REFRIGERATOR WITH ICE MAKER (STAINLESS STEEL); MODEL #RS25J500DSR), ALONG WITH A STOVETOP/OVEN, MICROWAVE/CONVECTION OVEN, WASHER, AND DRYER?ALL SAMSUNG?FOR OUR REMODEL. IN TOTAL, WE SPENT NEARLY $5,000 TO HAVE ALL MATCHING APPLIANCES. 

AFTER NOT EVEN FIVE YEARS OF USE, OUR REFRIGERATOR STARTED HAVING PROBLEMS. FIRST, IN THE SPRING OF 2023, THE ICE MAKER COMPLETELY QUIT WORKING. NO ICE WAS BEING PRODUCED AT ALL. THEN, ON OR ABOUT AUGUST 28, 2023, THE CONTROLS ON THE FRONT OF THE REFRIGERATOR SUDDENLY BEGAN FLASHING, SIGNALING AN ERROR CODE AND FAILED TO RESPOND TO TOUCH. I CONTACTED SAMSUNG VIA ONLINE MESSAGING ON OR ABOUT AUGUST 30, 2023. THE SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE REQUESTED INFORMATION FROM ME REGARDING THE PROBLEM AND EVEN COLLECTED A VIDEO FROM ME SHOWING THE CONTROL PANEL FLASHING LIGHTS. HE INSTRUCTED ME TO PERFORM A HARD RESET OF THE UNIT, WHICH I DID WITH NO RESULTING CHANGE. THE REPRESENTATIVE THEN ADVISED THAT THEY WOULD OPEN A TICKET AND REQUEST SERVICE FROM A LOCAL REPAIR TECHNICIAN. IN THE MEANTIME, WE CONTINUED TO ATTEMPT SEVERAL TIMES TO PERFORM A RESET ON THE UNIT, FOLLOWING THE STEPS SUGGESTED BY SAMSUNG. WE ALSO ENSURED THAT THE COILS AND FILTERS WERE CLEAN AND FREE OF DEBRIS. AT THAT TIME, THE REFRIGERATOR AND FREEZER BEGAN HAVING ISSUES COOLING ADEQUATELY AND HOLDING A CONSISTENT TEMPERATURE. WE HAVE VERIFIED THAT THE UNIT IS NOT COOLING TO AN OPTIMAL TEMPERATURE THROUGH THE USE OF STANDALONE THERMOMETERS. OBVIOUSLY, THIS IS VERY UNSAFE, AND WE HAVE LOST HUNDREDS OF DOLLARS OF GROCERIES BECAUSE OF THIS. THANKFULLY, NO ONE HAS GOTTEN ILL (YET). TO THIS DAY, ALL ISSUES WITH THE ICE MAKER, CONTROL BUTTONS, AND REFRIGERATOR TEMPERATURE PERSIST AND SAMSUNG REFUSES TO HELP WITH REPAIRS OR ACKNOWLEDGE THEIR DEFECTIVE PRODUCT.

ON SUNDAY, NOVEMBER 5, 2023, WHILE WE WERE HAVING BREAKFAST, WE HEARD A LARGE CRASH.  WHAT WE DISCOVERED WAS ONE OF THE GLASS SHOWER DOORS PURCHASED AND INSTALLED IN 2020 BY A PROFESSIONAL CONTRACTOR HAD TOTALLY "DISINTEGRATED".  GLASS WAS EVERYWHERE.  THERE WAS NO APPARENT REASON FOR THIS TO HAPPEN.  WE NEVER NOTICED ANY CHIPS, SCRATCHES OR DEFECTS IN THE GLASS.  THE SHOWER IS ONLY USED BY TWO PEOPLE, WE ARE THE ONLY RESIDENTS.  HAD SOMEONE BEEN IN THE BATHROOM AT THE TIME, THEY WOULD HAVE BEEN SERIOUSLY INJURED, NOT TO MENTION HAD THEY ACTUALLY BEEN IN THE SHOWER.
THE EXPLOSION OF GLASS DAMAGED THE FRAME ALONG THE BOTTOM.  (SMALL DENTS) THE TRACKS WERE FILLED WITH GLASS SHARDS AND FINE GLASS POWDER THAT HAD TO BE REMOVED.  GLASS HAD BLOWN ACROSS THE BATHROOM, UNDER THE SINK AND UNDER SHELVES.
THE CONTRACTOR PURCHASED THE MATERIALS, WHICH INCLUDED THE SHOWER DOORS, FROM HOME DEPOT AND THE DOORS HAVE "DELTA" LABELS ON THEM.  THE DOORS ARE SUPPOSED TO BE WARRANTED FOR 5 YEARS.  APPARENTLY, DELTA USES LIBERTY HARDWARE TO SUPPLY THE DOORS TO HOME DEPOT.  AFTER SOME DIFFICULTY CONTACTING LIBERTY, WE WERE ABLE TO MAKE CONTACT AND SUPPLY THE INFORMATION THEY REQUIRED TO MAKE A WARRANTY CLAIM ON NOVEMBER 9.  THE CLAIM WAS DENIED ON NOVEMBER 10TH CITING THAT A T-STRAP ON THE OPPOSITE SIDE HAD BEEN INSTALLED INCORRECTLY USING AN EXTRA SCREW.
ON NOVEMBER 13, WE WROTE BACK TO LIBERTY EXPLAINING THAT WHILE THE PARTICULAR T-STRAP IN QUESTION INDEED HAD AN EXTRA SCREW, IT WAS OF NO CONSEQUENCE SINCE THE EXPLODING DOOR WAS INSTALLED ON THE OPPOSITE SIDE AND DID NOT CONTACT THE SCREW IN QUESTION.  THIS WAS EVIDENCED BY THE PHOTOGRAPHS SHOWING THE MAJORITY OF GLASS ON THE FLOOR AND IN THE TRACK ON THE OPPOSITE SIDE OF THE SHOWER.  WE ASKED THAT THE MATTER BE ESCALATED TO MANAGEMENT.
ON NOVEMBER 30TH AFTER NO ANSWER, WE SENT A FINAL REQUEST FOR MANAGEMENT INTERVENTION.  ON DECEMBER 1, THE TECHNICAL PROVIDER REPLIED THAT THE MATTER WAS FORWARDED TO A MANAGER.  AS OF NOW THERE HAS BEEN NO RESPONSE.  BASED UPON OTHER SIMILAR COMPLAINTS REGARDING DELTA SHOWER DOORS LISTED ON YOUR SITE, I BELIEVE LIBERTY IS SUPPLYING A FAULTY PRODUCT AND HIDING BEHIND SUPPOSED INSTALLATION ERRORS.  AGAIN, SOMEONE COULD HAVE BEEN SERIOUSLY INJURED BY THE SHARDS PRODUCED WHEN THE GLASS LITERALLY EXPLODED HAD THE SHOWER ACTUALLY BEEN IN USE AT THE TIME.  PHOTOGRAPHS ARE AVAILABLE.

incident_description:
PER THE HOMEOWNER.- SHE LEFT THE RESIDENCE AROUND 1300 HOURS, RETURNED FOUR HOURS LATER, AND NOTICED THAT THE DISHWASHER WAS STILL RUNNING. SHE STATED THAT THE DISHWASHER HAD NEVER RUN FOR THIS LONG. SHE OPENED THE DISHWASHER DOOR AROUND 1730-1745 HOURS, AND SMOKE IMMEDIATELY CAME OUT. 
INITIALLY, THE SMOKE WAS GREY AND RAPIDLY TURNED BLACK. THE HOMEOWNER CALLED 911 AND CUT THE POWER AT THE MAIN ELECTRICAL PANEL.
THE DISHWASHER IS A GENERAL ELECTRIC (GE) MONOGRAM SERIES ZBD6880K00SS, SERIAL NUMBER RG70724B. THE HOMEOWNER STATED THAT THE HOUSE WAS BUILT IN 2014 AND THAT ALL OF THE DISHWASHERS IN THE HOUSING TRACT HAD THE SAME UNITS. A RECALL SEARCH ON THE GE WEBSITE HAS SEVERAL DISHWASHER RECALLS, BUT NONE AFTER 2006. THE SAME SEARCH ON THE CPSC WEBSITE RETURNED NO RESULTS.
ORIGIN AND CAUSE EXAMINATION
THE FIRE WAS CONTAINED INSIDE THE DISHWASHER'S DOOR. SOOT DEPOSITS WERE INSIDE THE DOOR FRAME (BETWEEN THE INNER AND OUTER SKINS) AND ON THE DOOR'S LOCKING MECHANISM. THE METAL AROUND THE LOCK MECHANISM WAS DISCOLORED AND MAY HAVE A CLEAN BURN FROM SOOT DEPOSITS BEING BURNED OFF OR HEATED TO A POINT WHERE THEY WERE CONSUMED. THE DOOR WAS NOT DISASSEMBLED, DAMAGED, OR ALTERED BY RESPONDING FIRE CREWS OR THE ON-SCENE FIRE INVESTIGATOR. 
FOR NFIRS REPORTING, THE FIRE IS CLASSIFIED AS ACCIDENTAL. WITHOUT DISASSEMBLY AND ANALYSIS BY AN ELECTRICAL ENGINEER, THE SPECIFIC IGNITION SEQUENCE OR CAUSE CANNOT BE DETERMINED. 
THE CONCERN IN THIS FIRE IS THAT THE INITIAL FAILURE SEQUENCE DID NOT SHUT DOWN THE DISHWASHER. THE HOMEOWNER SAID SHE TRIED TO TURN THE UNIT OFF AT THE CONTROL PANEL, BUT THE SYSTEM WAS NOT WORKING. THE INITIAL FAULT, OR THE SUBSEQUENT FIRE, DID NOT TURN OFF THE TIMER AND HEATING ELEMENT. HAD THE HOMEOWNER LEFT FOR AN EXTENDED PERIOD, A HIGH PROBABILITY EXISTS THAT THE FIRE IN THE DISHWASHER DOOR WOULD HAVE SPREAD TO THE COUNTER ABOVE THE DISHWASHER AND SUBSEQUENTLY INVOLVED THE KITCHEN OR THE ENTIRE HOME.

WHEN I OPERATED THE TOOL I QUICKLY REALIZED THAT THE CUTTING WHEEL ROTATES IN A DIRECTION OPPOSITE TO THE MARKINGS ON THE TOOL ITSELF AND OPPOSITE TO WHAT I FEEL IS THE INTUITIVE DIRECTION OF ROTATION. SPECIFICALLY, WHEN I PRESS THE FORWARD/REVERSE BUTTON TO THE RIGHT (IN THE DIRECTION INDICATED BY THE LETTER "F" ON THE HANDLE) THE CUTTING WHEEL ROTATES CLOCKWISE (AS SEEN BY AN OBSERVER LOOKING AT THE TOOL FROM ITS LEFT SIDE) WHICH IS OPPOSITE TO THE DIRECTION INDICATED BY THE "F" ARROW ON THE GUARD THAT SHIELDS THE USER FROM THE CUTTING WHEEL.  SPARKS GENERATED BY CUTTING METAL TRAVEL UPWARDS TOWARD THE OPERATOR. CONVERSELY, WHEN I PRESS THE BUTTON TO THE LEFT (IN THE DIRECTION INDICATED BY THE LETTER "R" ON THE HANDLE, THE CUTTING WHEEL ROTATES COUNTERCLOCKWISE WHICH IS OPPOSITE TO THE DIRECTION INDICATED BY THE "R" ARROW ON THE WHEEL GUARD. SPARKS GENERATED BY CUTTING METAL TRAVEL DOWNWARDS AWAY FROM THE OPERATOR. THIS DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE A MERE LABELING PROBLEM, BECAUSE THE DIRECTIONS OF THE "F" AND "R" ARROWS ON BOTH THE HANDLE AND ON THE WHEEL GUARD ARE AS SHOWN IN THE USERS' MANUAL.  I REPORTED THE PROBLEM TO DEWALT, AND THEIR CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVE SHIPPED ME A REPLACEMENT TOOL WHICH, BY ALL APPEARANCES, IS ALSO BRAND-NEW. HOWEVER THE REPLACEMENT TOOL SUFFERS FROM THE SAME PROBLEM AS THE ORIGINAL TOOL, I.E. IT ROTATES IN THE WRONG DIRECTION - IN REVERSE WHEN THE SWITCH IS SET TO FORWARD AND FORWARD WHEN THE SWITCH IS SET TO REVERSE. 

I BELIEVE THIS IS A SAFETY ISSUE FOR THE FOLLOWING REASONS:  THE CUTTING TOOL ROTATES AT 20,000 RPMS.  IT CAN CUT THROUGH METAL AND WOULD MAKE SHORT WORK OF FLESH AND BONES.  BECAUSE IT'S A ROTATING TOOL IT'S SUSCEPTIBLE TO KICKBACK OR KICK-FORWARD DEPENDING ON THE DIRECTION OF ROTATION. THEREFORE, THE TOOL NEEDS TO ROTATE IN A DIRECTION INDICATED BY THE MARKINGS ON THE TOOL SO THAT THE OPERATOR CAN BE KEENLY AWARE OF WHAT DIRECTION OF ROTATION TO EXPECT WHEN HE SQUEEZES THE TRIGGER.  THE FACT THAT "WRONG-DIRECTION" OPERATION OCCURRED ON TWO DIFFERENT TOOLS SELECTED AT RANDOM SUGGESTS TO ME THAT THE PROBLEM IS WIDESPREAD.  OBVIOUSLY, A USER COULD SIMPLY GET USED TO THE "WRONG DIRECTION" OPERATION, HOWEVER WITH A DANGEROUS TOOL SUCH AS THIS ONE, THE OPERATOR SHOULD NOT HAVE TO MAKE THAT KIND OF MENTAL ADJUSTMENT.

incident_description: I PURCHASED A WOLF RANGE R304 SERIAL # 17233022 ON APRIL 27, 2011.  THE FIRST OUTREACH WAS WITHIN MONTHS TO REPORT CLICKING OF THE IGNITERS DURING BURN.  AFTER SOME BACK AND FORTH, WOLF REPLACED THE SURFACE IGNITOR 15 MONTHS LATER 7/17/2013. I EXPRESSED GREAT CONCERN ABOUT THE INTEGRITY OF THE APPLIANCE. ASKED IF THERE WERE ANY REPORTED ISSUES FOR IGNITERS TO WHICH THEY ANSWERED NO.  THEN 6 MONTHS LATER 2/22/13 THE BROIL IGNITER REPORTED AND REPLACED. AGAIN SERVICED 11/5/2013. AGAIN 4/12/16. AGAIN 5-10-16. IGNITER ISSUE AGAIN 2019 FORCED THE FIRE DEPARTMENT TO DISCONNECT THE STOVE. THEY GAVE ME A PAPER FOR SERVICE TECHNICIAN TO COMPLETE AND RETURN TO THE STATION ONCE THE APPLIANCE HAD BEEN REPAIRED. SERVICE CAME OUT AND FOUND NOTHING AT THE TIME. HE RECONNECTED IT AND STATED HE DIDN'T NEED TO REPORT TO THE FIRE DEPARTMENT THAT IT WAS RECONNECTED. AGAIN 3/7/2022 IGNITER ISSUES REPORTED AND 3/12 FIRE DEPARTMENT DISCONNECTED IT. REPORTED TO WOLF AND SERVICE WAS SCHEDULED OVER A MONTH OUT SO I HAD ANOTHER COMPANY SERVICE 3/17/22.  THE TECHNICIAN FOUND A FAULTY BURNER FOR THE BROILER, THE OVEN AND THE MIDDLE CYLINDER FOR THE BOTTOM OF THE STOVE HAD A LARGE HOLE IN IT FROM A SMALL EXPLOSION.  I REPORTED THIS WITH PICTURES TO WOLF AND THEIR SOLUTION WAS TO OFFER A DISCOUNT FOR ME TO PURCHASE A NEW ONE.  I COMMUNICATED THAT SPENDING ANOTHER $5,000 FOR A STOVE THAT HAS NOT LIVED UP TO ITS EXPECTATIONS IS NOT AN OPTION. THEY REPORTED THAT SINCE THE UNIT WAS PURCHASED YEARS AGO THEY CANNOT DO ANYTHING MORE THAN OFFER A DISCOUNT FOR ANOTHER PURCHASE. I EXPLAINED AT THAT TIME THAT IT SEEMS LIKE THEY TRIED TO OUTLIVE THIS OPTION BY PROVIDING FREE REPAIRS.  A YEAR ALMOST TO THE DAY 3/11/2023 THE FIRE DEPARTMENT HAD TO COME OUT AGAIN AND DETACH THE STOVE. THE RANGE TOP IGNITER WAS CRACKLING AND POPPING WITHOUT IT BEING USED (NO FLAME). MY DAUGHTER THOUGHT SOMEONE WAS COOKING AND REALIZING THAT WAS NOT THE CASE SO SHE WALKED OVER TO SEE. THE SAME IGNITER REPEATED THE NOISE AND THEN POPPED "LIKE A MINI EXPLOSION" IN HER FACE.  FEARFUL, SHE CALLED THE FIRE DEPARTMENT AND THEY DETACHED IT FROM THE GAS WITH INSTRUCTIONS TO HAVE IT REPLACED BECAUSE OF ITS HISTORY POSING A SAFETY HAZARD.  THROUGH OUT THE LIFE OF THE STOVE I CONTINUOUSLY COMMUNICATED WITH WOLF EXPRESSING MY CONCERN AND DISCONTENT. THE FIRST SIGNS OF DEFECT I ASKED THEM TO REPLACE IT THINKING IT WAS A "LEMON". THEY ENCOURAGED ME IT WAS OK AND PROVIDED FREE SERVICE. THE STOVE STRUGGLES TO PERFORM ITS BASIC FUNCTIONS.  UPON MY RESEARCH, IGNITERS ARE SUPPOSED TO HAVE A LIFE EXPECTANCY OF 8 YEARS. OBVIOUSLY NOT THE CASE FOR THIS STOVE. I HAVE MULTIPLE CASE NUMBERS ON FILE AFTER THE WARRANTY EXPIRED FOR EACH EVENT WHERE WOLF PROVIDED SUPPORT. CASE[REDACTED].  I ALSO LEARNED ON 3/17/2023 THAT WOLF HAS A LONG HISTORY OF IGNITER ISSUES AND REPORTED RECALLS OF ANOTHER MODEL. I HAVE KEPT A RUNNING TAB OF INCIDENTS AND OUTREACH OVER THE YEARS INCLUDING EMAILS.

incident_description:
I WAS USING A DASH RAPID EGG COOKER THIS AFTERNOON TO MAKE HARD BOILED EGGS. THE RAPID EGG COOKER IS A SMALL APPLIANCE THAT PLUGS INTO THE WALL, BUT IT ALSO HAS A POWER BUTTON FOR TURNING THE APPLIANCE ON. I WAS USING THE PRODUCT FOR THE FIRST TIME AFTER IT HAD BEEN IN STORAGE FOR A FEW MONTHS, AND I PLACED IT ON MY KITCHEN COUNTER AND PLUGGED IT IN WHILE I MEASURED WATER AND ARRANGED THE EGGS IN THE ACCOMPANYING PLASTIC TRAY. BEFORE ADDING WATER TO THE PRODUCT'S HOT PLATE AND PRESSING THE POWER BUTTON, I NOTICED THAT THERE WAS A BIT OF DUST OR DEBRIS ON THE HOT PLATE'S SURFACE, AND SO I TRIED TO QUICKLY BRUSH IT OFF SO THAT IT WOULDN'T BURN ONTO THE SURFACE. HOWEVER, UNBEKNOWNST TO ME, THE PRODUCT WAS ALREADY SWITCHED ON, EVEN THOUGH I HAD NOT PRESSED THE POWER BUTTON, AND EVEN THOUGH THE HOT PLATE WAS DRY. I BURNED TWO FINGERS DUE TO TOUCHING THE HOT PLATE; LUCKILY, THE BURNS APPEAR TO BE MINOR, FIRST-DEGREE BURNS. I ONLY NOTICED AFTERWARD THAT THE RAPID EGG COOKER'S INDICATOR LIGHT WAS ON, AND FOUND THAT PRESSING THE POWER BUTTON DID NOTHING: IT'S NOT POSSIBLE TO TURN THE UNIT OFF WITHOUT EITHER UNPLUGGING IT OR ALLOWING IT TO BECOME HOT ENOUGH TO AUTOMATICALLY TURN OFF.

UPON CONSULTING THE MANUAL, I NOTICED THIS WARNING: "ATTENTION: DO NOT UNPLUG THE UNIT WHILE COOKING. IF YOU UNPLUG THE UNIT WHILE COOKING, IT WILL STILL BE TURNED ON WHEN YOU PLUG IT BACK IN. IF THE UNIT DOES NOT DETECT WATER ON THE HEATING PLATE, IT WILL AUTOMATICALLY SHUT OFF AND RESET ITSELF IN A FEW SECONDS." I DO NOT KNOW WHETHER THE HOT PLATE HAD BEEN UNPLUGGED WHILE IT WAS COOKING, BUT THIS EVENING, I TESTED A HUNCH. I DID MANAGE TO SUCCESSFULLY COOK EGGS AFTER THE INCIDENT, SO I HAD OBSERVED THE PRODUCT TURN OFF AFTER THE WATER BOILED OFF. SO, I TOOK THE UNPLUGGED, COLD COOKER, AND PRESSED THE POWER BUTTON. UPON PLUGGING THE COOKER IN, IT WAS ON. IT TOOK OVER A MINUTE - A FAR CRY FROM A FEW SECONDS - TO AUTOMATICALLY SHUT OFF. THIS MEANS THAT ANY ACCIDENTAL MOTION THAT COULD PUSH THE BUTTON (FOR INSTANCE, BUMPING INTO ANOTHER OBJECT WHILE THE PRODUCT IS IN STORAGE) CAN CAUSE THE COOKER TO START IMMEDIATELY WITHOUT INTENTIONALLY PRESSING THE POWER BUTTON, GREATLY INCREASING THE LIKELIHOOD OF THIS TYPE OF INJURY.

incident_description: OSTER TSSTTVCG02 OSTER 6 SLICE CONVECTION TOASTER OVEN WITH INTEGRATED BROIL RACK, BRUSHED STAINLESS STEEL. THE OVEN'S MECHANICAL TIMER DIAL (LOWER RIGHT KNOB) IS TURNED CLOCKWISE/ RIGHT TO SET FOR UP TO 60 MINUTES, TICKING AS IT TURNS BACK TO ZERO/OFF POSITION. OR THE DIAL CAN BE TURNED COUNTER-CLOCKWISE/LEFT TO "STAY ON". THE TIMER HAS FAILED SO THAT THE DIAL KEEPS TURNING COUNTER CLOCKWISE FROM ANY  SET TIME, RIGHT PAST ZERO/OFF, IN TO THE "STAY ON" POSITION.  IF MANUALLY TURNED COUNTERCLOCKWISE TO OFF, IT NO LONGER STAYS THERE AND REMAINS OFF, INSTEAD BEGINS TO TURN TOWARD THE "STAY ON" SETTING. LIKE OTHER POSTERS WITH SIMILAR MODELS, I FIRST THOUGHT THIS WAS MY ERROR UNTIL I OBSERVED AND TESTED.  THE OVEN CAN STAY ON PAST SET TIME, INDEFINITELY, AND CAN TURN ITSELF ON WITHOUT RESIDENTS KNOWING ABOUT IT. THE INDICATOR LIGHT IS OFF UNLESS HEATING TO SET TEMPERATURE, SO USER MAY NOT KNOW THE OVEN IS NOT ACTUALLY OFF.  THIS IS A FIRE AND SMOKE HAZARD IN ADDITION TO RUINING FOOD AND WASTING ELECTRICITY. IN PRIOR REPORTS FOR SIMILAR MODELS THE MAKER HAS STATED THIS IS NOT A DEFECT OR HAZARDOUS. IT CLEARLY IS A DESIGN FLAW AND AN UNTENDED HOT COUNTERTOP OVEN IS HAZARDOUS. THE OVEN SHOULD HAVE A FAILSAFE AGAINST THE TIMER DIAL MOVING FROM OR PAST THE OFF POSITION ON IT'S OWN.

OUR HOUSE WOULD HAVE BURNED DOWN IF MY WIFE AND I HAD NOT EXTINGUISHED THE FIRE. I WAS RIDING AN UNAGI MODEL ONE SCOOTER AT AROUND 8MPH, A CAR CAME OUT OF A BLIND DRIVEWAY ABOUT 30FT IN FRONT OF ME (PLENTY OF TIME TO STOP). THIS MAKES IT ESSENTIALLY USELESS FOR EMERGENCY BRAKING, AND EXTREMELY DANGEROUS. ALMOST ALL OTHER SCOOTERS ON THE MARKET HAVE PHYSICAL BRAKES -- DRUM OR HYDRAULIC. NOTE THAT THE UNAGI DOES HAVE A "FENDER" BRAKE, WHERE YOU CAN PRESS THE FENDER INTO THE REAR WHEEL FOR ADDITIONAL BRAKING, BUT THIS IS USELESS IN AN EMERGENCY SCENARIO SINCE YOU CAN'T SHIFT YOUR FOOT TO THE FENDER MID STOP.

product_1: Electric Ranges or Ovens (Excl Counter-top Ovens) (278)
incident_description:
I OWN A "30 IN. 5.4 CU. FT. INDUCTION ELECTRIC RANGE WITH SELF-CLEANING OVEN IN SMUDGE-PROOF STAINLESS STEEL WITH AIR FRY" BY FRIGIDAIRE THAT I PURCHASED IN MAY OF 2022. THE OVEN HAS BUTTONS TO OPERATE THE BURNERS RATHER THAN PHYSICAL SWITCHES. TWO TIMES NOW I HAVE HEARD BEEPING COMING FROM THE OVEN, AND WHEN I WENT INTO THE KITCHEN I HAVE FOUND THAT THE OVEN HAD REGISTERED INPUTS FROM THE BUTTONS DESPITE NO HUMAN OR ANIMAL BEING ANYWHERE NEAR THE STOVE. IN THE MOST RECENT INCIDENT, AT ROUGHLY 3AM ON MARCH 23, I WAS AWOKEN BY BEEPING COMING FROM MY KITCHEN, AND CAME DOWNSTAIRS TO FIND THAT THE OVEN HAD STARTED A ONE MINUTE TIMER AND TURNED THE OVEN LIGHT ON.

IN THE PREVIOUS INSTANCE, THE OVEN TURNED A BURNER ON TO THE HIGHEST POWER SETTING. (THERE HAPPENED TO BE A CLEAN NON-STICK FRYING PAN SITTING ON TOP OF THE OVEN WHEN THIS HAPPENED - I BELIEVE THE OVEN NEEDS TO DETECT THE PRESENCE OF A PAN IN ORDER TO TURN ON.) ON THE HIGHEST POWER SETTING AN EMPTY PAN WOULD VAPORIZE IT'S NON-STICK COATING WITHIN MINUTES (IF NOT SECONDS) AND PLAUSIBLY EVEN MELT THE PAN. FURTHERMORE, IF THE OVEN HAD OTHER FLAMMABLE ITEMS IN THE VICINITY WHEN THIS HAPPENED, IT'S EASY TO IMAGINE IT STARTING A FIRE. I AM WRITING REGARDING EXTENSIVE MOLD LURKING IN THE LIDS OF NESPRESSO'S NOMAD TRAVEL MUGS. 

MY HUSBAND AND I HAVE THREE NOMAD MUGS, TWO 18 OZ., AND ONE 13.5 OZ. ALL THREE MUGS HAVE POP DOWN TOPS WITH A CENTER THAT DEPRESSES ALLOWING FOR 360 DEGREE DRINKING. WE'VE HAD HEALTH ANNOYANCES AND COFFEE THAT WOULD CURDLE FOR ONE OF US, BUT NOT THE OTHER ON SOME DAYS. WHEN THE COFFEE CURDLED AGAIN WE DECIDED TO LOOK INTO THE LIDS. PRIOR TO THIS, WE HAVE FOLLOWED THE DIRECTIONS THAT REQUIRE ONLY THAT THE PRODUCT IS  SOAKED IF NOT WASHED IMMEDIATELY, AND IF PLACED IN THE DISHWASHER THAT THE LID IS WASHED IN THE "OPEN" POSITION SO WATER CAN FLOW THROUGH THE CUP. WHEN WE DISCOVERED MOLD IN ALL THREE CUPS, I FIRST PRESSURE WASHED TWO OF THE THREE CUPS (CUPS A AND B IN THE IMAGES) WITH THE SINK FAUCET BEFORE SOAKING IN WATER AND VINEGAR, THEN DISASSEMBLING DISASSEMBLING THE LID AS MUCH AS CAN BE DONE (WITH THE INNER "POP" LID AND OUTER SPRING REMOVED, BUT THE INNERMOST SPRING LOCKED INSIDE). EVEN THE PARTS OF THE INNER SPRING THAT LOOK CLEAN CAN BE LIFTED AND THEN SCRAPED BELOW WITH A TOOTHPICK TO REMOVE MORE RESIDUE. 

WHICH LEADS ME TO THIS:  THESE LIDS POSE A SERIOUS HEALTH RISK TO CONSUMERS; THEY MUST BE RECALLED.  THE INSTRUCTIONS DO NOT TELL CONSUMERS HOW TO EVEN CLEAN AS FAR AS I WAS ABLE TO; THEY WERE DISASSEMBLED BY FORCE AND WITHOUT DIRECTION. BUT MORE IMPORTANTLY, THEY ULTIMATELY CANNOT BE FULLY DISASSEMBLED. THAT INNER RING THAT CANNOT BE REMOVED, THAT IS TUCKED INTO THE CENTER RING, THAT EVERY OUNCE OF BEVERAGE PASSES THROUGH, HARBORS MOLD. THESE LIDS LOOK THIS WAY AFTER FOLLOWING THE RINSING AND DISHWASHING INSTRUCTIONS AS FAR AS ANY REASONABLE CONSUMER COULD BE EXPECTED TO DO. 

I CONTACTED NESPRESSO WHICH THEN HAD A SUPERVISOR CONTACT ME. I WAS PROVIDED THE FIRST OPTION OF AN IDENTICAL REPLACEMENT MUG, AN ALTERNATIVE MUG, AND THEN A REFUND. AFTER SEVERAL WEEKS THEY RESPONDED (CASE # [REDACTED]) AND AFTER 1 MONTH+ THEY PROVIDED ME WITH 5 BOWLS. IN JANUARY OF THIS YEAR (2023) I REALIZED THAT THE PLASTIC STRIP WHICH SEALS THE FEEDER ATTRACTS MOLD AND IS VERY SUSCEPTIBLE TO MOLD ACCUMULATION AND IMPOSSIBLE TO CLEAN (PICTURE AVAILABLE). I SMELLED THIS MOLD TO CONFIRM AND FOR SEVERAL DAYS I HAD BURNING LUNG PAIN, COUGHING, AND WHEEZING. I CONTACTED SUREFLAP SUPPORT [NOREPLY@SUREFLAP.CO.UK] ON 31 JAN 2023 USING THE SAME CASE NUMBER (CASE # [REDACTED]). ON 7 FEB 2023, THEY OFFERED TO SEND ME NEW LIDS. THEY NEVER SENT ME THE LIDS. ON 15 FEB 2023 AT [REDACTED], I CALLED THEIR CUSTOMER SERVICE AT 855.461.4740. [REDACTED] AGREED THAT MOLDS CAN FORM AND ASKED ME TO WASH MY FEEDERS. SINCE I WASH MY FEEDERS EVERY DAY AND THE MOLD IS NOT REMOVABLE, I ASKED TO BE TRANSFERRED TO A SUPERVISOR. [REDACTED] HUNG UP ON ME. I SENT AN EMAIL TO THE MANAGEMENT AND SOMEONE FROM THE UK CALLED ME ON 16 FEB 2023 IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT AND LEFT ME A VOICEMAIL THAT THEY WILL GET BACK TO ME IN A FEW DAYS AS OF TODAY, 2 MARCH 2023 NO ONE HAS CALLED ME BACK. I AM SHOCKED THAT THIS COMPANY HAS NO INTEREST IN ENSURING THAT THEIR PRODUCT IS NOT HARMFUL TO CATS AND HUMANS.  I BELIEVE THEY SHOULD WARN CONSUMERS THAT MOLD CAN BE FORMED ON THEIR PRODUCTS.
