incident_description:
I PURCHASED A WOLF CI304C/B INDUCTION COOKTOP. WHEN THIS UNIT WAS TURNED ON AND USED TO HEAT COOKWARE, THE COOKWARE EMITTED A SOUND THAT FORCED ANYONE IN THE ROOM TO LEAVE. THIS HAPPENED CONSISTENTLY, ON MULTIPLE OCCASIONS, WITH SEVERAL VARIETIES OF HIGHLY-REGARDED INDUCTION-COMPLIANT COOKWARE. USING A PHONE APP, THIS SOUND WAS MEASURED AT 19,688 HZ, WITH AN ESTIMATED INTENSITY OF AT LEAST 93 DB AT NORMAL WORKING DISTANCE. (GIVEN FREQUENCY ROLL-OFF, IT'S VERY PROBABLY HIGHER THAN THAT.) NOTE THAT 85 DB IS THE GENERALLY-RECOGNIZED LEVEL AT WHICH LONG-TERM EXPOSURE CAUSES HEARING LOSS.

SINCE MOST ADULTS CAN NO LONGER HEAR AT SUCH HIGH FREQUENCIES, THIS IS NOT A COMMONLY REPORTED ISSUE. THAT MEANS THIS PROBLEM IS SPECIFICALLY A DANGER TO CHILDREN WHICH WILL CAUSE HEARING LOSS, AND ONE WHICH THEIR PARENTS GENERALLY CANNOT PERCEIVE!

I'M AN ELECTRICAL ENGINEER, AND I SPENT NINE YEARS OF MY CAREER DESIGNING SWITCHING POWER ELECTRONICS SIMILAR TO INDUCTION COOKTOPS IN MANY RESPECTS. THE PANS RING, JUST BY THE NATURE OF INDUCTION HEATING. HOWEVER, THE FACT THAT THE COOKTOP OPERATES WITHIN THE HUMAN HEARING RANGE IS A DESIGN CHOICE BY THE MANUFACTURER, AND IT IS THIS DESIGN CHOICE THAT IS AT THE ROOT OF THIS HAZARD. NO SPECIFIC UNIT DEFECT WOULD HAVE THIS RESULT; THE ENTIRE PRODUCT LINE IS A THREAT TO PUBLIC SAFETY. AS A LICENSED ENGINEER, I AM ETHICALLY OBLIGATED TO REPORT THREATS TO PUBLIC SAFETY. SO HERE I AM.

I REPORTED THIS PROBLEM TO WOLF, WHO SAID, "WE DO NOT HAVE ACTUAL DECIBEL RATINGS FOR MOST OF OUR PRODUCTS BUT I ASSURE YOU WE ARE WITHIN MARKET STANDARDS." THIS IMPLIES THE PROBLEM IS LIKELY TO EXIST ACROSS THE ENTIRE INDUSTRY, NOT JUST WITHIN WOLF. A FRIEND MEASURED THE SOUND FROM A [REDACTED] INDUCTION COOKTOP AND FOUND THE SAME ~20 KHZ SPIKE, THOUGH WE WERE NOT ABLE TO EFFECTIVELY COMPARE DECIBEL MEASUREMENTS.

product_1: All Terrain Vehicles (Four Wheels/off Road Only) (3286)
incident_description:
AT 4PM, SUNDAY, APRIL 16, 2023, I DROVE MY ATV OUT OF THE GARAGE TO HOSE OFF SOME DIRT THAT HAD ACCUMULATED ON THE SNOWPLOW BLADE.  THE ATV WAS ON A TRICKLE CHARGER, STORED INDOORS IN A HEATED GARAGE AT ALL TIMES.  I DROVE IT APPROX. 50 FT. AND PARKED IT ON A GRAVEL AREA ADJACENT TO MY CONCRETE DRIVEWAY.  I HOSED OFF THE BLADE IN A MINUTE OR SO.  I THEN HOSED OFF THE UNDERSIDE OF ALL FOUR FENDERS.  THIS WHOLE PROCESS TOOK 3-4 MINUTES.  THE ENGINE WAS COLD, THE IGNITION WAS SHUT OFF AND THE TRANSMISSION WAS IN PARK.  THE ENGINE WAS CLEAN--NO ACCUMULATED OIL, GREASE, OR GRIME AND NO GASOLINE LEAKS OR ODORS.  THE GAS TANK HAD BEEN FILLED A COUPLE WEEKS PRIOR AND IT WAS NEARLY FULL.  THE SEATS, ENGINE, RUNNING BOARDS, AND UTILITY BOXES WERE ALL CLEAN SO I DID NOT SPRAY ANY OF THOSE AREAS.

AFTER CLEANING THE ATV, I LEFT IT IN PLACE.  I THEN BACKED MY TRUCK ONTO THE CONCRETE DRIVEWAY AND GAVE IT A QUICK RINSE WITH THE HOSE.  THIS ONLY TOOK 3-4 MINUTES.  I FINISHED ALL THIS ABOUT 4:10 PM.  AT THIS POINT, I LOOKED AT MY ATV AND THOUGHT:  "I NEED TO PUT THAT IN THE GARAGE".  MY PICKUP WAS BLOCKING ACCESS TO THE GARAGE STALL WHERE I PARK MY ATV SO I DECIDED IT COULD WAIT UNTIL MORNING.  IT HAD BEEN A WARM DAY AND THE WEATHER WAS GOOD.

ABOUT 9:20 PM I WAS IN THE KITCHEN READING WHEN I HEARD A MUFFLED BOOM THAT SOUNDED LIKE DISTANT THUNDER.  IT HAD BEEN A RATHER WARM DAY SO I THOUGHT THUNDER WAS CERTAINLY POSSIBLE.  I DID NOT GIVE IT ANOTHER THOUGHT.  ABOUT A MINUTE OR TWO LATER I HEARD A SECOND BOOM. AGAIN, I GAVE IT NO THOUGHT.  THEN ANOTHER MINUTE OR TWO WENT BY AND I HEARD A THIRD BOOM.  AT THIS POINT THINGS WEREN'T SOUNDING QUITE RIGHT SO I WENT OUT MY FRONT DOOR (NORTH SIDE).  IT WAS PITCH DARK AND CALM, NO WIND.  I THOUGHT:  "WHAT IS GOING ON?".  I THEN HEARD A NOISE ON THE EAST SIDE OF MY HOUSE AT THE LOWER LEVEL IN THE GARAGE/DRIVEWAY AREA.  AS I NEARED THE NE CORNER OF MY HOUSE, I NOTICED A LARGE ORANGE GLOW.  WHEN I CLEARED THE CORNER, I SAW THAT MY POLARIS ATV WAS COMPLETELY ENGULFED IN A MASSIVE INFERNO! EVERYTHING WAS ON FIRE.  THE SEATS, GAS TANK, FENDERS, UTILITY BOX, RUNNING BOARDS, DASH WERE ALL GONE.  ALL I SAW WAS A BURNING FRAME AND 4 TIRES ON FIRE.  MY ATV WAS COMPLETELY GONE SO I RAN DOWN TO SAVE MY PICKUP TRUCK WHICH WAS ONLY 10 FEET FROM THE BURNING ATV.  I QUICKLY MOVED THE TRUCK AND THEN GRABBED THE GARDEN HOSE, KNOCKING DOWN THE FIRE IN A FEW MINUTES.

AT THIS POINT I FULLY EXPECTED FIRE TRUCKS TO COME ROLLING UP WITH LIGHTS FLASHING AND SIRENS BLARING.  THAT NEVER HAPPENED, WHICH WAS PUZZLING.  THERE WAS VEHICLE TRAFFIC ON [REDACTED] APPROXIMATELY 1/3 MI. BELOW MY HOUSE.  MY HOUSE SITS ON TOP OF A PROMINENT HILL AND THAT FIRE COULD BEEN SEEN CLEARLY IN MANY DIRECTIONS FROM 2-3 MILES AWAY.  NOBODY CALLED.  THE NEXT DAY I CHECKED WITH THE POLICE/SHERIFF'S OFFICE TO REVIEW THEIR 911 LOGS FROM SUNDAY NIGHT.  THEY CHECKED FROM 8:30 PM TO 10:30 PM AND NOBODY CALLED IN THIS FIRE.  I LIVE IN THE COUNTRY ABOUT 7 1/2 MI. FROM TOWN SO IT IS VERY DARK AND QUIET WHERE I LIVE.   A FIRE OF THIS SIZE COULD NOT HAVE BEEN MISSED, BUT SURPRISINGLY NOBODY CALLED IT IN.



IN RETROSPECT, THE THREE MUFFLED "BOOMS" I THOUGHT WAS THUNDER WERE MOST LIKELY MY TIRES AND GAS TANK EXPLODING.  I SUSPECT THE FIRE HAD BEEN KICKING UP FOR AT LEAST 3-4 MIN. (5?) BEFORE I WENT OUTSIDE AND DISCOVERED THE INFERNO.

AFTER I KNOCKED DOWN THE FIRE, I NOTICED THAT THE FABRIC COVER ON MY BOAT HAD MELTED IN THE BOW AREA.  THE BOAT WAS ONLY 5 FEET FROM THE ATV.   I NEVER OBSERVED ANY OPEN FLAMES ON THE BOAT COVER.  I STAYED UP UNTIL 11:30 TO MAKE SURE A NEW FIRE DIDN?T REIGNITE.  EARLY THE FOLLOWING MORNING, I INSPECTED MY [REDACTED] PICKUP FOR ANY FIRE/HEAT DAMAGE.  I NOTICED THAT A SMALL, PLASTIC TRIM PIECE ON THE RIGHT FRONT QUARTER PANEL HAD WARPED AND BUCKLED DUE TO THE HEAT.  I TOOK SEVERAL PICTURES OF THE TRUCK, BOAT, AND ATV ON MY [REDACTED].

I AM A 47 YEAR OLD MOTHER OF TWO TEENAGE SONS, AND I HAVE BEEN DOING LAUNDRY FOR CLOSE TO 30 YEARS SINCE BEING SHOWN BY MY MOTHER.  FOR MUCH OF THAT TIME, I USED THE OLD FASHIONED TOP LOAD AGITATOR MACHINES, AND I WAS ALWAYS IN THE HABIT OF USING A FULL CAPFUL OF LAUNDRY DETERGENT FOR EACH LARGE LOAD (I GUESS IT TURNS OUT THAT WE HAVE BEEN HEAVY-HANDED WHEN ADDING DETERGENT).

ABOUT 8-9 YEARS AGO, MY HUSBAND AND I PURCHASED A NEW [REDACTED] WASHER WITHOUT THE AGITATOR.  THE INSTRUCTION MANUAL WAS QUITE VAGUE, BUT I DIDN'T THINK ANYTHING OF IT AT THE TIME, AND I CONTINUED TO FOLLOW MY SAME LAUNDRY ROUTINE.

   I DIDN'T THINK TO READ THE BACK OF THE DETERGENT BOTTLES ALL THESE YEARS BECAUSE THEIR OVERALL APPEARANCE NEVER CHANGED...I DID THE LAUNDRY AS I ALWAYS HAD DONE OUT OF HABIT, UNAWARE THAT I WAS USING TOO MUCH DETERGENT.  THE CAP SIZES NEVER CHANGED, EITHER.  WHY ARE THEY STILL SO LARGE?  WHY ARE DETERGENTS BEING CONCENTRATED (NEVER REALIZED BEFORE) WITHOUT WARNING CUSTOMERS?  

I BECAME EXTREMELY WORRIED A FEW MONTHS AGO WHEN I READ AN ARTICLE THAT TIDE WOULD BE BANNED IN CERTAIN STATES DUE TO PRESENCE OF CARCINOGENS IN ITS DETERGENT?  WHAT?  I HAD BEEN USING IT FOR YEARS...I THOUGHT LAUNDRY DETERGENT WAS SAFE...IT WAS RECOMMENDED BY [REDACTED] TO USE IN THEIR WASHERS.

IT IS THEN THAT I REALIZED THAT THE DEFAULT CYCLE ON THE [REDACTED] MACHINE I HAD FOR THE LAST 8-9 YEARS ONLY DID A SINGLE 1-2 MINUTE RINSE SPRAY.  EVEN IF I HADN'T USED SO MUCH DETERGENT ALL THESE YEARS, I STILL DON'T KNOW HOW IT COULD RINSE ALL THE CLOTHES PROPERLY.  IRONICALLY, ALL THESE YEARS, MY FAMILY AND I NEVER NOTICED.  OUR CLOTHES WERE SPUN DRY SO WELL THAT I NEVER SAW RESIDUE, AND I THINK WE GOT USED TO THE STRONG DETERGENT SMELL.  OF COURSE, THOUGH, AS I RECENTLY STARTED HAND RINSING SOME OF OUR CLOTHING, I NOTICED ALL THE DETERGENT BUILT UP IN THE WATER.

IT SCARES ME BEYOND BELIEF THAT MY SONS HAVE BEEN WEARING CHEMICALLY LADEN CLOTHING SINCE THEY WERE LITTLE.  MY HUSBAND HAS A BACKGROUND IN BIOCHEMISTRY AND TELLS ME NOT TOO WORRY SINCE MY FAMILY NEVER HAD ANY ACUTE REACTIONS, BUT I AM TERRIFIED TO HEAR THAT LAUNDRY DETERGENT COULD HAVE POTENTIAL CARCINOGENS.  WHAT IF THERE ARE LONG-TERM HEALTH EFFECTS FROM YEARS OF WEARING CLOTHES WITH LAUNDRY DETERGENT BUILD-UP?
 
I HAVE ACTUALLY REACHED OUT TO [REDACTED] AND TIDE ABOUT MY CONCERNS AND WAITING TO HEAR BACK FROM [REDACTED].  I ALSO WANTED TO REACH OUT TO AN ORGANIZATION ABOUT THIS MATTER BECAUSE I THINK LAUNDRY DETERGENT USE, ESPECIALLY IN HE MACHINES NEEDS TO BE "REGULATED".  THE INSTRUCTIONS ON BOTTLES AND MACHINES ARE VAGUE.  WHAT EXACTLY DEFINES A LARGE LOAD OF LAUNDRY?  IT'S REALLY MORE ABOUT THE WATER AMOUNT THAN THE LAUNDRY SIZE, ISN'T IT?  WHY IS IT THAT WASHING MACHINE MANUFACTURERS DO NOT WARN CUSTOMERS THAT THEY NEED TO USE SO MUCH LESS DETERGENT IN THESE HIGH EFFICIENCY MACHINES?  PRECISE INSTRUCTIONS AND WARNINGS ARE DESPERATELY NEEDED.  THERE SHOULD BE CLEARLY LABELED WARNINGS AND DETAILED INSTRUCTIONS FROM BOTH THE DETERGENT AND WASHER MANUFACTURERS ON THE AMOUNT OF DETERGENT TO USE BASED ON THE RATIO OF WATER PER MAKE AND MODEL OF MACHINE.  THERE IS TOO MUCH OF A DISCREPANCY RIGHT NOW.

I KNOW THIS MAY NOT SEEM LIKE A BIG DEAL,  BUT I'M SURE MANY CONSUMERS ARE USING TOO MUCH LAUNDRY DETERGENT.  IT'S BAD ENOUGH TO BE SENDING EXCESS DETERGENT DOWN THE DRAIN (NOT TO MENTION THE $), BUT WHAT ABOUT POTENTIAL SAFETY ISSUES?  THE DATE BELOW IS AN ESTIMATION OF WHEN I FINALLY BECAME AWARE OF THE FACT THAT I WAS USING TOO MUCH LAUNDRY DETERGENT FOR THE PAST 8-9 YEARS.

I BELIEVE THAT LAUNDRY DETERGENT MANUFACTURERS SHOULD BE REQUIRED TO CHANGE THEIR BOTTLES AND ESPECIALLY CAP SIZES...THEY SHOULD NOT BE SO BIG BECAUSE I THINK IT "ENCOURAGES" CONSUMERS TO OVERPOUR.  THE CAPS ALSO SHOULD HAVE CLEARLY LABELED MEASURING MARKS (HORIZONTAL AROUND CAP IN A DIFFERENT COLOR) SO THAT CONSUMERS CAN ACTUALLY SEE THEM.  ALSO, HE WASHERS SHOULD HAVE WARNINGS ON THEIR MACHINES TO INFORM CUSTOMERS TO USE A MINIMAL AMOUNT OF DETERGENT (ESPECIALLY FOR THOSE OF US WHO HAD BEEN USING TRADITIONAL TOP-LOADS).  FURTHERMORE, I THINK BOTH WASHER AND DETERGENT MANUFACTURERS NEED TO PROVIDE SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS ON THE DOSE OF DETERGENT TO USE PER AMOUNT OF WATER IN MACHINE (NOT JUST A SUBJECTIVE LOAD SIZE).  THERE NEEDS TO BE A PARTICULAR DILUTION RATIO, AND THAT SHOULD BE WRITTEN IN THE CONSUMER MANUAL OF THE WASHER...OR BETTER YET, ON THE MACHINE, IN ADDITION TO THE DETERGENT BOTTLES.  THANK YOU.

incident_description:
A PRODUCT THAT I PURCHASED AS AN OUTDOOR ACTIVITY FOR MY CHILDREN, WHICH IS CLEARLY A PRODUCT MARKETED AND INTENDED FOR USE AS A CHILDRENS OUTDOOR RECREATION, ACTUALLY FAILED WHILE BEING USED AS INTENDED BY MY THREE YOUNGER SONS AND RESULTED IN SIGNIFICANT INJURIES BEING SUFFERED BY EACH OF THEM. THE PRODUCT: NINJA WARRIOR OBSTACLE COURSE KIT  IS MANUFACTURED BY GASKY KIDS AND WAS PURCHASED UNDER MY ACCOUNT THROUGH AMAZON.COM IN APRIL OF 2021 FOR A TOTAL PRICE OF $177.70. THE KIT IS DESIGNED TO BE SUSPENDED BETWEEN TWO ANCHOR POINTS, WE USED TWO TREES ROUGHLY 30FT APART, AND ONCE THE PROPER TENSION IS ACHIEVED THROUGH A LARGE RATCHET STYLE PIECE OF HARDWARE AFFIXED TO ONE END OF THE STRAP, SPECIAL CLIPS AND HANGERS CAN BE ATTACHED TO THE LINE FROM WHICH VARIOUS ROPE AND SWING STYLE TOYS CAN BE ADDED DOWN THE LENGTH OF THE LINE. THE GOAL IS TO ATTEMPT TO MAKE AN OBSTACLE COURSE FROM ONE SIDE TO THE OTHER AND CROSS THE OBSTACLES WITHOUT TOUCHING THE BOTTOM STRAP OR GROUND. 
AS STATED, MY THREE YOUNGEST BOYS, AGES 4, 6, AND 11 AND HAVE A COMBINED WEIGHT OF 110 LBS TOTAL, WERE PLAYING ON THE LINE AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT AND WERE ALL SPACED APART ON DIFFERENT ATTACHMENTS AS WELL, WHEN THE 2" MAIN OVERHEAD STRAP EXPERIENCED COMPLETE PRODUCT FAILURE AND WAS TORN APART ALMOST EXACTLY IN TWO EQUAL PIECES. AS SUCH, THE FAILURE CAUSED EVERYTHING ATTACHED TO THE LINE, INCLUDING CHILDREN, TO SUDDENLY, AND VIOLENTLY BE DROPPED TO THE GROUND FROM HEIGHTS RANGING FROM 3FT. TO 8.5FT FROM THE GROUND. NOT ONLY WAS MY 4YR OLD SLAMMED INTO THE CLOSEST TREE TRUNK BEFORE FALLING OFF OF THE SWING HE WAS SITTING ON, MY OLDEST WAS CLIMBING THE CARGO NET ATTACHMENT THAT WAS INCLUDED WITH THE SET AND HAD JUST REACHED THE TOP WHEN THE LINE BROKE, RESULTING IN HIM PRACTICALLY FACE PLANTING INTO THE GROUND FROM THE HIGHEST POSSIBLE POINT OF THIS SET UP. AS FOR MY 6YR OLD, HE WAS ON A TRAPEZE BAR AT THE TIME AND SUFFERED A BUSTED LIP THANKS TO HIS KNEE BEING PLUNGED INTO HIS FACE AFTER HITTING THE GROUND UNEXPECTEDLY. I AM THANKFUL THAT NONE OF THEM WERE STRUCK DIRECTLY BY THAT TOP STRAP WHEN IT CAME APART AND ALL OF THE TENSION SUDDENLY UNLEASHED IN OPPOSITE DIRECTIONS.
FORTUNATELY NONE OF THE INJURIES WERE SERIOUS ENOUGH TO REQUIRE A TRIP TO THE ER AND ALL THREE BOYS WERE BANDAGED AND ICED FOR MOST OF THE AFTERNOON. ONCE I HAD MY BABIES CARED FOR, MY ATTENTION TURNED TO FIGURING OUT WHAT HAPPENED AND WHY THIS PRODUCT FAILED. MY HUSBAND AND I BOTH LOOKED OVER THE ENTIRE STRAP, WHICH WAS NOW IN TWO SEPERATE PARTS, AND DISCOVERED THAT THE MATERIAL APPEARED TO BE FRAYED SIGNIFICANTLY AT THE POINT WHERE THE FAILURE OCCURED. WE ALSO NOTICED THAT EACH PLACE ON THE STRAP WHERE THE SUPPLIED HANGERS WERE ATTACHED, THE STRAP SHOWED SIGNS OF WEARING AND STRESS UNDERNEATH THE CLIPS WHERE IT COULD NOT BE SEEN UNLESS THE HANGER WAS MOVED TO A DIFFERENT POSITION ON THE LINE. ACCORDING TO THE INFORMATION PROVIDED BY THE SELLER OF THIS PRODUCT, THE MAXIMUM SPAN OF THE NINJA LINE WAS 50FT BETWEEN ANCHOR POINTS AND WAS RATED TO HOLD A WORKING LOAD OF 1,320 LBS. CLEARLY, THESE PARAMENTERS AND LIMITS WERE NOT EVEN CLOSE TO BEING EXCEDED AS MY CONFIGURATION WAS, AT MOST, 30 FEET IN LENGTH BETWEEN THE TWO TREES AND THE THREE VICTIMS UTILIZING IT WERE WELL BELOW THE INDICATED WEIGHT LIMIT BY A DIFFERENCE OF 1,200LBS.
FOLLOWING MY VISUAL ASSESSMENT OF THE DAMAGED PRODUCT, I CONTACTED THE CUSTOMER SERVICE DEPARTMENT AT AMAZON.COM TO REPORT THE PRODUCT FAILURE AND TO INQUIRE IF THERE WAS ANY TYPE OF WARRANTY PROVIDED BY THE SELLER IN SUCH INSTANCES OF A PRODUCT DESIGN FAILURE. I WAS ADVISED BY AMAZON SUPPORT STAFF THAT I WOULD NEED TO CONTACT THE SELLER DIRECTLY TO ADDRESS SUCH CONCERNS AND THAT THE TIME PERIOD OF 30 DAYS HAD OBVIOUSLY LAPSED BETWEEN PURCHASE DATE AND PRODUCT FAILURE, WHICH ULTIMATELY CLEARED AMAZON OF ANY RESPONSIBILITIES IN THIS MATTER. ADITIONALLY, I WAS ALSO INFORMED THAT THE SELLER LISTED FOR THIS PURCHASE RECENTLY CLOSED ITS ACCOUNT WITH AMAZON AND NO LONGER SELLS ANY PRODUCTS THROUGH AMAZON'S PLATFORM, AND IN ACCORDANCE WITH THEIR COMPANY POLICY, AMAZON NO LONGER LISTS OR STORES ANY CONTACT INFORMATION FOR THE SELLER IN THEIR SYSTEM. FRUSTRATED, BUT DETERMINED,  I WAS ABLE TO TRACK DOWN SOME OF THE SELLER'S COMPANY DETAILS, INCLUDING THE NEW WEBSITE BEING USED TO MARKET THEIR PRODUCTS, INCLUDING THE NINJA KIT THAT I PURCHASED AND WAS ALMOST RESPONSIBLE FOR SEVERELY INJURING MY FAMILY. AMAZON DID, HOWEVER, MAKE AN ATTEMPT TO CONTACT THE SELLER, ON MY BEHALF, USING THE ACCOUNT INFORMATION PROVIDED WITHIN MY PURCHASE ORDER FOR THE PRODUCT. UNFORTUNATELY,  I HAVE NOT RECEIVED ANY CORRESPONDENCE FROM THE SELLER, THE MANUFACTURER, NOR AMAZON UPPER MANAGEMENT, DESPITE MY REPEATED WEEKLY CONNECTIONS TO AMAZON'S CUSTOMER SUPPORT ATTEMPTING TO RECEIVE ANY UPDATES ON WHAT I BELIEVE TO  BE A DANGEROUS AND DEFECTIVE PRODUCT THAT IS OBVIOUSLY STILL BEING SOLD AND UTILIZED BY CHILDREN, WHO ARE POSSIBLY BEING PLACED IN A DANGEROUS AND HARMFUL SITUATION, ONLY MADE WORSE BY THE FACT THAT THE COMPANY RESPONSIBLE FOR THE PRODUCT CONTINUES TO DISMISS AND REFUSE TO RESPOND OR ACKNOWLEDGE ANY REPORTS INDICATING SUCH A FAILURE OCCURED.

incident_description:
ON APRIL 28, 2023, AT AROUND 7:05PM EST, I HEATED MY TOP FRIGIDAIRE/ELECTROLUX DOUBLE OVEN TO 400 TO COOK MY PARTIALLY FROZEN BARRAMUNDI FISH FOR 30-35 MINUTES.  AROUND 7:45PM, I TURNED THE OVEN OFF AND I WAS SITTING ON MY COUCH ABOUT 13 FEET AWAY SPEAKING WITH A FRIEND ON THE PHONE WHEN WE BOTH HEARD AN EXPLOSION, AND I LOOKED OVER TOWARD MY KITCHEN.  I STOOD UP TO GET A BETTER VIEW AND SAW THE BROWN COLORED GLASS ON THE FLOOR.  I WAS BAREFOOT SO I CAREFULLY WALKED AROUND THE FAMILY ROOM CHAIR AND FOUND GLASS WITHIN 6 FEET OF WHERE I WAS SITTING.  I TOOK THE FIRST PICTURE AT 9:05PM FROM A DISTANCE, DUE TO BEING BAREFOOT, AND YOU CAN SEE THAT THE CONTROL/DISPLAY PANEL SHOWED EVERYTHING WAS OFF AND ONLY THE TIME WAS SHOWING.  THE EXTERNAL SMOKE COLORED GLASS WAS SHATTERED.  ONCE I HAD MY SHOES ON, I STARTED WALKING AROUND THE KITCHEN AND I STOOD BACK BECAUSE I KEPT HEARING THE EXTERNAL SHATTERED GLASS POPPING AS PIECES WERE STILL BEING PROJECTED ONTO THE FLOOR.  I SLOWLY APPROACHED FROM THE LEFT SIDE AND FELT THE OVEN?S INTACT CLEAR GLASS AND IT WAS VERY HOT.  I THEN TRIED TO PARTIALLY OPEN THE OVEN DOOR TO LET THE HEAT OUT, BUT THE SHATTERED GLASS KEPT POPPING AND FALLING SO I RE-CLOSED THE DOOR.  I BELIEVE OPENING THE OVEN DOOR HELPED RELIEVE ANY PRESSURE HEAT IN THE OVEN AND THE ISLAND SAVED ME FROM GETTING HIT BY THE FLYING GLASS.  MEDIUM TO VERY SMALL PIECES OF DIFFERENT SHAPED GLASS WERE TO THE LEFT AND RIGHT OF THE OVEN, UP ON THE COUNTERTOPS, THROWN BEHIND THE BUTTER DISH, AND DOWN THE HALLWAY TO THE SPARE BEDROOMS, IN ADDITION TO BEING BEHIND THE FAMILY ROOM CHAIR NEAR ME.
  
I TEXTED OUR APARTMENT MANAGER, [REDACTED], AND CALLED THEIR EMERGENCY LINE WHERE [REDACTED], THE MAINTENANCE LEAD, AND [REDACTED] SHOWED UP AROUND 10:00PM.  THE CLEAR GLASS ON THE OVEN WAS STILL HOT EVEN THOUGH THE OVEN SHOWED TURNED OFF AND JUST HAD THE TIME.  THEY STARTED CLEANING UP THE GLASS AND AROUND 11:00PM THE CLEAR GLASS WAS STILL WARM TO THE TOUCH.  [REDACTED] THEN DECIDED TO SHUT OFF THE APARTMENT?S MAIN CIRCUIT PANEL TO THE OVEN.
  
I HAVE READ THERE HAVE BEEN UNEXPLAINED EXPLOSIONS OF GLASS AND THAT THE CONSUMER PRODUCT SAFETY COMMISSION SAYS SAFETY GLASS SHOULD BREAK INTO NUGGETS AND NOT SHARDS.  BUT THESE PIECES OF GLASS WERE VERY SHARP, AND SOME WERE LIKE ARROWS.  I HAVE TWO INDEPENDENT WITNESSES THAT HELP CLEAN UP THE BROKEN GLASS AND THEY HAD TO DOUBLE UP THE GARBAGE BAG DUE TO THE SHARPNESS OF THE GLASS PIECES.  IF I HAD BEEN HIT BY THESE SHARDS OF GLASS AT THE HIGH VELOCITY SPEED IT BROKE, THEY WOULD HAVE PUNCTURED MY EYES, SLICED MY FACE, SKIN, NECK ETC.  I WAS BY MYSELF, AND I COULD HAVE BEEN BADLY INJURED AND UNCONSCIOUS BLEEDING FOR AN HOUR AND HALF BEFORE MY HUSBAND CAME HOME FROM WORK. 
   
THE DISPLAY/CONTROL PANEL DID NOT SHOW ANYTHING WAS TURNED ON, YET THIS OVEN GOT EXTREMELY HOT TO CAUSE THIS EXPLOSION AND RAPID VELOCITY SPRAY OF THE EXTERNAL SMOKE COLORED GLASS.  I READ HOW THEY BLAME PEOPLE FOR RESTING THINGS ON THE GLASS, OR DAMAGING THE GLASS, OR A CRACK IN THE GLASS THAT GREW, OR HOW PEOPLE USE THE GLASS TO SHUT THE METAL SHELVES AND MORE.  THIS WAS NOT THE CASE WITH OUR OVEN. NONE OF THOSE REASONS EXPLAIN WHY THE OVEN WAS HOT FOR THREE HOURS WHILE SHOWING IT WAS OFF.  PLUS, THIS IS A TWO-YEAR-OLD OVEN, BARELY USED, BY TWO VERY METICULOUS AND CAREFUL ADULTS WITH NO CHILDREN IN THE APARTMENT.
 
SOMETHING NEEDS TO BE DONE BEFORE SOMEONE IS HURT.  IF I HAD BEEN WITHIN RANGE AND THE ISLAND HADN?T BEEN BETWEEN THE OVEN AND I, THEN THOSE HIGH VELOCITY SHARDS OF GLASS WOULD HAVE EASILY PLACED ME IN THE HOSPITAL.  GLASS POWERFUL ENOUGH WHERE IT SHOOTS OUT, SMASHES AGAINST AN ISLAND, AND THEN FLIES 4 FEET TO THE SIDES BEHIND BUTTER DISHES, AGAINST BACKSPLASHES, AND DOWN HALLWAYS IS POWERFUL ENOUGH TO HAVE CAUSED SEVERE DAMAGE TO ME OR SOMEONE ELSE.  

I CAN SEND PICTURES IF YOU CAN TELL ME HOW/WHERE I CAN DO THAT, IF THIS SYSTEM DOESN'T ALLOW ME TO UPLOAD THEM. 
 
I LOOK FORWARD TO A REPLY ON HOW THESE OVENS THAT ARE TURNING ON/STAYING ON WITH NO NOTICE, HEATING UP SO INTENSE THAT IT CAUSES GLASS TO BECOME HIGH VELOCITY PROJECTILES OR POTENTIALLY CAN CAUSE A FIRE ARE GOING TO BE CORRECTED.

IT ALSO SUGGESTS THAT THE SAFETY SWITCH IS NOT IN SERIES WITH THE POWER SOURCE AND THEY ARE USING THE SWITCH AS A SENSOR INPUT TO SOME SOFTWARE TO TURN THE MOTOR ON AND OFF.

WE PURCHASED A MR. HEATER VENT FREE 30,000 BTU RADIANT PROPANE HEATER (BUNDLE WITH FAN BLOWER) IN NOVEMBER 2022.  TWICE IT HAS HAD A PROPANE BUILDUP WHICH CAUSE A FLARE-UP WHERE IT BASICALLY WENT "WHOOMPH" AND BLEW A BALL OF FLAME 2 TO 3 FEET OUT OF THE FRONT OF THE UNIT.  THIS ONLY OCCURRED WHEN THE THERMOSTAT WAS SET TO UNDER THEIR 2 SETTING (SETTINGS RANGE FROM 1 TO 5).  THIS IS USED IN OUR LIVING ROOM AS A SECONDARY HEAT SOURCE.  ALSO NOTE THAT IN OUR CORRESPONDENCE WITH ENERCO GROUP (THE MANUFACTURER), THEY STATE THE CAUSE WAS SETTING THE THERMOSTAT TO SETTINGS THAT WERE NOT WHOLE NUMBERS (I.E. SETTING THE THERMOSTAT EXACTLY ON 1, 2, 3, 4, OR 5).  NOTHING IN THE OWNERS OR OPERATORS MANUAL INDICATES THE THERMOSTAT MUST ONLY BE SET ON WHOLE NUMBERS.  IN OUR CORRESPONDENCE, ENERCO STATES THAT EVEN THOUGH THEY KNOW THIS DANGEROUS FLARE-UP PROBLEM CAN BE CAUSED WHEN THE THERMOSTAT IS NOT LEFT EXACTLY ON A WHOLE NUMBER SETTING, THEY HAVE NO PLANS TO REPLACE THE THERMOSTAT WITH ONE THAT SIMPLY CLICKS INTO PLACE ON THE WHOLE NUMBERS.  ENERCO STATES THEY ARE CHANGING THEIR OWNERS MANUAL TO INDICATE THE THERMOSTAT SHOULD BE SET ON WHOLE NUMBERS ONLY, BUT, AGAIN, THEY ARE STILL GOING TO LEAVE THE THERMOSTAT THAT ALLOWS UNSAFE SETTINGS.  THIS SHOULD BE A SIMPLE HARDWARE FIX - REPLACE THE THERMOSTAT WITH ONE THAT DOES NOT CAUSE AN EXPLOSION OF FLAME.  ENERCO REFUSES.  NO ONE WAS INJURED DURING THE TIMES THIS OCCURRED, BUT THE POSSIBILITY IS VERY HIGH IF SOMEONE HAD BEEN IN THE WRONG PLACE AT THE WRONG TIME.  I WILL ATTACH COPIES OF ALL EMAIL CORRESPONDENCE WITH ENERCO REPRESENTATIVES, BOTH THEIR EMAILS AND MINE.

WE PURCHASED THE PETRATOOLS HD4000 FOUR-GALLON BATTERY OPERATED SPRAYER.  THIS PRODUCT IS SOLD BY MULTIPLE RESELLERS INCLUDING {REDACTED] AMAZON [REDACTED]

THIS SPRAYER HAS AN INTERNAL 12-VOLT BATTERY THAT REQUIRES OCCASIONALLY CHARGED.  THE SPRAYER COMES WITH A PROPRIETARY A/C TO DC CHARGER THAT IS TO BE USED TO CHARGE THE SPRAYER.  THIS CHARGER IS MAKE IN CHINA AND DOES NOT CONFORM TO THE US ELECTRICAL CODE BECAUSE OF THE INSTALLATION OF AN A/C PLUG ON THE DC SIDE OF THE CHARGER.

THE PROBLEM IS THAT THE ELECTRICAL RECEPTACLE ON THE SPRAYER IS A 3-PIN SHROUD FEMALE (IEC C13) AC RECEPTACLE.  THIS AC RECEPTACLE ALLOWS FOR THE INSERTION OF AC PLUGS INTO THIS RECEPTACLE THAT IS ONLY DESIGNED TO HAVE DC POWER.

AFTER SEVERAL MONTHS OF NON-USE, WE USED A STANDARD AC CORD WITH THIS SPRAYER RECEPTACLE.  THIS RESULTED IN OVERHEATING AND MELTING OF INTERNAL CIRCUITRY AND POSED A FIRE HAZARD BUT LUCKILY THE CIRCUIT BREAKER TRIPPED PRIOR TO STARTING A FIRE.

THIS IS A SAFETY PROBLEM AND COULD RESULT IN SIGNIFICANT DAMAGE, FIRE, INJURY OR DEATH.  THIS PRODUCT SHOULD BE RECALLED AND REDESIGNED TO COMPLY WITH THE US ELECTRIC CODE AND SAFETY REQUIREMENT.

RE: LOCHINVAR GAS BOILER MODEL #KHN110 SERIAL #1551102312187 . 2 INCIDENTS OF GAS LEAKS. 
1ST WAS FEB 16, 2022: CALLED MY PLUMBER/INSTALLER TO REPORT MY BOILER NOT WORKING AND WITH A STRONG SMELL OF GAS. WAS TOLD THE GAS WAS LEAKING - THE VALVE HAD LOOSENED AND THAT IT IS NOW FIXED. 
2ND TIME OCT 13, 2022: VERY STRONG SMELL OF GAS. I CALLED [REDACTED] TO REPORT A GAS LEAK. TECHNICIAN CAME TO THE HOUSE WITH A DETECTOR TO DETERMINE THE SOURCE OF THE LEAK. THE DETECTOR WENT CRAZY WHEN NEAR THE BOILER, WHICH CLEARLY INDICATED THE LEAK WAS COMING FROM THE BOILER. I TOOK A VIDEO WITH THE TECHNICIAN AND HAD HIM EXPLAIN VERBALLY AND VISUALLY SHOW THE EXACT LOCATION OF THE LEAK INSIDE THE BOILER. HE IMMEDIATELY TURNED OFF THE GAS SOURCE, AND TAGGED THE BOILER. HE ADVISED ME TO OPEN WINDOWS AND NOT IGNITE ANY FLAMES, ETC. UNTIL THE BOILER COULD BE SERVICED. I IMMEDIATELY CALLED MY PLUMBER/INSTALLER WHO CAME AND IT WAS DETERMINED THAT THE GAS VALVE WAS INDEED FAULTY, AND IT WAS THEN REPLACED.
FOR MONTHS I HAD BEEN EXPERIENCING SEVERE HEADACHES, NAUSEA, TIREDNESS THROUGHOUT THE SUMMER OF 2022. AS AUTUMN AND COOLER TEMPERATURES APPROACHED, I NORMALLY CLOSED ALL MY WINDOWS AND TURNED ON MY HEAT. WITH WINDOWS CLOSED THE SMELL OF GAS NOW BECAME OBVIOUS. I HAD NOT PREVIOUSLY ASSOCIATED MY SYMPTOMS WITH THE PRESENCE OF GAS, BUT NOW BELIEVE THE LEAKING GAS WAS THE CAUSE. SINCE THE REPLACEMENT OF THE FAULTY GAS VALVE, MY SYMPTOMS BEGAN TO DISAPPEAR. 
I HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO REACH ANYONE AT LOCHINVAR - THEY SIMPLY DO NOT ANSWER THE PHONE.
THIS IS A DANGEROUS SITUATION AND COULD HAVE RESULTED IN SERIOUS DAMAGE TO MY HOME, AND MORE SO, TO MY OWN WELL BEING!
LOCHINVAR HAS NUMEROUS REGISTERED RECALLS PERTAINING TO FAULTY GAS VALVES CAUSING DANGEROUS GAS LEAKS, BUT MY BOILER MODEL IS NOT ONE LISTED AS A RECALLED MODEL. IT SHOULD BE!

THIS CONSUMER HAS OWNED A PITT BOSS PLATINUM BRUNSWICK WOOD PELLET VERTICAL SMOKER (SMOKER) SINCE
DECEMBER 14, 2021. IT HAS BEEN USED AN ESTIMATED 12-15 TIMES SINCE PURCHASE. ON TWO OF THESE USES,
THE SMOKER HAD A SERIOUS "BURN BACK" (DESCRIBED BELOW), WHICH RESULTED IN AN UNREASONABLE RISK OF INJURY
TO THE CONSUMER AND DAMAGE TO PERSONAL PROPERTY. ADDITIONALLY, THROUGHOUT THE APPROXIMATE 1.5-YEAR
OWNERSHIP PERIOD, THERE HAVE BEEN REPEATED STRUCTURAL AND MECHANICAL ISSUES. ALL MECHANICAL AND
SAFETY ISSUES WERE PROMPTLY REPORTED TO THE COMPANY VIA THE COMPANY'S CUSTOMER SERVICE GROUP.
IN GENERAL, THE COMPANY WAS RESPONSIVE TO THE MECHANICAL ISSUES, PROVIDING ADVICE AND NUMEROUS
REPLACEMENT PARTS (INCLUDING CONTROLLER BOARD, IGNITOR, TEMPERATURE PROBES, AND MORE). AN ESTIMATED
20-30 HOURS OF LABOR WERE REQUIRED BY THE CONSUMER TO REPLACE PARTS AND MAKE NEEDED REPAIRS
(INCLUDING A MALFUNCTIONING DOOR LATCH AND SEAL). THE COMPANY WAS NOT HOWEVER, PARTICULARLY HELPFUL IN
DEALING WITH THE BURN-BACK FIRE ISSUES (DISCUSSED BELOW). FRUSTRATED WITH THE SCOPE, FREQUENCY, AND
SEVERITY OF PROBLEMS, THE CONSUMER ATTEMPTED TO RETURN THE SMOKER TO WALMART (WHERE IT WAS
PURCHASED). THE RETURN WAS DENIED AS IT WAS BEYOND THE DESIGNATED 3 (6?) MONTH RETURN PERIOD.
THE SMOKER IS FUELED BY WOOD PELLETS, WHICH ARE STORED IN A LARGE HOPPER LOCATED ON THE BACK OF THE
SMOKER. THE PELLETS ARE TRANSPORTED INTERNALLY VIA A METAL AUGER. IT FEEDS A SMALL FIRE CHAMBER WHERE
THE PELLETS ARE IGNITED PRODUCING HEAT AND SMOKE. THE BURN BACK HAZARD IS CAUSED WHEN THE WOOD
PELLETS CONTAINED INSIDE THE AUGER BECOME SO HOT THEY SMOLDER AND EVENTUALLY COMBUST. IN A MATTER OF
MINUTES, THE FIRE CAN BACK UP THE AUGER INTO THE STORAGE HOPPER CAUSING A SERIOUS FIRE RISK.
THE CONSUMER WAS ABLE TO EXTINGUISH THE TWO FIRES EXPERIENCED BY: REMOVING THE PELLETS IN THE HOPPER
(WHICH IS VERY DIFFICULT AND DANGEROUS WHILE BURNING), UNPLUGGING THE INTERNAL COOLING FAN (WHICH WAS
MAKING THE FIRE WORSE), AND CUTTING OFF ALL OTHER OUTSIDE AIR SOURCES. THE CONSUMER WAS NOT INJURED IN
EITHER INCIDENT, NOR WAS PERSONAL PROPERTY SIGNIFICANTLY DAMAGED. HOWEVER, THIS OUTCOME WAS ONLY DUE
TO THE FACT THE CONSUMER WAS STILL NEAR THE SMOKER WHEN BOTH FIRES STARED AND ABLE TO RESPONDED QUICKLY
TO REMOVE FUEL AND AIR SUPPLY.

THE CONSUMER HAS FOLLOWED ALL STATED MAINTENANCE AND OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES FOUND IN COMPANY
MANUAL/GUIDES, ON LINE, AND FROM CUSTOMER SERVICE REPRESENTATIVES. THE SMOKER WAS THOROUGHLY CLEANED
AFTER EACH USE, THE WOOD PELLETS WERE SIFTED TO REMOVE EXCESSIVE "DUST" (WHICH CAN CLOG THE AUGER), AND
ALL START-UP AND SHUT-DOWN PROCEDURES WERE CAREFULLY FOLLOWED. DURING THE MOST RECENT CALL WITH
COMPANY REPRESENTATIVES (5/29/23), IT WAS ALSO SUGGESTED THAT " ... PERHAPS THE CONSUMER(I) JUST NEEDED
TO INVEST IN A BETTER MORE EXPENSIVE SMOKER." (THE INITIAL COST OF THIS SMOKER WAS $579. 79.)
THE BURN BACK HAZARD WITH THIS SMOKER APPEARS TO BE PERVASIVE. THE CONSUMER CONDUCTED A VERY BRIEF
SEARCH OF THE PITT BOSS INTERNET FORUM (KEY WORDS AUGER FIRE, BACK FIRE) AND FOUND 8 POSTS IN THE RECENT PAST 
ON SIMILAR PROBLEMS. SOME POSTS INDICATED SERIOUS OUTCOMES. THE CONSUMER STRONGLY ENCOURAGES
CPSC INVESTIGATORS TO REVIEW THIS AND OTHER PERTINENT INFORMATION (INCLUDED PAST RECORDED CALLS BETWEEN
THE CONSUMER AND PITT BOSS REPRESENTATIVES).

THE CONSUMER WAS TOLD BY PITT BOSS CUSTOMER SERVICE STAFF (5/29/23) THAT THE PLATINUM BRUNSWICK
SMOKER IS STILL BEING SOLD, AND THAT IT IS NOT UNDER ANY TYPE RECALL. THE CONSUMER BELIEVES THIS SMOKER
UNIT IS POORLY DESIGNED AND MANUFACTURED AS EVIDENCED BY THE NUMEROUS FAILURES EXPERIENCED. MORE
IMPORTANTLY, THE CONSUMER BELIEVES THIS SMOKER REPRESENTS A VERY REAL, ONGOING, AND UNREASONABLE RISK

I WAS OPERATING A HUSQVARNA SELF-PROPELLED RIDE ON MOWER, MODEL NUMBER TS242XD WITH A 2 CYLINDER KAWASAKI GASOLINE ENGINE, MOWING 6 INCH GRASS ON A SLIGHT GRADE OF 2-3 DEGREES. THE MOWER SUDDENLY STOPPED MOVING FORWARD, DESPITE THE ENGINE RUNNING AND THE FORWARD DRIVE PEDAL BEING DEPRESSED. THE MOWER STARTED ROLLING BACKWARD, BUT WOULD NOT STOP DESPITE THE BRAKE PEDAL BEING FULLY DEPRESSED. THE MOWER BLADES WERE STILL RUNNING. THE FORWARD DRIVE PEDAL BRIEFLY WORKED AGAIN, AND I WAS ABLE TO DRIVE THE MOWER ANOTHER 60-70 FEET, AND IT STOPPED WORKING COMPLETELY. THE BRAKE PEDAL ALSO STOPPED WORKING COMPLETELY. THE MACHINE WAS PURCHASED IN 2021; I'VE OWNED IT FOR ABOUT 25 MONTHS. I'M A 55 YEAR OLD ADULT MALE WHO HAS OPERATED VARIOUS RIDE-ON LAWNMOWERS FOR OVER 40 YEARS; MY WEIGHT IS ABOUT 200 POUNDS. 

AFTER REMOVING THE MOWER DECK, INSPECTING THE UNDER SIDE OF THE MOWER, AND CONSULTING WITH THE RETAIL DEALER WHO SOLD ME THE PRODUCT, THE LEFT REAR METAL FRAME FAILED DUE TO WHAT APPEARS TO BE SEPARATION OF THE FRAME'S SPOT WELDS, DEFORMATION OF THE FRAME (THE METAL FRAME WAS VISIBLY BENT NEAR THE LEFT REAR WHEEL), AND VISIBLE BENDING OF THE LEFT SUPPORT BRACKET ATTACKED TO THE HYDROSTATIC DRIVE. THERE ALSO APPEARS TO BE SOME VISIBLE FRAME DEFORMATION NEAR THE RIGHT REAL WHEEL AS WELL. EFFECTIVELY THE HYDROSTATIC DRIVE HAD MOVED CLOSER TO THE ENGINE, RESULTING IN A LOSS OF DRIVE BELT TENSION AND FAILURE OF BOTH FORWARD AND REVERSE DRIVE PEDALS TO FUNCTION, AND TOTAL LOSS OF BRAKING POWER DUE TO SLACK IN THE LINKAGE TO THE HYDROSTATIC DRIVE'S BUILT-IN BRAKE.

COMPLETE LOSS OF ALL OPERATOR AND BRAKING POWER ON A 567 POUND MOWER CREATED AN EXTREMELY DANGEROUS AND POTENTIALLY LETHAL SITUATION. WHILE NO ONE WAS INJURED, THE MACHINE DID ROLL BACKWARDS UNCONTROLLED ON THE SLIGHT GRADE UNTIL IT REACHED LEVEL GROUND. THE MANUFACTURER RATES THE MACHINE FOR UP SLOPE/DOWN SLOPE OPERATION UP TO SLOPES OF 15 DEGREES. HAD THIS FAILURE OCCURRED ON A SLOPE OF EVEN 7 OR 8 DEGREES, THE MOWER WOULD HAVE ACCELERATED TO DANGEROUS SPEEDS IN SECONDS. THERE IS NO OTHER WAY TO BRAKE OR SLOW THE MOWER. INJURY OR DEATH TO ADULTS OR CHILDREN FROM ROTATING MOWER BLADES, COLLISION, OR ROLLOVER OF THE 567 POUND MOWER COULD EASILY RESULT. 

WHEN I DISCUSSED THE SPECIFICS OF THE INCIDENT WITH THE RETAILER/REPAIR SHOP WHO SOLD ME THE MOWER 2 YEARS AGO, AND EXAMINED A NEW MOWER FOR COMPARISON TO DETERMINE WHAT WAS CAUSING THE MALFUNCTION, I REMARKED THAT THE HYDROSTATIC DRIVE APPEARED TO HAVE MOVED TOWARDS THE FRONT OF THE MOWER. THE REAR WHEELS WERE CLOSER TO THE MOWER DECK SUPPORTS ON MY MOWER THAN THE BRAND NEW MOWER. THE MECHANIC THEN TOLD ME TO EXAMINE THE METAL FRAME JUST ABOVE THE REAR WHEELS TO SEE OF THE FRAME METAL HAD FAILED. THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT I CONFIRMED VISUALLY ON MY MOWER. IT WAS CLEAR FROM THE MECHANIC'S COMMENTS THAT THIS IS AN ISSUE THIS PARTICULAR MOWER HAD BEFORE. HAVING OPERATED SIMILAR MOWERS WITH ALMOST IDENTICAL DESIGNS ([REDACTED]), THE METAL FRAME ON THE HUSQVARNA MODEL TS242XD DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE AS HEAVY A GAUGE, AND THERE IS OTHER VISIBLE BENDING ON THE FRAME WHERE THE GRASS CATCHER BAG ASSEMBLY ATTACHES AS WELL. THIS INDICATED POOR ENGINEERING. THIS IS A PART OF THE MACHINE THAT SHOULD NEVER FAIL, GIVEN THE EXTREMELY DANGEROUS SITUATION OF HAVING A 567 POUND VEHICLE MOVING WITHOUT AND PROPULSION OR BRAKING CONTROL.

THE MACHINE AND FRAME ARE STILL UNDER WARRANTY, BUT THE DESIGN FLAW OF AN INSUFFICIENTLY ENGINEERED FRAME UNABLE TO WITHSTAND NORMAL USE WITHOUT FAILING MEANS THE POTENTIAL HAZARD IS JUST WAITING TO HAPPEN AGAIN EVEN IF THIS MACHINE IS REPAIRED, UNLESS IT IS REPAIRED WITH A STRONGER, UPGRADES FRAME. THERE ARE ALSO THOUSANDS OF OTHER IDENTICAL MOWERS OUT THERE WITH THE SAME DESIGN FLAW THAT COULD RESULT IN INJURY OR DEATH IF THE REAR FRAME FAILS IN THE SAME MANNER.

JUST TO BE CLEAR, THIS MOWER HAS ONLY BEEN USED UNDER NORMAL OPERATING CONDITIONS SPECIFIED WITHIN THE MANUFACTURER'S OPERATING MANUALS, RESIDENTIAL USE ONLY. IT HAS ABOUT 127 HOURS OF RUN TIME INDICATED ON THE CONTROL PANEL. IT HAS BEEN GARAGED, AND MAINTAINED ACCORDING TO THE MANUFACTURER'S TIMETABLE FOR OIL CHANGES AND OTHER ADJUSTMENTS.

I WAS COOKING A HAMBURGER PATTY IN THE SMALL PAN ON MY KITCHEN STOVETOP ON MAY 11, 2023 AT ABOUT 5PM WHEN ALL OF A SUDDEN SOMETHING LIKE A GUNSHOT WENT OFF IN MY KITCHEN. I MOVED THE PAN OFF THE BURNER AND TOOK THE SPLATTER GUARD OFF THE PAN, REMOVED THE HAMBURGER, LOOKED TO SEE IF I COULD SEE ANY METAL ON IT AND FOUND NONE ON THE OUTSIDE OF THE BURGER, SO I PUT IT IN THE MICRO TO CONTINUE COOKING.      I HAVE NEVER HAD COOKWARE BULLETS FLYING AROUND MY KITCHEN! I AM SO GLAD THAT MY DAUGHTER HAD NOT BEEN COOKING THAT DAY OR THAT I DID NOT GET HURT. NOW I HAVE TO REPLACE ALL OF THESE PANS, AS WELL, SINCE I AM AFRAID OF THIS HAPPENING AGAIN. RE:  SAFETY LATCHES ON PICNIC COOLER LIDS

DEAR SIRS AND MADAMS:

I AM A RETIRED ENGINEER WHO WORKED FOR 23 YEARS FOR THE [REDACTED] IN WICHITA KANSAS.  DURING MY TIME WITH [REDACTED](1967 THROUGH 1989) I WAS FOR SEVERAL YEARS THE DESIGN ENGINEERING MANAGER FOR THERMAL PRODUCTS (PICNIC COOLERS AND JUGS).  IN THE EARLY 1970?S THE CPSC BROUGHT TO OUR ATTENTION THAT THE LATCHES ON ALL OF OUR LARGER PICNIC COOLERS COULD BE HAZARDOUS TO SMALL CHILDREN.  YOU MIGHT REMEMBER THAT AT ONE TIME OLD, DISCARDED REFRIGERATORS WITH SOLID LATCHING DOORS BECAME DEADLY TRAPS FOR KIDS.  VIEW YOUR PUBLICATION [REDACTED].

[REDACTED] HAD A PROVEN, RELIABLE LATCHING SYSTEM FOR ALL OF OUR METAL BODIED, PLASTIC LINED COOLERS.  WE HAD NEVER HAD ONE INSTANCE WHERE A KID WAS INJURED BY A [REDACTED]COOLER AND I PERSONALLY DID NOT BELIEVE THAT WE POSED A RISK.  WE WERE BUILDING MORE THAN A MILLION OF THIS TYPE OF PRODUCT ANNUALLY.  I TRAVELED TO DC TO GO BEFORE THE CPSC AND WAS INSTRUCTED THAT WE MUST CHANGE OUR DESIGNS.  

ON RETURNING FROM THE DC MEETING I RAN A TEST WITH SMALLER CHILDREN.  WE FIXED SEVERAL SIZES OF COOLERS SO THAT EACH ONE HAD BREATHING HOLES AND PUT THESE IN A ROOM WITH YOUNGER CHILDREN AND, WITHOUT INSTRUCTIONS (TO THE KIDS), SIMPLY WATCHED.  THE KIDS WERE YOUNG ENOUGH THAT THE LATCHES WERE A MYSTERY BUT THEY EVENTUALLY UNLOCKED THE COOLERS.  THE KIDS SOON OPENED THE LIDS AND GOT IN THE COOLERS.  THE KIDS ?HID? IN THE COOLERS.  EVENTUALLY KIDS SAT ON THE LID WHEN ANOTHER KID WAS IN THE COOLER.  THEY WOULD HAVE FOUND A WAY TO LOCK ANOTHER KID IN THE COOLER.  I WAS CONVINCED THAT WE HAD TO CHANGE.  [REDACTED] THEN CHANGED THE DESIGN OF ALL MEDIUM SIZED AND LARGER COOLERS SO THAT THE LID OF THE COOLER COULD BE PUSHED OPEN FROM THE INSIDE WITH MINIMAL FORCE.  WE NEVER SAW ANY PROBLEMS WITH THE USE OR POPULARITY OF THE COOLERS WITH THE SAFETY LATCH.

ALL OF THIS HAPPENED 50 YEARS AGO.  NOW IT SEEMS THAT YOU HAVE EITHER CHANGED YOUR STANDARDS OR THE MANUFACTURERS OF PICNIC COOLERS HAVE FORGOTTEN WHY WE CHANGED TO SAFETY LIDS.  THERE ARE SEVERAL BRANDS OF PICNIC COOLERS (YETI AND OTHERS) THAT OFFER LARGE CAPACITY PICNIC COOLERS WITH SOLID RUBBER LATCHES/STRAPS THAT COULD RENDER THEIR COOLERS DEATH TRAPS FOR SMALL KIDS.  I CAN THINK OF NO REASON WHY THE UNDERLYING PRINCIPLES OF THE ORIGINAL DECISION TO REQUIRE SAFETY LATCHES HAVE CHANGED.

I BOUGHT AN LG WASHER AND DRYER SET IN 2019 AND A FEW YEARS LATER, I BEGAN TO EXPERIENCE ISSUES WITH THE GAS DRYER.  MY FAMILY AND I STARTED TO SMELL TRACE AMOUNTS OF NATURAL GAS WHEN OPENING THE DRYER.  IN MAY OF 2022, I PAID FOR AN APPLIANCE REPAIR TECHNICIAN TO COME OUT AND TAKE A LOOK AT THE DRYER.  HE CHECKED IT AND REFERRED ME TO LG'S CUSTOMER SERVICE, SAYING THE ONLY ISSUE THAT HE SAW WAS REGARDING PARTS WITHIN THE MACHINE THAT WERE CAUSING THE GAS TO NOT COMPLETELY BURN AS THE DRYER WAS IN ITS CYCLE.
IN MAY OF 2022, I REACHED OUT TO LG AND, AFTER MULTIPLE PHONE CALLS, THEY SENT OUT A TECHNICIAN ON MAY 27, 2022.  THE TECHNICIAN TESTED GAS PIPES AND THE DRYER UNIT AND CAME TO THE CONCLUSION THAT A PART WITHIN THE UNIT WAS DEFECTIVE.  HE REPLACED IT AND IN THE COMING DAYS, THE GAS SMELL HAD DISSIPATED.  MY FAMILY AND I SMELLED MORE GAS A MONTH LATER AND SCHEDULED ANOTHER APPOINTMENT WITH LG.  THE APPOINTMENT WAS CANCELLED, AS THE TECHNICIAN SENT THIS TIME SAID THAT I NEEDED ONLY TO CLEAN THE UNIT, WHICH I REGULARLY DO, INCLUDING THE EXHAUST DUCTING FROM ANY LINT OR BLOCKAGE.
OVER THE NEXT YEAR, THE GAS SMELL CONTINUOUSLY RETURNED AND MY FAMILY AND I BEGAN DRYING OUR CLOTHES WITHOUT THE HEATING OPTION.  IN APRIL 2023, I CONTRACTED OUT AN APPLIANCE REPAIR TECH AND HE SUGGESTED THAT THE DRYER WAS FAULTY AND THAT WE PURCHASE  NEW DRYER.  
ON JUNE 12, 2023, I SCHEDULED A LOCAL PLUMBER TO COME OUT AND SURVEY OUR GAS LINES IN THE HOUSE AND HE CAME TO THE CONCLUSION THAT THE ONLY GAS LEAK WAS COMING FROM THE EXHAUST VENT FROM THE DRYER AND THE DRYER WAS DEFECTIVE IN SOME WAY, AS THE AMOUNT OF GAS RELEASED BY THE DRYER WAS UNACCEPTABLE.  
I CALLED LG WITH THIS ISSUE AND NOTED THAT IT HAS BEEN ONGOING AND MULTIPLE OUTSIDE TECHNICIANS CONSIDER THE MACHINE TO BE FAULTY.  THEY PROMISED A CALL BACK AND I AM CURRENTLY WAITING FOR THAT CALL FROM LG.

TO WHOM IT MAY CONCERN: I PURCHASED A BRAND NEW $3,000 LIEBHERR REFRIGERATOR MODEL CS1321 22 MONTHS AGO. APPROXIMATELY 8 WEEKS AGO I BEGAN TO ENCOUNTER ISSUES WITH THE TEMPERATURE SETTINGS, FIRST WITH THE REFRIGERATOR AND SOON AFTER WITH THE FREEZER. I DISCOVERED A MANUAL POWER RESET FIXED THE ISSUE. THIS LASTED A COUPLE WEEKS UNTIL THE TEMPERATURES INCREASED MORE AND A POWER RESET NO LONGER WAS EFFECTIVE. THE REFRIGERATOR'S TEMPERATURE CONTROL PANEL WAS MALFUNCTIONING WITHOUT WARNING AT ALL HOURS OF THE DAY/NIGHT. THIS CAUSED ALL OF OUR FOOD TO SPOIL AND BE THROWN AWAY. FIVE WEEKS AGO I CONTACTED LIEBHERR CUSTOMER SERVICE AND WAS GIVEN CONTACT INFORMATION FOR A LOCAL COMPANY TO REPAIR THE ISSUE UNDER WARRANTY. WHEN I FIRST CONTACTED THE WARRANTY COMPANY THEY RECOMMENDED THAT I RENT A FRIDGE AND INFORMED ME A TECHNICIAN WAS NOT AVAILABLE THAT DAY BUT A VIRTUAL TECHNICIAN WOULD CALL ME IN TWO DAYS.  I WAS DISAPPOINTED WITH THIS OPTION BUT FELT I HAD NO CHOICE BECAUSE OF THE WARRANTY ON THE REGRIGERATOR.  A TECHNICIAN CAME TO OUR HOME 2 WEEKS AFTER THE INITIAL CALL WITH THE WARRANTY COMPANY. HE STATED HE NEEDED TO ORDER MULTIPLE PARTS AND I WOULD HEAR BACK IN A WEEK TO SCHEDULE THE REPAIR. IT HAS NOW BEEN 2 WEEKS SINCE THAT VISIT AND I HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO REACH ANYONE AT THEIR OFFICE. I EMAILED LIEBHERR CUSTOMER SERVICE ABOUT MY EXPERIENCE AND THEY ONLY CONFIRMED PARTS WERE ON ORDER AND ADVISED I CONTINUE TO CALL THE WARRANTY COMPANY. THE WARRANTY COMPANY THAT WAS ASSIGNED TO ME HAS SEVERAL COMPLAINTS FROM CUSTOMERS WITH SIMILAR EXPERIENCES, SOME LASTING MONTHS. THEY HAVE MULTIPLE 1 STAR RATINGS ON ALL REVIEW SITES AND COMPLAINTS WITH THE [REDACTED]. I RELAYED THIS INFORMATION TO THE LIEBHERR REPRESENTATIVE AS WELL.  I PURCHASED THIS REFRIGERATOR FOR A FAMILY OF FOUR WITH TWO TODDLERS. THIS EXPERIENCE HAS CREATED A HARDSHIP IN MAINTAINING BASIC NEEDS FOR MY FAMILY. I FEEL LEIBHERR HAS FAILED IN PROVIDING A WARRANTY SERVICE THAT PROMPTLY HELPS THEIR CUSTOMERS MAINTAIN A FUNCTIONING CRITICAL APPLIANCE. I AM HOPEFUL THEY WILL DO THE RIGHT THING. THANK YOU FOR TAKING THE TIME TO LOOK INTO THIS REPORT. I APPRECIATE YOUR TIME.

THE MOTION AND SLANT CAUSED MY DAUGHTER TO SLIDE TO THE SIDE OF THE BASSINET. HAD I NOT WOKEN UP MY DAUGHTER COULD HAVE BEEN SERIOUSLY HURT. 
I USED THIS BASSINET FOR 4 MONTHS WITH MY SON. STORED IT IN THE GARAGE. THEN USED IT FOR MY DAUGHTER. SINCE THW FIRST DAY OF USE THE BASSINET HAS OCCASIONALLY MADE A SOFT CLICKING NOISE WHEN CHANGING DIRECTION OF MOTION. 
THE BASSINET HAS SEEN A TOTAL OF 8 MONTHS OF USE. I UNDERSTAND THAT THE BASSINET HAS A 1 YEAR WARRANTY. BUT THAT SHOULDN'T MEAN THAT AFTER 1 YEAR THE BASSINET IS NO LONGER SAFE FOR USE. THE BASSINET IS CONTINUING TO OPERATE, BUT IT IS OPERATING IN A SERIOUSLY DANGEROUS MANNER. I PURCHASED A SAMSUNG 3-DOOR REFRIGERATOR IN APRIL 2020. THE UNIT WAS WITHIN NORMAL WORKING PARAMETERS UNTIL APRIL 2022. I BEGAN NOTICING ICE BUILD UP IN THE VENTS AT THE BACK OF THE REFRIGERATOR SECTION. THIS BUILD-UP DID NOT AFFECT ANY PART OR OPERATION OF THE UNIT AT THIS TIME. AT THE END OF APRIL 2022, I NOTICED MY DELI DRAWER AT THE BOTTOM OF THE UNIT WAS STUCK, IT WOULDN'T MOVE. THANKS TO A LAYER OF ICE THAT FORMED, THE DRAWER WAS GOING NOWHERE. I ALSO NOTICED THAT FOOD WAS GOING BAD QUICKER THAN IT NORMALLY WOULD. THE TEMPERATURE FROM THE TOP SHELF REPORTED 55F WHEN THE PANEL READ 37F. EACH WEEK, I WOULD REMOVE THE DELI DRAWER AND BREAK OUT THE LAYER OF ICE THAT HAD ACCUMULATED BEFORE DRYING IT OUT. AT THE END OF MAY 2022, FOOD STORED IN THE UNIT BEGAN TO SPOIL WITHIN DAYS OF PURCHASING. A GALLON OF MILK HAD SPOILED WITHIN A DAY. IN JUNE OF 2022, I HAD MY FIRST REPAIR BILL FOR IT FOR $350. SAMSUNG HAD SCHEDULED THE REPAIR FROM A COMPANY ON THEIR AUTHORIZED LISTS. UPON ARRIVAL, THE REPAIR PERSON KNEW WITHIN MOMENTS OF THE ISSUE, AS THEY DESCRIBED THIS SITUATION AS THE MOST COMMON ONE THEY FACE: A FAULTY TEMPERATURE SENSOR. THIS SENSOR MESSAGES THE COOLANT SYSTEM TELLING IT IF THE FRIDGE NEEDS COLDER OR TO STAND DOWN. THIS FLUCTUATION FROM THE SENSOR'S FAILURE CAUSED ICE BUILD-UP THAT BLOCKS THE AIR VENTS, WHICH RAISES THE INTERNAL TEMPERATURE. THE FIX WAS IMMEDIATE AND HAD NO FURTHER ISSUES UNTIL MARCH OF 2023. THE ICE BUILD-UP WAS BACK AND I BEGAN REMOVING IT EVERY TWO WEEKS. I REACHED OUT TO SAMSUNG ASKING FOR THE REPAIR TO A DEVICE THEY REPLACED LESS THAN A YEAR AGO, BUT WAS TOLD THERE WAS NO AUTHORIZED REPAIRFOLK IN THE {REDACTED] AREA SO I WOULD HAVE TO SCHEDULE MY SERVICE AND THEN FILE A CLAIM TO SEE IF THE WARRANTY OF ONLY THE SENSOR WOULD BE COVERED (BUT THERE MAY BE OTHER 'ISSUES' DISCOVERED'). AT THE TIME, THE ICE REMOVAL WAS NOT A HUGE ISSUE SO I DID NOTHING IN MAY OF 2023, MY FOOD BEGAN TO SPOIL WITHIN DAYS OF PURCHASING, AGAIN. CONTACTING SAMSUNG, I WAS TOLD THERE WAS NOW AN AUTHORIZED REPAIR COMPANY THAT COULD SCHEDULE THE APPOINTMENT BUT I WOULD HAVE TO PAY $425 UPFRONT TO SCHEDULE IT. I NEVER HAD TO DO THAT WITH THE FIRST REPAIR AND THIS NEW APPOINTMENT IS ESSENTIALLY FIXING THE ORIGINAL REPAIR'S PROBLEM. FURIOUSLY, I DECIDED NOT TO CONTINUE THE CONVERSATION WITH SAMSUNG AND ATTEMPT ALTERNATIVE ROUTES. I CONCLUDED THAT IF THE SENSOR WAS THE SIMPLE FIX, THEN I COULD DO IT. AFTER DAYS OF REVIEWING SEVERAL VIDEOS AND ARTICLES ON THE SUBJECT, AS THIS ISSUE WITH SAMSUNG'S UNITS HAS BEEN GOING ON SINCE 2017, I FELT CONFIDENT ENOUGH TO SCREW OFF A PANEL, REMOVE THE ICE BUILD-UP, AND REPLACE THIS SENSOR PIECE. THE OPERATION WENT TEXT-BOOK WELL. I WAS CLOSING UP THE OPERATION WHEN I HAD NOT REALIZED THAT THE FINAL 2 SCREWS WERE NOT CATCHING THE RECEIVING END FOR FASTENING. REALIZING I PLACED THE WRONG SCREWS IN, I BEGAN REMOVING THE FIRST INCORRECTLY PLACED SCREW WHEN A HIGH-PRESSURE BURST OF GAS SPEWED OUT AROUND THE SCREW. I HAD PUNCTURED THE COIL WHICH CIRCULATED THE REFRIGERANT GAS. UNKNOWING THE TOXICITY OF THE GAS, I CLOSED THE UNIT DOORS IMMEDIATELY AND REMOVED MY ROOMMATE AND MYSELF FROM MY TOWNHOUSE. AFTER SPENDING A WASTEFUL 20 MINUTES WITH SAMSUNG SUPPORT ON ASCERTAINING HOW TOXIC THIS GAS WAS, I DISCOVERED THAT WE WERE IN NO DANGER BY MY RESEARCH FOR AN MSDS SHEET ON THE GAS. MY ISSUES ARE THESE: HOW ARE THESE PRODUCTS STILL BEING PRODUCED WHEN THEY KNOWINGLY HAVE CONTINUOUS ERRORS IN THEIR TEMPERATURE SENSORS? IF THEY CLAIM THEY DIDN'T, THEN THEIR RESEARCH DEPARTMENT SHOULD BE FIRED.  [REDACTED] KNEW THAT THIS HAS BEEN AN ISSUE SINCE 2017. THE ONLY LOGICAL CONCLUSION IS THAT SAMSUNG HAS DESIGNED THESE UNITS TO FAIL ON PURPOSE. FOR EXAMPLE: WHY IS THERE A VITAL TUBE BEHIND A SCREW HOLE? WHY NEED TWO DIFFERENT LENGTH SCREWS WHEN YOU COULD HAVE DESIGNED IT ONLY TO HAVE ONE, ELIMINATING THE CHANCE A CONSUMER WOULD BE CONFUSED, [REDACTED] EVEN A REPAIRPERSON COULD GET CONFUSED. I DON'T THINK I'M AN EINSTIEN-LEVEL GENIUS, BUT AS A LICENSED ARCHITECT, I UNDERSTAND THE PURPOSE AND WHY THINGS ARE BUILT THE WAY THEY ARE. THIS PRODUCT WAS DESIGNED TO FAIL. THAT FAILURE HAS COSTED ME WITH LOST FOOD, POINTLESS REPAIRS, AND POSES A HAZARD TO MY HEALTH. THIS IS NOT ONLY UNPROFESSIONAL OF SAMSUNG BUT UNETHICAL. I AM BLOWN AWAY THAT THIS HAS BEEN ALLOWED.

incident_description: STOVE BURNERS COME ON ACCIDENTLY IF BUMPED.  SAMSUNG'S WEB PAGE REBUTS THAT THE KNOBS MUST BOTH BE PUSHED IN AND TURNED, WHICH IS TRUE, BUT THIS DOES NOT MAKE IT SAFE. THE STOVE IS A SAMSUNG SLIDE-IN ELECTRIC RANGE MODEL NE63T8111SG/AA.  SAMSUNG'S WEB SITE RECOMMENDS PURCHASE OF EXPENSIVE, INCONVENIENT AND UNSIGHTLY CHILD-PROOF COVERS.  RIDICULOUS AND IRRESPONSIBLE.  AT AT MINIMUM, THERE SHOULD BE A LOCK-OUT FOR THE KNOBS, AS THERE IS FOR THE OVEN.

incident_description:
ON FEBRUARY 20, 2023, I PURCHASED THIS PRODUCT (ORDER # [REDACTED]):
WIEZ GPS WIRELESS DOG FENCE, ELECTRIC DOG FENCE,PET CONTAINMENT SYSTEM,RANGE 65-3281FT, ADJUSTABLE WARNING STRENGTH, RECHARGEABLE, HARMLESS AND SUITABLE FOR ALL DOGS(NEW MODEL FOR 2023!)  

THAT PRODUCT WAS PURCHASED FROM THE AMAZON WEBSITE AND CHARGED TO MY AMAZON CREDIT CARD, BILLED AS AN AMAZON PURCHASE.

THE PRODUCT SAYS IN ITS TITLE ITS SAFE FOR DOGS. THE REVIEWS WERE VERY POSITIVE. I RELIED ON THAT INFORMATION TO MAKE, WHAT I THOUGHT TO BE, AN INFORMED DECISION.

HOWEVER, THE DOG COLLAR MALFUNCTIONED AND SHOCKED MY DOG WITH ELECTRICITY FOR SEVERAL MINUTES STRAIGHT. THE DOG WAS ONLY A FEW FEET FROM THE CENTER OF THE AREA HE SHOULD HAVE BEEN ABLE TO USE. HE SHOULD HAVE BEEN ABLE TO WALK MORE THAN 60 FEET AWAY WITH NO SHOCK.

ADDITIONALLY, WHEN I WAS FINALLY ABLE TO GET THE COLLAR OFF OF HIM, IT SHOCKED ME SO BADLY I YELLED OUT LOUD AND DROPPED IT. THIS SHOCK OCCURRED DESPITE THE FACT THAT THE PRODUCT WAS SET ON THE LOWEST LEVEL AVAILABLE FOR THE SHOCK. I AM 160 POUNDS. THIS PRODUCT WAS MARKETED AS APPROPRIATE FOR MY 16 POUND DOG. 

THE COLLAR TOOK MINUTES TO REMOVE BECAUSE THE DOG WAS FLAILING AND IT IS SNUGLY FIT AGAINST HIS THROAT. IT APPEARED TO BE GIVING THE HIGHEST LEVEL OF SHOCK ALTHOUGH IT WAS CLEARLY SET AT THE LOWEST LEVEL.

MY DOG WILL NOT ALLOW ME TO PUT ANYTHING LIKE THIS AROUND HIS NECK NOW AND WILL NOT GO OUT BACK WITH ME ANYMORE, DESPITE THE FACT THAT HE WOULD NEVER BE MORE THAN 2 FEET FROM ME REGARDLESS OF WHETHER I AM INSIDE OR OUTSIDE, PRIOR TO THIS EVENT. 

I HAVE PEOPLE THAT WILL TESTIFY AS WITNESSES ON MY BEHALF. 

AMAZON IS VERY CLEAR ON ITS WEBSITE THAT IT DOES NOT TOLERATE VENDORS ATTEMPTING TO ALTER REVIEWS OR PAYING PEOPLE TO ALTER OR DELETE THEIR REVIEW. THE VERBIAGE CHOSEN BY AMAZON TO DESCRIBE THE INTOLERANCE OF THESE ACTS IS EXTREMELY CLEAR.

HOWEVER, WHEN WROTE A VERY HONEST REVIEW OF THE PRODUCT AND ITS HORRIFIC MALFUNCTION, THE VENDOR DID IN FACT OFFER ME MONEY TO TAKE MY REVIEW DOWN. I REPORTED THAT EVENT TO AMAZON AND DESCRIBED THE PRODUCT MALFUNCTION AND THE EXTREME PAIN IT CAUSED MY DOG. INSTEAD OF INTOLERANCE, I FOUND THE VENDOR HAD APPARENTLY NEVER BEEN CONTACTED BY AMAZON ABOUT PAYING ME TO TAKE DOWN MY REVIEW. IN FACT, THE VENDOR CONTINUED TO OFFER ME $125 TO TAKE THE REVIEW DOWN. A VERY MOTIVATING AMOUNT OF MONEY FOR MANY PEOPLE.

SO NOW I RELIED ON REVIEWS TO BE ACCURATE, BECAUSE OF AMAZON?S EXTREMELY CLEAR POLICY OF INTOLERANCE FOR ALTERATION OR DELETION OF BAD REVIEWS. BUT THAT INTOLERANCE IS ACTUALLY NONEXISTENT IN MY CASE, WHICH LEADS ME TO BELIEVE OTHER PEOPLE HAVE LIKELY WRITTEN REVIEWS ABOUT THIS PRODUCT MALFUNCTIONING. THOSE REVIEWS WOULD HAVE STEERED ME AWAY FROM THIS PRODUCT. IN FACT, AFTER LOOKING AT MANY PRODUCTS SIMILAR TO THIS ONE, I CHOSE THIS ONE BECAUSE THE REVIEWS GAVE NO HINT OF SAFETY PROBLEMS. BUT THOSE REVIEWS CAN BE FALSIFIED.

MY DOG WAS IN EXTRAORDINARY PAIN WHILE HE WAS BEING SHOCKED. HE NOW CANNOT EVEN GO OUT IN BACK ANYMORE. I CANNOT USE ANY TYPE OF DOG FENCE COLLAR ON HIM ANYMORE. HE THINKS SOMETHING IS IN THE BACK THAT ATTACKED HIM AND LIVES IN FEAR OF IT.

MY DOG AND I MAY BE LUCKIER THAN SOME. IF I LEFT HOME TO GO TO THE STORE HE COULD HAVE BEEN SHOCKED FOR AN HOUR OR MORE STRAIGHT. I?D GUESS A DOG WOULD LIKELY DIE OF A HEART ATTACK FROM THAT. MAYBE FROM SELF INJURY DUE TO FLAILING EVERY WHICH WAY TO TRY TO GET AWAY FROM THE VERY POWERFUL SHOCK. 

AMAZON MISLED ME IN AN EXTRAORDINARY WAY BY LEADING ME TO BELIEVE REVIEWS ARE GENERALLY UNALTERED, WHEN IN ACTUALITY I HAVE EVIDENCE THAT AMAZON TAKES NO ACTION TO STOP REVIEW TAMPERING, EVEN WHEN ITS REPORTED DIRECTLY TO THEM.

THIS ALSO MAKES ME REALIZE THAT AMAZON SELLS MANY PRODUCTS THAT CAN BE SAFETY HAZARDS. SOME ARE EVEN IDENTIFIED AS MEDICAL DEVICES. ALL OF THOSE MAY HAVE SKEWED SETS OF REVIEWS, DUE TO REVIEW TAMPERING. THIS MAKES ME FEEL THAT THE CPSC, FDA AND OTHER GROUPS NEED TO PUT OUT ADVISORIES.

THIS NEW PRESSURE WASHER WAS WORKING FINE AS I CLEANED THE SIDING ON MY HOUSE. I NOTICED THE ENGINE STARTING TO SPUTTER SO I SHUT THE MACHINE OFF TO REFILL THE GAS TANK. ONCE REFILLED, I GRABBED THE STARTING CORD HANDLE AND GAVE IT A PULL. BECAUSE THE STARTING CORD IS ANGLED SLIGHTLY TOWARD THE FRONT OF THE MACHINE, MY PULLING OF IT CAUSED THE ENTIRE MACHINE TO LUNGE FORWARD. WHAT I ASSUME IS THE HOT METAL MUFFLER IN THE FRONT OF THE MACHINE MOMENTARILY CAME INTO CONTACT WITH MY LEFT LEG AND I IMMEDIATELY FELT THE MY LEG BURNING AND IT TURNED RED. THE NEXT DAY, I HAD A RECTANGLE-SHAPED BURN MARK ON MY LEG WITH BLISTER BUBBLES AND OOZING BURNS. WITH THE BURN BEING PAINFUL, OOZING, AND BLISTERED, I DECIDED TO VISIT MY LOCAL EMERGENCY ROOM. THE ER DOCTOR AND NURSE PRESCIBED MEDICATION TO APPLY TO THE WOUND AND INDICATED THAT I HAD A PARTIAL-THICKNESS BURN. AS IT WAS RATHER GROTESQUE AND SOMEWHAT PAINFUL, I COVERED THE WOUND WHEN WEARING SHORTS FOR THE REMAINDER OF THE SUMMER. NEARLY A YEAR LATER, THE SCAR ON MY LEG IS STILL PRESENT AND I'M ASSUMING WILL BE THERE FOR LIFE. I CONSIDER THE DESIGN OF THIS PRESSURE WASHER, WITH THE STARTING CORD ANGLED TOWARDS THE FRONT OF THE MACHINE, ALONG WITH ITS LIGHT WEIGHT, TO BE A DESIGN FLAW. IT WOULD HAVE BEEN JUST AS EASY FOR THE MANUFACTURER TO NOT HAVE THE STARTER CORD ANGLED TOWARD THE FRONT OF THE MACHINE. RATHER, IT SHOULD BE ANGLED DIRECTLY TO THE SIDE OF THE MACHINE SO THAT THE PULLING MOTION DOES NOT CAUSE IT TO EASILY PULL FORWARD ON ITS LARGE REAR WHEELS. I CONTACTED THE DEWALT COMPANY AND THEIR REPRESENTATIVE INSISTED THAT I AM THE ONLY PERSON TO EVER INJURE MYSELF IN THIS MANNER WITH ONE OF THEIR PRESSURE WASHERS. THEY DID, HOWEVER, PUT ME IN CONTACT WITH THEIR LAWYER TO SETTLE THE MATTER. ALTHOUGH GIVING ASSURANCES THAT THEY "WANT TO MAKE THIS RIGHT" AND THAT THEY WOULD COVER MY ER BILL, COST OF BANDAGES, REPLACE THE MACHINE WITH A DIFFERENT MODEL, AND ACCOUNT FOR MY INJURY, THE LAWYER HAS STOPPED ALL CONTACT WITH ME FOR THE PAST 4 MONTHS. I RECENTLY PURCHASED A RECTEQ 1250 ELECTRIC PELLET SMOKING GRILL. UPON MY FIRST IGNITION/STARTUP I WAS ABLE TO QUICKLY DETERMINE THAT THE AMOUNT OF FUEL BEING FED INTO THE FIRE POT WAS NOT APPROPRIATE TO THE AMOUNT OF OXYGEN AND HEAT SOURCE. THIS RESULTED IN VERY LARGE PLUMES OF HEAVY SMOKE. WHEN CONFINED TO A SMOKER THIS CAN AND OFTEN RESULTS IN A SMOKE EXPLOSION. 

I THOUGHT IT WAS JUST BECAUSE IT WAS THE FIRST IGNITING, BUT ON SUBSEQUENT STARTS IT HAS DONE THE SAME THING. UPON DOING FURTHER RESEARCH I FOUND THIS IS QUITE A COMMON PHENOMENON AT START UP WITH THIS BRAND OF PELLET SMOKER. ALL SMOKERS RUN THIS RISK, BUT IT IS USUALLY CAUSED BY PELLET VOIDS OR FLAMEOUTS. WHERE THESE ARE HAPPENING AT STARTUP WHICH SHOWS THEIR FORMULAS AND RATIOS ARE OFF.  THE FREQUENCY THIS THIS HAPPENS ALSO APPEARS TO BE HIGHER WITH THIS AS A RESULT OF THIS. IT'S THE DESIGN, NOT AN ANOMALY OR FLUKE.

WHEN I WROTE RECTEQ ABOUT TRYING TO RETURN THE SMOKER I WAS SENT AN AUTOMATED REPLY, THAT WAS VERY SIMILAR TO OTHERS I HAVE SEEN WHO HAVE REPORTED THIS ISSUE. THIS SHOWS ME THAT IT IS REPORTED FREQUENTLY ENOUGH THAT THEY HAD DRAFT AND MODIFY AN AUTOMATED REPLY.

UPON FURTHER INSPECTION OF MY SMOKER I DISCOVERED THAT THE HEATING ELEMENT WAS NOT INSTALLED CORRECTLY. IT IS NOT SET IN A WAY WHERE IT IS MAKING GOOD CONTACT WITH THE PELLETS. IT WAS ACTUALLY INSTALLED RECESSED AND THIS IS WHY THEY WERE NOT IGNITING AS THEY SHOULD. AGAIN, THIS IS A KNOWN ISSUE WITHIN THEIR COMMUNITY.

AS A RESULT OF THESE INCORRECTLY INSTALLED HEATING ELEMENTS THESE UNITS ARE AT A HIGH RISK OF FIRE, INJURY, AND EXPLOSION RIGHT OUT OF THE BOX.  THIS POOR CONTACT ALSO RESULTS IN TOO MANY PELLETS BEING FED TO THE FIRE POT WHICH ALSO RUNS THE RISK OF A BACKDRAFT, AND ALSO BACK BURN. BACK BURN IS WHEN THE PELLETS BURN BACK INTO THE HOPPER (PELLET FEED WHICH HOLDS 40 POUNDS OF PELLETS) AND AGAIN CAN CAUSE SIGNIFICANT FIRES. 

IT DOES NOT SEEM THAT THE COMPANY HAS NOT DONE MUCH TO ADDRESS THIS QUALITY CONTROL  ISSUE. IT IS UP TO THE CONSUMER TO TAKE APART THE FIRE POT AND MAKE THE ADJUSTMENT OF THE HEATING ELEMENT. THEY DO NOT WARN CONSUMERS ABOUT THIS POTENTIAL BEFORE STARTING UP THEIR SMOKER. IN MY OPINION IT SHOULD BE SOMETHING INCLUDED IN THEIR MANUAL TO CHECK BEFORE IGNITING.  

I AM LUCKY AS I HAVE A COOKING AND FIRE SCIENCE BACKGROUND, AND I COULD SEE THE TROUBLE RIGHT AWAY. MANY OTHERS DO NOT, AND FAR WORSE MANY BELIEVE THAT IT IS NORMAL. I UNDERSTAND THAT EVERY SMOKER, GRILL, ETC POSES POTENTIAL RISKS, THIS HOWEVER IS HAPPENING BECAUSE OF AN ASSEMBLY FLAW THAT SHOULD BE CORRECTED AT THE FACTORY. THERE IS NO EXCUSE FOR THESE TO ROLL OUT WITH THE HEATING ELEMENT, A KEY COMPONENT INSTALLED INCORRECTLY. IT'S FAR TOO DANGEROUS.

DEAR CPSC,

I AM WRITING TO REPORT A SAFETY CONCERN AND INCIDENT RELATED TO THE VT1000 DUAL DISPLAY UNIVERSAL USB 3.0 DOCKING STATION MANUFACTURED BY LENOVO.

ON JULY 27, 2023, WHEN I CONNECTED THE DOCKING STATION TO THE INCLUDED POWER ADAPTER, THE POWER INDICATOR LIGHT STARTED FLICKERING. SHORTLY AFTER, WHITE SMOKE STARTED EMANATING FROM THE LOCK SLOT, ACCOMPANIED BY A MILD EXPLOSION SOUND. I IMMEDIATELY DISCONNECTED THE POWER SOURCE, WHICH CEASED THE EMISSION OF SMOKE.

AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT, THE PRODUCT WAS BEING USED FOR ITS INTENDED PURPOSE, TO CONNECT MULTIPLE ELECTRONIC DEVICES, SUCH AS AN E-INK DISPLAY, KEYBOARD, AND MOUSE. I WAS OPERATING THE DEVICE AT THE TIME OF THE INCIDENT.

THE PRODUCT WAS BEING USED AS INTENDED, WITH ELECTRONIC DEVICES CONNECTED TO IT THROUGH VARIOUS PORTS. THERE WERE NO ABNORMAL USAGE CONDITIONS; THE ENVIRONMENT WAS A TYPICAL HOME OFFICE SETTING.

THANKFULLY, NO PHYSICAL INJURIES OCCURRED DURING THIS INCIDENT. HOWEVER, THE POTENTIAL FOR HARM WAS SIGNIFICANT. THE INCIDENT COULD HAVE POTENTIALLY RESULTED IN FIRE OR ELECTRICAL INJURY IF THE POWER HADN'T BEEN DISCONNECTED PROMPTLY OR IF THE SITUATION HAD ESCALATED FURTHER.

THIS INCIDENT ALSO LED TO CONSIDERABLE PROPERTY DAMAGE. MY [REDACTED] DISPLAY AND KEYBOARD, BOTH CONNECTED TO THE DOCKING STATION AT THE TIME, WERE RENDERED INOPERABLE, LIKELY DUE TO A SUDDEN SURGE IN VOLTAGE CAUSED BY THE MALFUNCTIONING DOCKING STATION.

I HAVE ALREADY CONTACTED LENOVO, THE MANUFACTURER, REGARDING THIS ISSUE, BUT I WANTED TO BRING THIS TO YOUR ATTENTION GIVEN THE SEVERITY OF THE INCIDENT AND THE POTENTIAL FOR HARM TO OTHERS USING THE SAME OR SIMILAR PRODUCTS.

I AM WILLING TO PROVIDE MORE INFORMATION OR SUPPORT AN INVESTIGATION IN ANY WAY I CAN.

incident_description:
I AM WRITING TO REPORT AN UNSAFE DOOR LOCK, WHICH IS MANUFACTURED BY A COMPANY CALLED OMNIA. UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, THE LOCK DOES NOT OPEN AND PRESENTS AN ENTRAPMENT HAZARD.

THE LOCK IS AN OMNIA MORTISE LOCKSET WITH THESE IDENTIFYING STICKERS:
CONTROL NO. 33L5 SINGLE-POINT LOCK OR LATCH
LOCK FUNCTION F (LEVER AND LH ARE CHECKED OFF)
788N
BM20LH-LB.FIN

THE LOCK IS ON MY FRONT DOOR. WHEN I UNLOCK MY DOOR, IF I LEAVE THE KEY IN THE LOCK AND THE DOOR CLOSES BEHIND ME, IT WILL OCCASIONALLY LOCK ME INSIDE MY CONDO. IT DOESN'T HAPPEN EVERY TIME, AND TO DATE THIS HAS HAPPENED TWICE. WHEN IT DOES HAPPEN, THE KEY REMAINS INSERTED ON THE OUTSIDE OF THE DOOR, AND THE INSIDE DOOR HANDLE AND DEADBOLT KNOB DO NOT TURN. I NEED TO HAVE SOMEONE TURN THE KEY FROM OUTSIDE IN ORDER TO OPEN THE DOOR. THIS PRESENTS AN ENTRAPMENT HAZARD, AS I CAN'T EXIT MY CONDO UNDER THESE CONDITIONS WITHOUT SOMEONE UNLOCKING THE DOOR FROM THE OUTSIDE.

A LOCKSMITH TOOK APART THE LOCK ON 6/30/23 AND WAS ABLE TO REPLICATE THE ISSUE. HE SAID THAT IT WAS DUE TO A DESIGN FLAW OF THE MORTISE LOCK ITSELF. HE DESCRIBED THE ISSUE AS: ?WHEN THE KEY IS ORIENTED TO ENGAGE THE LATCH, THE CAM ON THE MORTISE CYLINDER PREVENTS THE INTERIOR LEVER FROM ENGAGING THE LATCH.? HE SAID THAT THERE WAS NOTHING THAT COULD BE ADJUSTED OR CLEANED ON THE LOCKSET TO FIX THE ISSUE. HE ADVISED REPLACING THE LOCKSET WITH A DIFFERENT BRAND OF LOCK, WHICH WOULD NOT HAVE THIS DESIGN FLAW.

I CONTACTED OMNIA ON 6/30/23 TO INFORM THEM OF THIS PROBLEM AND TO ASK FOR A SOLUTION. THEIR RESPONSE, ON 7/5/23, DID NOT PROVIDE A SOLUTION:
"IF THE KEY IS LEFT IN THE CYLINDER AND THE KEY TURNS AT ALL, THE CAM OF THE CYLINDER COULD LOCK UP THE MORTISE LOCK. TO PREVENT THE SITUATION YOU DESCRIBED, WE RECOMMEND THAT YOU NOT LEAVE THE KEY IN THE CYLINDER. THANK YOU, [REDACTED]"

I AM CONCERNED THAT THE MANUFACTURER HAS APPARENTLY ACKNOWLEDGED THE ENTRAPMENT RISK THAT I DESCRIBED AND IS TREATING IT AS THE INTENDED BEHAVIOR FOR THIS LOCK.

I HAVE 2 AMERICAN STANDARD HVAC SYSTEMS INSTALLED AT MY HOME (INSTALLED IN DECEMBER OF 2016), WITH THE FURNACE UNITS AND BLOWER ASSEMBLIES IN THE ATTIC. I HAD TO SHUT OFF POWER AT THE BREAKER BOX AND THEN GUESS WHAT THE ISSUE WAS.  IT TURNS OUT THAT THE ELECTRONIC CONTROL MODULE OF THE MOTOR WAS THE ISSUE. 

THAT MOTOR WAS REPLACED WITH A DIFFERENT TYPE OF ECM MOTOR BACK IN SEPTEMBER OF 2021, AND THAT REPLACEMENT JUST FAILED IN A SIMILAR MANNER ALTHOUGH NOT AS SEVERE.  THIS TIME I RECOGNIZED THE SMELL MUCH SOONER AND SHUT THE UNIT DOWN. 

BASED ON THESE 2 SIMILAR FAILURES AND SOME ADDITIONAL RESEARCH, I BELIEVE THAT THERE ARE TENS OF THOUSANDS OR MORE AMERICAN STANDARD/TRANE HVAC UNITS INSTALLED IN HOMES THAT POSE A TOXIC SMOKE HAZARD AND A FIRE HAZARD AS WELL.  THUS FAR TRANE HAS FAILED TO ADDRESS THIS SAFETY HAZARD WITH ME.

FIBERGLASS CONTAMINATION IN CASPER MATTRESSES: A CALL FOR CONSUMER PROTECTION

INTRODUCTION:
ON SATURDAY, JUNE 16TH, 2023, AN ALARMING INCIDENT OCCURRED WHEN AN ATTEMPT TO CLEAN ONE OF OUR CASPER MATTRESSES LED TO THE DISCOVERY OF FIBERGLASS CONTAMINATION IN OUR HOME. THE FIBERGLASS EMERGED FROM THE DETERIORATED FIRE SOCK SITUATED BELOW THE MATTRESS COVER, UNBEKNOWNST TO US, AS NO MENTION OF SUCH MATERIAL WAS PROVIDED IN THE PRODUCT DESCRIPTION AT THE TIME OF PURCHASE. THIS REPORT DETAILS THE EVENTS THAT UNFOLDED, THE ADVERSE EFFECTS WE EXPERIENCED, AND THE SUBSEQUENT ACTIONS TAKEN TO ADDRESS THE CONTAMINATION, WITH A SPECIFIC FOCUS ON THE CONCERNING EMERGENCE OF FIBERGLASS FROM THE DETERIORATED FIRE SOCK. FURTHERMORE, IT RAISES CONCERNS ABOUT THE SAFETY IMPLICATIONS AND THE NEED FOR PROPER CONSUMER PROTECTION IN THE BEDDING INDUSTRY.

BACKGROUND:
OUR CASPER MATTRESS WAS PURCHASED ON NOVEMBER 7TH, 2016, AND HAD BEEN USED BY BOTH OUR FAMILY MEMBERS AND GUESTS. LITTLE DID WE KNOW THAT THE MATTRESS CONTAINED FIBERGLASS, WHICH WAS ONLY DISCOVERED DURING THE ATTEMPTED CLEANING PROCESS.

DISCOVERY OF FIBERGLASS CONTAMINATION:
UPON FOLLOWING THE MATTRESS TAG'S INSTRUCTIONS FOR HAND WASHING THE MATTRESS COVER, FIBERGLASS PARTICLES BEGAN TO EMANATE FROM THE FIRE SOCK BENEATH IT. THESE PARTICLES WERE FOUND TO BE WIDESPREAD IN THE AIR AND HAD SETTLED ON VARIOUS SURFACES, RESEMBLING SPARKLING FIBERS.

ADVERSE EFFECTS AND HEALTH IMPACT:
THE FIBERGLASS CONTAMINATION AFFECTED NOT ONLY OUR HOUSEHOLD ITEMS BUT ALSO HAD ADVERSE EFFECTS ON OUR BELOVED PETS. ONE OF OUR DOGS EXPERIENCED A SEVERE SKIN REACTION, LEADING TO INTENSE SCRATCHING AND NOW HAS LARGE SCABS ON BOTH SIDES OF HIS NECK. CONSEQUENTLY, IT BECAME EVIDENT THAT URGENT MEASURES WERE REQUIRED TO MITIGATE THE CONTAMINATION'S IMPACT ON OUR LIVING ENVIRONMENT AND HEALTH. ADDITIONALLY, WE HAVE SCHEDULED DOCTOR?S VISITS FOR OUR FAMILY TO SEE WHAT POTENTIAL RISKS WE CAN POSSIBLY FACE DOWN THE ROAD FROM INHALING THESE FIBERS IN THE AIR. FURTHERMORE, THIS HAS AFFECTED OUR MENTAL HEALTH AS WE ARE NOW HYPER-VIGILANT OF ANY KIND OF FIBER LINGERING IN THE AIR OR ON ANY SURFACE. THIS IS AN EXPERIENCE THAT WILL FOREVER IMPACT US.

RESPONSE FROM CASPER:
DESPITE PROMPTLY REPORTING THE ISSUE TO CASPER AND THEIR QUALITY ASSURANCE TEAM, WE RECEIVED NO SATISFACTORY RESPONSE OR APPROPRIATE ACTION TO ADDRESS THE CONTAMINATION. THE LACK OF ACCOUNTABILITY AND RESPONSIBILITY NECESSITATED US TO TAKE MATTERS INTO OUR OWN HANDS AND DEVELOP A CLEANUP PLAN.

CLEANUP MEASURES TAKEN:
TO MINIMIZE FURTHER CONTAMINATION, WE EMPLOYED PLASTIC BAGS TO STORE OUR CLOTHES AND REMOVE ALL OTHER ITEMS SUCH AS RUGS, CURTAINS, LAMPS, BEDDING, DOG BEDS, POROUS FURNITURE, AND BASICALLY ANYTHING THAT CAN?T BE CLEANED. ADDITIONALLY, WE HIRED A PROFESSIONAL CARPET CLEANING COMPANY TO CLEAN THE AFFECTED CARPETS. HOWEVER, IT SOON BECAME EVIDENT THAT THESE MEASURES WERE INSUFFICIENT, AND THE CONTAMINATION PERSISTED. AS A RESULT, WE HAD NO CHOICE BUT TO REPLACE THE ENTIRE CARPET, WHICH WAS ALSO IMPACTING OUR FAMILY?S AND PETS? WELL-BEING.

HVAC AND AIR DUCTS CLEANING:
RECOGNIZING THE EXTENT OF THE CONTAMINATION, WE TOOK THE ADDITIONAL STEP OF RENTING AND PURCHASING AIR SCRUBBERS TO CONTAIN THE SPREAD OF FIBERGLASS PARTICLES IN THE AIR. FURTHERMORE, WE HAVE SCHEDULED AN HVAC AND AIR DUCT CLEANING TO ENSURE THE ELIMINATION OF ANY REMAINING CONTAMINANTS.

CONCERNS REGARDING PRODUCT SAFETY AND RECALLS:
DESPITE, CASPER?S KNOWLEDGE OF THIS PROBLEM WITH MATTRESSES THAT HAVE TAGS THAT OFFER INSTRUCTIONS FOR REMOVING AND HOW TO WASH THE MATTRESS COVER CASPER HAS NOT ISSUED A RECALL FOR THEIR MATTRESSES. CONSUMERS WITH THESE TAGS WILL NOT KNOW OF THE PRESENCE OF FIBERGLASS UNTIL THEY HAVE REMOVED THE MATTRESS COVER AND THUS EXPOSED THIS MATERIAL. ALTHOUGH THEY CLAIM THAT THE CONSUMER PRODUCT SAFETY COMMISSION DEEMS THE "CONTINUOUS FILAMENT" FIBERGLASS USED IN TEXTILES AND FIRE-RESISTANT BARRIERS AS NON-HAZARDOUS, WE FIRMLY BELIEVE THAT SUCH MATERIAL SHOULD NOT BE PLACED DIRECTLY BELOW A MATTRESS COVER. THIS ISSUE POSES RISKS TO CONSUMERS' QUALITY OF LIFE AND POTENTIALLY THREATENS THEIR HEALTH AND SAFETY.

CONCLUSION:
THE INCIDENT INVOLVING FIBERGLASS CONTAMINATION IN OUR CASPER MATTRESS RAISES SIGNIFICANT CONCERNS ABOUT CONSUMER PROTECTION AND THE NEED FOR STRINGENT SAFETY MEASURES IN THE BEDDING INDUSTRY. WE ADVOCATE FOR A THOROUGH INVESTIGATION INTO THE PRESENCE OF FIBERGLASS IN CASPER MATTRESSES AND A PROACTIVE RECALL PROCESS TO SAFEGUARD CONSUMERS FROM POTENTIAL HEALTH RISKS WITH THESE TAGS THAT OFFER WASHING INSTRUCTIONS FOR THE MATTRESS COVER. IT IS OUR HOPE THAT THIS REPORT WILL CONTRIBUTE TO ENSURING SAFER PRODUCTS AND RESPONSIBLE PRACTICES WITHIN THE MATTRESS MANUFACTURING INDUSTRY.

WHILE NORMALLY USING THIS SNOWBLOWER, I STARTED THE ENGINE USING THE 120VOLT STARTER.  TO DO THIS, YOU PLUG AND MALE END OF AN EXTENSION CORD INTO THE STARTER MOTOR SWITCH AND PLUG THE OTHER END INTO A 120 VOLT OUTLET.  DURING NORMAL OPERATION I DISCOVERED THAT THE GROUND PIN ON THE SNOWBLOWER HAD BROKEN OFF AND WAS LEFT IN THE EXTENSION CORD.  I DIDN'T NOTICE THIS PROBLEM UNTIL I TRIED TO USE THE EXTENSION CORD FOR AN UNRELATED PURPOSE.  IT WAS THEN I FOUND THE GROUND STILL STUCK IN THE EXTENSION CORD.  THE PROBLEM IS THAT THE SNOWBLOWER IS NO LONGER GROUNDED.  IF I START THE SNOWBLOWER IN A SNOW STORM OR WHILE THE GROUND IS WET I COULD RECEIVE AN ELECTRICAL SHOCK.  FORTUNATELY, I NOTICED THIS WHILE I WAS STARTING THE EQUIPMENT WHILE I WAS IN MY GARAGE ON DRY GROUND.

I CONTACTED TORO AND THEY SIMPLY SAID TO BRING THE SNOWBLOWER TO AN AUTHORIZED DEALER TO HAVE THE STARTER MOTOR REPLACED (APPROX PART COST $340, LABOR EXTRA)  THEY SAID THE UNIT WAS NO LONGER IN WARRANTY AND WOULDN'T REPLACE THE PART.  THEY ALSO SAID THERE WAS NO REPLACEMENT PART FOR THE SWITCH...THE ENTIRE STARTER HAD TO BE REPLACED.

THE PIN THAT BROKE WAS NOT ATTACHED TO THE STARTER SWITCH VERY WELL (I HAVE PHOTOS).  I SPOKE TO MY DEALER AND THEY SAID THIS WAS A FAIRLY COMMON PROBLEM WITH THE TORO SNOWBLOWER STARTER.  THE STARTER WAS MADE IN CHINA.

CALLER STATED THAT HE CONTACTED THE COMPANY AND THEY ADVISED TO SEND OUT A SERVICE TECHNICIAN FOR INSPECTION.  CALLER STATED THAT THEY ARE AWARE OF THIS SAFETY ISSUE.
CALLER FEELS THAT THESE KNOBS ARE UNSAFE AND SHOULD BE REPORTED.

I HAVE A KITCHENAID DOUBLE OVEN GAS RANGE, (MODEL KFGDS00ESS04, SERIAL NUMBER DX3609098) WITH WHAT I BELIEVE HAS POTENTIAL FOR SERIOUS INJURY. SPECIFICALLY, THE KNOBS THAT TURN ON THE TOP BURNERS ARE VERY SENSITIVE TO TOUCH WHICH CAN CAUSE THEM TO BE TURNED ON WITHOUT THE USER KNOWING IT. THE SIMPLE ACT OF BRUSHING AGAINST ONE OF THE KNOBS WHILE LEANING OVER TO STIR A POT ON THE BACK BURNER CAN CAUSE THE FRONT BURNER TO PARTIALLY TURN ON RELEASING GAS. IN SOME CASES, THE BURNER WILL ACTUALLY IGNITE POSING A POTENTIAL FOR BURNS FROM A CLOTHING FIRE. THIS ANOMALY OCCURRED SEVERAL TIMES OVER THE PAST YEAR.

I BELIEVE THERE IS A DESIGN DEFECT, IN THAT, THE GAS STARTS FLOWING TOO SOON BEFORE THE IGNITER IS ACTIVATED AND THAT THE FORCE NEEDED TO PUSH IN THE KNOB IS TOO LIGHT.

ON 7/11/2023 KITCHENAID SENT A TECHNICIAN TO EXAMINE THE RANGE. HIS CONCLUSION BASED ON MY UNDERSTANDING WAS THAT THERE WAS NO PROBLEM AND THAT THE RANGE WAS WORKING AS DESIGNED.

ALTHOUGH THE OCCURRENCE OF THIS HAPPENING IS RELATIVELY LOW THE CONSEQUENCES ARE HIGH. THE RESULTING INJURIES FROM BURNS OR EXPLOSIONS COULD BE LIFE THREATING. I HOPE THAT THE COMMISSION WILL TAKE A SERIOUS LOOK INTO THIS ISSUE.

THE CURRENT APPLE IPAD OPERATING SYSTEM DOES NOT INCLUDE A GLOBAL VOLUME CONTROL SETTING FOR THE BUILT-IN SPEAKERS.  AS A RESULT, THE VOLUME LEVEL OF MUSIC, VIDEOS, ETC. IS UNREGULATED FOR THOSE WHO NEED IT TO BE REGULATED.  WHEN THE UNIT IS HELD CLOSE TO THE EAR, THE MAXIMUM VOLUME LEVEL IS SUCH THAT HEARING DAMAGE CAN OCCUR.  THIS IS ESPECIALLY TRUE FOR CHILDREN, DISABLED, AND OTHER VULNERABLE PEOPLE.  WITHOUT A GLOBAL VOLUME CONTROL, PARENTS AND CAREGIVERS CANNOT LIMIT THE EXPOSURE TO THE EXCESSIVE SOUND LEVELS TO THOSE INDIVIDUALS.  APPLE REALIZED THE NEED IN OTHER PRIOR VERSIONS OF THE OPERATING SYSTEM BY INCLUDING A GLOBAL VOLUME CONTROL SETTING, BUT HAS ELIMINATED THAT CONTROL IN THEIR RECENT UPDATES.  THE ISSUE RELATES TO THE OPERATING SYSTEM SOFTWARE VERSION 16 FOR THIS AND ALL OTHER IPADS AND IPHONES.

FOR THE PAST MONTH, MY FAMILY HAS BEEN PURCHASING GROCERIES FROM [REDACTED] AND WE HAVE NOTICED A RECURRING ISSUE WITH THE QUALITY OF THE PRODUCTS, PARTICULARLY REGARDING THE MILK. WE'VE OBSERVED THAT THE MILK CONSISTENTLY GOES BAD WITHIN JUST A FEW DAYS OF PURCHASE. INITIALLY, WE ATTRIBUTED THIS PROBLEM TO [REDACTED], AS THE INTERNAL TEMPERATURE OF OUR SAMSUNG REFRIGERATOR, AS DISPLAYED ON ITS LCD SCREEN, WAS CONSISTENTLY AT 34 DEGREES FAHRENHEIT. IT SEEMED PLAUSIBLE THAT [REDACTED] MIGHT BE SELLING SPOILED MILK. ADDITIONALLY, WE FOUND THAT THE CHEESE WE HAD PURCHASED FROM [REDACTED] HAD RAPIDLY DEVELOPED MOLD AND EMITTED A FOUL ODOR. CONSEQUENTLY, WE OPTED TO EXPLORE ALTERNATIVE GROCERY SHOPPING OPTIONS, BELIEVING THAT THERE MIGHT BE A LAPSE IN QUALITY CONTROL AT [REDACTED].

AROUND A WEEK AGO, OUR 16-YEAR-OLD DAUGHTER FELL SERIOUSLY ILL. SHE WOKE UP IN THE MIDDLE OF THE NIGHT, EXPERIENCING SEVERE VOMITING AND DIARRHEA. AS PARENTS, WE INITIALLY SUSPECTED SHE MIGHT HAVE CONTRACTED THE NOROVIRUS OR A SIMILAR STOMACH BUG, AS WE HAD EXCLUSIVELY CONSUMED FOOD PREPARED AT HOME AND HADN'T EATEN FROM OUTSIDE FOOD SOURCES. OUR DAUGHTER'S RECOVERY TOOK APPROXIMATELY FIVE DAYS BEFORE SHE WAS FIT ENOUGH TO ATTEND SCHOOL AGAIN, HAVING MISSED HER FIRST DAY OF SCHOOL. IT'S NOTEWORTHY THAT WHILE NEITHER PARENT EXPERIENCED ANY ILLNESS, THE POTENTIAL HIGHLY INFECTIOUS NATURE OF THE NOROVIRUS LED US TO CONSIDER THE POSSIBILITY OF FOOD POISONING. IT'S IMPORTANT TO HIGHLIGHT THAT OUR DAUGHTER MAINTAINS A VEGETARIAN DIET, WHICH DIFFERS FROM OUR OWN, AND SHE HAD BEEN CONSUMING DISTINCT FOOD ITEMS. DURING THE TIME OF HER ILLNESS, SHE HAD BEEN CONSUMING FOOD FROM OUR PRIMARY STORAGE AREA, WHILE WE, HER PARENTS, WERE CONSUMING FROZEN FOOD FROM THE FREEZER.

A FEW DAYS LATER, THE MOTHER HAD A BOWL OF CEREAL AND PROMPTLY NOTICED THAT THE MILK HAD ALSO GONE SOUR. THIS MILK HAD BEEN PURCHASED JUST THREE DAYS PRIOR FROM [REDACTED], A PART OF THE [REDACTED] CHAIN, AND THE EXPIRATION DATE WAS STILL A WEEK AWAY. THIS DISCOVERY PROMPTED US TO REALIZE THAT THERE WAS MORE TO THIS SITUATION THAN WE HAD INITIALLY THOUGHT.

IN AN ATTEMPT TO UNDERSTAND THE ROOT CAUSE OF THESE ISSUES, WE PLACED A THERMOMETER IN THE FRIDGE ON THE MIDDLE SHELF. ALTHOUGH THE FRIDGE'S LCD PANEL CONTINUED TO INDICATE A TEMPERATURE OF 34 DEGREES FAHRENHEIT, THE THERMOMETER REGISTERED A SIGNIFICANTLY HIGHER TEMPERATURE OF 54 DEGREES FAHRENHEIT. TO ELIMINATE THE POSSIBILITY OF TEMPERATURE VARIATIONS AT THE FRONT OF THE FRIDGE, WHERE THE DOORS OPEN, WE RELOCATED THE THERMOMETER TO THE BACK. THROUGHOUT THE DAY, THE READINGS CONSISTENTLY RANGED BETWEEN 53 AND 54 DEGREES FAHRENHEIT. DESPITE OUR EFFORTS, UTILIZING THE "POWER COOL" BUTTON ADJACENT TO THE LCD PANEL YIELDED NO POSITIVE RESULTS.

OUR SAMSUNG FRIDGE, WHICH WAS ACQUIRED IN LATE 2015, HAS BEEN A RECURRING SOURCE OF TROUBLE. OVER THE YEARS, WE'VE BEEN COMPELLED TO DEFROST IT ONCE OR TWICE ANNUALLY DUE TO THE ACCUMULATION OF ICE AROUND THE EVAPORATOR COILS, CAUSING THE FAN TO EMIT DISRUPTIVE NOISES. EACH DEFROSTING CYCLE PRODUCES OVER A GALLON OF WATER FROM THE EVAPORATOR COILS. THIS CONSISTENT ISSUE HAS MADE THE FRIDGE A PERSISTENT HEADACHE, AND NOW WE FIND OURSELVES WITH AN EXPENSIVE APPLIANCE THAT IS UNUSABLE AND UNSELLABLE. CONTINUING TO USE THIS FRIDGE POSES A DIRECT DANGER TO THE SAFETY OF OUR FAMILY.

IN RESPONSE TO THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, WE HAVE BEEN FORCED TO DISCARD ALL THE CONTENTS OF THE FRIDGE AND SUBSEQUENTLY PURCHASE NEW GROCERIES, STORING THEM IN AN ICEBOX. UNFORTUNATELY, WE ARE LEFT WITH NO FUNCTIONAL REFRIGERATOR ASIDE FROM AN OLDER MINI FRIDGE SITUATED IN OUR GARAGE.

[REDACTED] INSTRUCTED ME TO BRING THE PUMP TO THEIR COMPANY, ABOUT AN HOUR AWAY.

WATER INTRUSION INTO THE MICRO SWITCH COULD CAUSE A SHORT BETWEEN THE HOT WIRE AND THE ADJUSTING NUT, RESULTING IN AN ELECTRICAL SHOCK TO ANYONE TOUCHING THE ADJUSTMENT NUT. 

I CONTACTED THE 3RD GENERATION OWNER OF THE COMPANY, [REDACTED]. HE ATTEMPTED TO SHIFT THE BLAME FOR THE FAILURE LEADING TO SHOCK ON THE CONSUMER.  WHEN I ASKED WHERE THE SWITCH WAS, HE INDICATED THAT THEY PROBABLY THREW IT AWAY. 

IT IS THE COMPLETE CAVALIER ATTITUDE BY THE COMPANY TOWARDS THIS HAZARDOUS DEFECT IN THEIR DESIGN WHICH LED ME TO REPORT THIS.

I PURCHASED A SAMSUNG REFRIGERATOR, MODEL # RF27T5241, BACK IN AUGUST OF 2022. I KEPT FINDING FLAKES OF SOME SORT COMING OUT OF THE WATER AND SETTLING AT THE BOTTOM OF OUR CUPS AND GLASSES. AT FIRST I THOUGHT THAT MAYBE I DIDN'T FLUSH OUT THE SYSTEM ENOUGH WHEN I FIRST SET IT UP. BUT NO MATTER HOW MUCH WATER I RAN THROUGH IT, THE FLAKES CONTINUED TO SHOW UP. I BOUGHT A COUPLE OF NEW WATER FILTERS FOR IT THINKING THAT MAYBE IT HAD A BAD FILTER IN IT. I REPLACED THE FILTER, AND WE STILL HAD THE SAME PROBLEM. I FINALLY CALLED SAMSUNG AND REPORTED IT TO THEM AND THEY SENT SOMEONE OUT TO MY HOME. THE MAN THEY SENT OUT THE FIRST TIME, PAID MORE ATTENTION TO THE GIRL HE WAS TALKING TO ON THE PHONE THAN HE WAS TO THE ISSUE. HE FIRST SAID, WHAT I WAS SEEING WERE BUBBLES. AFTER I SHOWED HIM THAT THOSE SO CALLED BUBBLES WERE SETTLING AT THE BOTTLE OF THE GLASS, HE INDICATED THAT THE PARTICLES I WAS SEEING HAD TO BE CALCIUM DEPOSITS COMING THROUGH MY WATER SUPPLY. I ADVISED HIM THAT THIS IS THE 3RD REFRIGERATOR I HAVE HAD IN THIS HOME, AND WE NEVER HAD ANY SUCH ISSUE WITH THEM. I ALSO STATED, THAT THE WATER FILTER IN THE REFRIGERATOR SHOULD HAVE CAUGHT THE PARTICLES. HE DENIED THAT AND SAID THAT THE FILTERS DON'T ALWAYS CATCH EVERYTHING. HE ASKED IF I REPLACED THE FILTER WITH A SAMSUNG FILTER, AND I ADVISED HIM THAT I DID. HE OBVIOUSLY DID NOT BELIEVE ME AND (WITHOUT TURNING OFF THE WATER SUPPLY AS THE MANUAL INDICATES), HE PULLED OUT THE FILTER, WATER STARTED FLOWING OUT EVERYWHERE, AND THEN HE SLAMMED THE FILTER BACK IN. SO HE STILL INSISTED IT WAS JUST CALCIUM COMING THROUGH AND LEFT. I HAD TO REPLACE THAT NEW FILTER BECAUSE DARK WATER BEGAN COMING OUT OF THE FILTER. NOT TO MENTION THAT THE FILTER WAS NOT PLACED BACK ON CORRECTLY AND WATER WAS LEAKING ALL OVER THE PLACE. I REPORTED ALL OF THIS TO SAMSUNG, AND THEY SENT SOMEONE ELSE OUT, WHO MORE OR LESS DID SAID THE SAME THING AS THE FIRST ONE. AGAIN, I CALLED SAMSUNG BECAUSE THERE WAS NO WAY WE WERE GOING TO DRINK THAT WATER OR USE THE ICE FROM IT. WHEN I SPOKE WITH SOMEONE FROM SAMSUNG THAT TIME, THE LADY ON THE PHONE ADVISED ME THAT IF SHE SENT SOMEONE OUT, I WOULD HAVE TO PAY FOR IT BECAUSE MY 1 YEAR WARRANTY WAS UP IN APRIL. I ADVISED HER, THAT I BOUGHT THE UNIT IN AUGUST NOT APRIL, AND IF THEY HAVE IT REGISTERED TO SOMEONE ELSE, THE UNIT MUST HAVE BEEN SOLD BEFORE, TAKEN BACK TO LOWE'S, AND RESOLD TO ME. SHE THEN STATED THAT SOMEONE ELSE WILL COME TO THE HOUSE AND CHECK IT OUT AGAIN. SO THE 3RD PERSON CAME TO THE HOME AND GUESS WHAT? HE FOUND THAT THERE WERE SOME DAMAGED PARTS INSIDE THE WATER FILTER SYSTEM AND IT WASN'T CALCIUM COMING THROUGH THE LINE. THE NEXT DAY, I RECEIVED A CALL FROM SAMSUNG, AND WAS TOLD THAT THEY WERE GOING TO SEND ME OUT A NEW UNIT. I ASKED IF I COULD GET A REFUND INSTEAD BECAUSE I REALLY DIDN'T TRUST THEIR PRODUCT IF IT HAS ISSUES THIS EARLY IN THE GAME. THE GENTLEMAN STATED, THAT THE UNIT WILL BE BRAND NEW AND LAST ME FOR YEARS, AND NOT TO WORRY BECAUSE IT WILL BE UNDER A NEW WARRANTY. SO, THEY SENT LOWE'S OUT WITH ANOTHER UNIT AND THIS ONE TURNS OUT TO BE WORST THAN THE LAST ONE. WE RECEIVED THIS ONE ON 06/10/23, AND AT FIRST, EVERYTHING WORKED FINE. BUT RIGHT AROUND THE 1ST OF JULY (THE DAY BEFORE WE LEFT FOR OUR VACATION), WE NOTICED THAT SOME OF THE ICE CUBES IN THE BOTTOM TRAY, WERE STUCK TOGETHER AND IT DIDN'T SEEM TO HAVE MADE MUCH MORE ICE. I THOUGHT BY THE TIME WE RETURNED FROM VACATION, THE TRAY WOULD BE FULL AGAIN. BUT WHEN WE RETURNED, IT DIDN'T MAKE ANYMORE ICE. WE ALSO NOTICED THAT SOME OF THE ITEMS IN THE FREEZER WERE GETTING SOFT. SO I CALLED SAMSUNG AND REPORTED IT TO THEM. THEY HAD ME UNPLUG THE UNIT, WAIT SEVERAL MINUTES, AND THEN PLUG IT BACK IN. I DID THAT AND THE TEMPERATURE INSIDE BOTH THE TOP AND THE BOTTOM OF THE REFRIGERATOR WERE LOWER THAN THEY SHOULD BE. SO, I WAS INSTRUCTED AS TO HOW I COULD RESET THE CORRECT TEMPERATURE ON BOTH THE TOP AND BOTTOM, THEN TOLD IT COULD TAKE UP TO 16 HOURS BEFORE EVERYTHING WAS BACK TO NORMAL AGAIN. WELL, I HAD TO REPEAT THAT OVER AND OVER AGAIN ON THE PHONE WITH THEM UNTIL I GOT FED UP WITH IT ALL. IT WAS APPARENT, THAT THE COMPRESSOR WAS NOT WORKING CORRECTLY. AGAIN, I ASKED FOR A REFUND, BUT WAS DENIED. I ASKED IF THEY WERE GOING TO SEND A NEW UNIT, AND I WAS DENIED THAT TOO. NOW, WE'RE ARE ABOUT TO JULY 21ST WITHOUT A REFRIGERATOR OR FREEZER WORKING PROPERLY, AND I WAS TOLD THAT THEY WILL SEND SOMEBODY OUT TO LOOK AT IT. ON THE 24TH, A MAN CAME OUT TO LOOK AT IT, AND SURE ENOUGH, THE COMPRESSOR WAS OUT. I ASKED IF SAMSUNG WAS GOING TO SEND OUT ANOTHER SINCE WE HAD FOOD GOING BAD, AND HE INDICATED THAT HE WAS GOING TO ORDER THE PARTS FOR IT. I ASKED HOW LONG DOES THAT TAKE, AND HE STATED IT TAKES AT LEAST A WEEK, BUT SAMSUNG IS A LITTLE SLOWER THAN MOST OF THEM. AS SOON AS HE LEFT, I CALLED SAMSUNG AND ADVISED THEM OF WHAT WAS GOING ON, AND COULD I PLEASE HAVE A REFUND OR AN EXCHANGE, AS THIS NOW SEEMS LIKE AN EMERGENCY. AND AGAIN, I WAS DENIED. THEY CAN'T OFFER AN EXCHANGE OR A REFUND, UNTIL AFTER THE UNIT HAS BEEN REPAIRED (LIKE THEY ARE GOING TO REFUND OR EXCHANGE ANYTHING AFTER IT'S UP AND RUNNING AGAIN). I ALSO MENTIONED (BECAUSE DURING CALLS AND WAITING TIMES, I DID SOME RESEARCH, AND FOUND THAT THIS MODEL IS THE SAME AS THE RF27T5201, EXCEPT THE 5241 MODEL HAS THE DUAL ICE MAKERS, HAVE BEEN ON YOUR RECALL LISTS SINCE 2020), THAT THE UNIT HAS BEEN ON A RECALL LIST, AND IT SHOULD BE HANDLED ASAP. I ASKED THEM HOW SOON CAN I EXPECT TO HAVE SOMETHING GOING BECAUSE WE NEED SOMETHING NOW. I WAS THEN TOLD THAT AS SOON AS THE REPAIRMAN COMPLETES HIS REPORT, AND WE RECEIVE IT, WHICH TAKES UP TO 48 HOURS, THEN SAMSUNG WILL MAKE A DECISION AS TO WHAT WILL BE DONE. THERE ISN'T ANYTHING ELSE THE CAN DO UNTIL THEN. SO HERE WE SIT IN THE MIDDLE OF THE SUMMER 100 DEGREE WEATHER WITHOUT A REFRIGERATOR. ABOUT A WEEK LATER, I CALLED THE REPAIR SHOP AND ASKED IF THE PARTS CAME IN YET, AND I WAS TOLD THAT THE PARTS HAD BEEN RECEIVED, BUT THE ONLY PERSON QUALIFIED TO WORK ON IT COULD NOT GET OUT TO MY HOME UNTIL THE FOLLOWING THURSDAY (IT WAS ON A FRIDAY WHEN I CALLED, SO THAT MEANT IT WOULD BE ANOTHER WEEK). WELL, THE FOLLOWING THURSDAY, THE REPAIRMAN CAME BY. ALL HE REALLY DID (THAT I COULD SEE), WAS SHOOT SOME FREON INTO THE SYSTEM. THE REPAIRMAN STATED THAT THE UNIT WASN'T PROPERLY FILLED CORRECTLY FROM THE FACTORY. THEN I WAITED ABOUT A WEEK BEFORE CALLING SAMSUNG BACK BECAUSE ONE OF THE PEOPLE THAT I FIRST SPOKEN WITH WHEN I CALLED ABOUT THESE ISSUES, TOLD ME TO MAKE A LIST OF ALL THE FOOD THAT GETS SPOILED BECAUSE SAMSUNG WILL GIVE ME A FOOD VOUCHER TO REPLACE IT ALL. I ADVISED MY OTHER HALF AS TO WHAT I WAS TOLD, SO SHE BEGAN MAKING A LIST. NOW, WE USUALLY ONLY SHOP ONCE A MONTH BECAUSE WE ARE ON FIXED INCOMES, SO AT THE TIME THIS ALL BEGAN, WE HAD ALREADY DONE ALL OF THAT SHOPPING. THE UNIT WAS VERY FULL BOTH TOP AND BOTTOM. WHEN I SPOKE WITH AN AGENT FROM SAMSUNG ABOUT HAVING A LIST, HE ASKED ME TO SEND THE LIST TO HIM, AND I DID. I FIGURED WITH ALL THE MEATS, SEAFOOD, AND POULTRY ALONE WOULD BE AN EASY $250.00. THEN MOST LIKELY ANOTHER, AT LEAST $200.00 WITH EVERYTHING ELSE WE HAD IN THERE. THE AGENT OFFERED ME $200.00. I TOLD HIM HE MUST BE OUT OF HIS MIND. HE SAID THAT'S ALL HE CAN OFFER BECAUSE SAMSUNG DOESN'T COVER THIS AND THAT AND THE OTHER (LIKE EVERYTHING ELSE WE HAD TO REPLACE WAS GOING TO BE FREE). I BROUGHT UP AGAIN THAT WITH ALL WE HAVE BEEN THROUGH WITH BOTH OF THEIR REFRIGERATORS, I WOULD STILL PREFER A REFUND BECAUSE EVEN AFTER THIS ONE HAD BEEN FIXED, I DO NOT TRUST SAMSUNG'S REFRIGERATORS. AGAIN, HE SAID ALL HE COULD DO WAS GIVE ME $200.00. I WAS SO UPSET WITH HIM, THAT I TOLD HIM THAT WAS NOT ACCEPTABLE, IN FACT, ALL HE DID WAS INSULT ME AND I COULD NOT DEAL WITH HIM ANY FURTHER AND I HUNG UP THE PHONE. BUT AS TO HOW THE REFRIGERATOR IS WORKING NOW, WELL, THE TEMPERATURES ON BOTH THE TOP AND BOTTOM (BECAUSE I PURCHASED MY OWN THERMOMETERS), HAVE BEEN GOING UP AND DOWN AND NOT KEEPING A CONSTANT TEMPERATURES. I THINK THAT I BETTER START SAVING MY MONEY TO BUY A NEW REFRIGERATOR TO REPLACE THIS SAMSUNG UNIT.
