MY CHILD'S ELEMENTARY SCHOOL MADE CAMPUS IMPROVEMENTS DURING THE SUMMER OF 2022. ONE OF THESE CHANGES WAS ADDING A MATERIAL THAT CONSISTS OF CHUNKY [REDACTED] AND URETHANE AS A BINDER. THE PRODUCT COMBINATION IS NOT SOLD TOGETHER. RATHER, THE CONTRACTOR MIXES THE TWO MATERIALS AND THEN LAYS IT DOWN OVER A GRAVEL BASE. [REDACTED] (THE COMPANY) DOES NOT WARRANTY THE MIXTURE. THIS WAS INSTALLED IN TWO LOCATIONS ON CAMPUS AND ALSO IN AT LEAST ONE OTHER LOCATION IN A NEIGHBORING ELEMENTARY SCHOOL IN THE DISTRICT.
THE MATERIAL SMELLED REALLY BAD WHEN INSTALLED. THE OUTDOOR SPACE GETS ESPECIALLY HOT IN ONE LOCATION ON CAMPUS WHERE IT WAS INSTALLED AND THE LOCATION IS DIRECTLY OUTSIDE OF TWO CLASSROOMS AND NEARBY SEVERAL OTHERS. THE TEACHERS TEND TO LEAVE THEIR DOORS OPEN FOR EXTRA AIR FLOW SO THE SMELL TRAVELLED INTO THE CLASSROOMS AS WELL.
NOW A YEAR LATER IT STILL SMELLS REALLY BADLY. THE ODOR BURNS MY NOSTRILS AND A STUDENT RECENTLY TOLD HIS MOM THAT IT MADE HIM NAUSEOUS. MY OWN DAUGHTER SAID IT GAVE HER A HEADACHE.
THE SCHOOL DISTRICT TOOK NO ACTION WHEN I ALERTED THEM AND INSTEAD SAID THAT IT WAS INSTALLED ACCORDING TO SPECIFICATIONS FROM THE LANDSCAPE DESIGNER. THERE WAS NO INDICATION THAT THEY WOULD COVER IT OR OTHERWISE TRY TO MITIGATE THE SMELL.
BESIDES THE SMELL THOUGH THERE IS THE FACT THAT THE CHUNKS OF RUBBER FALL OFF THE MATERIAL. THE KIDS WERE PLAYING WITH IT IN ANOTHER SPACE WHERE IT WAS INSTALLED - OUR SCHOOL GARDEN.
THE TWO AREAS ARE LABELLED AS OUTDOOR CLASSROOM SPACE SO THEY ARE MEANT TO BE USED BY KIDS TO SPEND TIME THERE. ONE SPACE, THE HOTTER ONE, IS OUTSIDE OF THE STEAM LAB CLASSROOM. THE WINDOWS OF THIS CLASSROOM FACE THE RUBBER AREA AS WELL. THE OTHER AREA IS IN THE SCHOOL GARDEN WHERE KIDS COME DURING LUNCH TIME TO DO GARDENING ACTIVITIES AND THE RUBBER AREA HAS TREE STUMPS FOR SITTING WHEN THE AREA EVENTUALLY GETS USED FOR MORE CLASSROOM RELATED ACTIVITIES.
I HAVE RECORDED THE TEMPERATURE OF THESE SURFACES AS WELL AND ON A 67 DEGREE DAY, THE SURFACE WAS 135 DEGREES. I HAVEN'T CHECKED THE TEMPERATURES IN HOTTER WEATHER.
UNFORTUNATELY, I DO NOT KNOW IF OTHER KIDS HAVE REPORTED THE SMELL OR FEELING ILL FROM THE SMELL. I AM A PARENT VOLUNTEER.
I WANT TO REPORT THIS PRODUCT BECAUSE I DO NOT THINK IT IS AN ACCEPTABLE SMELL FOR THE SCHOOL KIDS AND TEACHERS TO HAVE TO INHALE FOR HOURS IN A DAY PARTICULARLY THOSE CLOSER TO THE AREA OF THE HOTTER STEAM LAB YARD. PRODUCT IS ANKER POWERHOUSE 767, ORDERED FROM SELLER "ANKERDIRECT" ON EBAY (IDENTIFIES AS FANTASIA TRADING, LLC), APPARENTLY A WHOLLY OWNED SUBSIDIARY OF ANKER INNOVATIONS LIMITED.  THE PRODUCT IS AN ALL IN ONE PORTABLE POWER STATION (LITHIUM IRON PHOSPHATE BATTERY PACK, INVERTER, AND ASSOCIATED ELECTRONICS) WHICH CONTROLS BATTERY CHARGING AND SUBSEQUENT OUTPUT OF STORED ENERGY THROUGH AN INVERTER TO PROVIDE POWER TO HOUSEHOLD ELECTRICAL DEVICES WHICH RUN ON ALTERNATING CURRENT.  IT IS MARKETED TO PEOPLE DESIRING A SOURCE OF ELECTRICAL POWER DURING A UTILITY POWER OUTAGE (AMONG OTHERS).  I FIRST TESTED THE UNIT BY PLUGGING  THREE DEVICES INTO IT: CABLE MODEM, WIRELESS ROUTER, AND ETHERNET SWITCH.  THE ROUTER AND SWITCH POWERED UP, THE MODEM ([REDACTED]) DID NOT.  WHEN PLUGGED INTO A HOUSEHOLD 120-VOLT RECEPTACLE, THE MODEM POWERED UP NORMALLY.  HAVING EXTENSIVE ELECTRICAL EXPERIENCE IN MY 76 YEARS, I BEGAN INVESTIGATING BY PLUGGING IN MY $5 THREE-LIGHT 120-VOLT RECEPTACLE TESTER, AND FOUND (TO MY AMAZEMENT) HOT AND NEUTRAL REVERSED ON THIS $2000 PIECE OF GEAR.  AN ONLINE SEARCH OF "120 VOLT RECEPTACLE HOT NEUTRAL REVERSED" WILL AMPLY DESCRIBE WHY THIS IS INCORRECT AND DANGEROUS, SO I WON'T GO INTO THAT HERE.  I THEN SEARCHED ONLINE FORUMS TO SEE IF ANYBODY WAS TALKING ABOUT SUCH A PROBLEM, AND FOUND MULTIPLE EXAMPLES OF PEOPLE WITH THE SAME EXPERIENCE WHO HAD MADE THE COMPANY AWARE OF THE PROBLEM, AND RECEIVED REPLACEMENT UNITS WITHOUT THE PROBLEM.  OTHERS WHO BOUGHT UNITS LONG AFTER THE PROBLEM WAS MADE KNOWN TO THE COMPANY, AND SUPPOSEDLY FIXED, REPORTED RECEIVING UNITS WITH THE PROBLEM.  APPARENTLY, THE COMPANY PRODUCED MANY UNITS, WITH THE PROBLEM BUILT INTO A RANDOM SUBSET OF THE UNITS, DUE TO INADEQUATE INSTRUCTIONS AND SUBSEQUENT TESTING.  THEN THE UNITS WERE SENT TO MULTIPLE STOCK POINTS.  UPON LEARNING OF THE PROBLEM, THE APPROPRIATE ACTION BY THE COMPANY WOULD HAVE BEEN A RECALL AND "STOP SALE" ORDER, SINCE DETECTING THE PROBLEM IS EASY AND CHEAP.  THE COMPLICATING FACTORS ARE THAT THE UNIT WEIGHS 67 POUNDS, AND THE PACKAGING IS HEAVY DUTY AND STRAPPED FOR [REDACTED] SHIPMENT, AND THE MULTIPLE STOCK POINTS.  OPENING THE SHIPMENT UNITS TO DO THE SIMPLE TEST IS TAXING, SO THUS FAR, THE COMPANY HAS JUST CONTINUED TO SHIP OUT UNITS LIKE THERE IS NO PROBLEM, AND REPLACE THE PROBLEM UNITS AS THEY ARE IDENTIFIED AND RETURNED.  THE PROBLEM WITH THIS APPROACH IS THAT MANY DEVICES WILL OPERATE IN WHAT APPEARS TO BE NORMAL FASHION, BUT WITH THE RISK OF ELECTRICAL SHOCK THAT COMES WITH THE REVERSED LEADS.  THE TYPICAL CUSTOMER MAY HAVE NO DEVICES (AS I DID) THAT CHECK FOR THE REVERSAL AND REFUSE TO POWER UP.  THE TYPICAL CUSTOMER WILL HAVE NO EXPERIENCE THAT LEADS THEM TO LOOK FOR SUCH A PROBLEM, AND NO TOOLS TO IDENTIFY IT, AND WILL SUFFER THE RISK WITHOUT ANY WARNING.

ON APRIL 24, 2023, I WAS MOWING MY LAWN WITH THE EGO ELECTRIC LAWNMOWER MODEL LM2135SP THAT I HAD PURCHASED ON APRIL 4. I WAS MOWING ACROSS AN INCLINE WHEN, WHILE CHANGING DIRECTIONS, THE LAWNMOWER CAUGHT ON GRASS, CAUSING ME TO SLIP. AS I DID, THE LAWNMOWER CAME UP AND LANDED ON MY FOOT, SEVERING MY BIG TOE AND THE TOP HALF OF THE ADJACENT TOE.

WHEN I POSTED A NEGATIVE REVIEW ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE ONLINE, THE COMPANY REACHED OUT TO ME, AND THEN TOLD ME THEY'D FOLLOW UP WITH ME IN TWO TO THREE WEEKS. THEY NEVER FOLLOWED UP ON THEIR OWN, EVEN WHEN I TRIED TO MAKE CONTACT WITH THEM A MONTH LATER, AND ONLY RECENTLY RESPONDED WHEN I THREATENED LEGAL ACTION. THEY TOLD ME THAT I HAD IGNORED A WARNING LABEL THAT SAID NOT TO MOW ON SLOPES.

THE MANUAL DOES NOT SAY TO AVOID MOWING SLOPES, WHICH IS WHY I WAS CONFUSED WHEN THE REPRESENTATIVE CLAIMED IT DID, AND WONDERED IF I'D MISREMEMBERED THE INSTRUCTIONS; IT SAYS TO USE EXTRA CAUTION AROUND SLOPES, AND TO AVOID MOWING SLOPES GREATER THAN 15 DEGREES. IN ADDITION, INSTRUCTIONS FURTHER DOWN, ON PAGE 9, MENTION MOWING ACROSS (WHICH I WAS DOING) AND ALSO MENTIONED EXERCISING CAUTION WHILE CHANGING DIRECTIONS (WHICH I WAS TRYING TO DO).
I UNDERSTOOD THE INSTRUCTIONS TO MEAN THAT YOU SHOULD NOT MOW WHILE MOVING MORE THAN 15 DEGREES UP OR DOWN. I WAS MOWING ACROSS - IT'S ALREADY MUCH MORE EFFICIENT THAN GOING UP AND DOWN ON MY LAWN - AND I MOVED DOWN TO CHANGE DIRECTIONS AND MOW THE NEXT LINE. GIVEN THAT THE INSTRUCTIONS TELL YOU TO EXERCISE EXTREME CAUTION WHEN CHANGING DIRECTIONS, I ASSUMED THIS WAS EXPECTED (AS YOU ARE NOT TOLD NOT TO CHANGE DIRECTIONS AT ALL).

I AM AN AIRCRAFT MECHANIC. FOLLOWING INSTRUCTIONS IS A PART OF EVERY JOB I DO. BECAUSE OF THIS, I'VE SEEN A LOT OF AMBIGUOUS INSTRUCTIONS WITH POTENTIAL INTERPRETATIONS THAT ARE USELESS OR COUNTERPRODUCTIVE. WHEN I MISINTERPRET AMBIGUOUS INSTRUCTIONS, I'M ABLE TO EXPLAIN EXACTLY WHAT ABOUT THE INSTRUCTIONS ALLOWS FOR THEM TO BE MISINTERPRETED. IN THIS CASE, IT'S THAT THE INSTRUCTIONS "DO NOT MOW SLOPES GREATER THAN 15 DEGREES" DOES NOT SPECIFY WHETHER "GREATER THAN 15 DEGREES" APPLIES TO THE SLOPE OR THE ACTION OF MOWING.

I AM ALSO A RELATIVELY NEW HOMEOWNER, BEING THE FIRST IN MY FAMILY TO OWN ONE, AND THIS HAS BEEN THE FIRST TIME I'VE LIVED IN AREAS WITH LAWNS. I HAD OWNED MY HOME FOR ABOUT 6 MONTHS WHEN I GOT MY LAWNMOWER. I KNEW LITTLE ABOUT MOWING LAWNS BESIDES THAT A LAWNMOWER WAS THE STANDARD TOOL. MY NEIGHBORS HAD CUT GRASS ON THEIR INCLINES; AND BOROUGH REGULATIONS MANDATED THAT MY GRASS WAS CUT. GIVEN THAT I HAD NEVER SEEN ANYONE USE A TOOL FOR CUTTING LAWNS BESIDES A LAWNMOWER, AND THAT MY NEIGHBORS HAVE CONSISTENTLY HAD CUT GRASS ON THEIR INCLINES, THERE WAS NOTHING TO MAKE ME QUESTION MY USE OF THE LAWNMOWER FOR THAT PURPOSE.
THAT IS, ALL THE CONTEXT I HAD LEF ME TO INTERPRET THE INSTRUCTIONS TO MEAN AVOIDING MOWING A SLOPE WHILE MOVING AT A 15-DEGREE ANGLE UP OR DOWN, AS, BASED ON WHAT I SAW AND KNEW, SIMPLY NOT MOWING MY INCLINE AT ALL DIDN'T SEEM RIGHT WHEN MY NEIGHBORS HAD MOWED INCLINES, AND THE INSTRUCTIONS EMPHASIZING CAUTION WHEN CHANGING DIRECTIONS ON SLOPES (AS OPPOSED TO TELLING YOU NOT TO DO SO) SUGGESTED TO ME THAT MOVING TO CHANGE DIRECTIONS LIKE I DID WAS AN EXPECTED ACTION.

THE INSTRUCTIONS COULD BE WRITTEN IN WAYS THAT MAKE THEM LESS AMBIGUOUS, SUCH AS:

"DO NOT MOW SLOPES *THAT ARE* GREATER THAN 15 DEGREES." (THIS SPECIFIES THAT IT'S THE GRADIENT OF THE SLOPE ITSELF, AND NOT THE ACTION OF MOWING, THAT SHOULDN'T BE GREATER THAN 15 DEGREES.)
"DO NOT MOW SLOPES *WHICH HAVE A GRADIENT* GREATER THAN 15 DEGREES." (THIS SPECIFIES 15 DEGREES AS A PROPERTY OF THE SLOPE.)

I AM REPORTING TWO INCIDENTS SPANNING APX 4 MONTHS, BECAUSE DESPITE SEVERAL EMAILS TO BERTAZZONI CUSTOMER CARE, CUSTOMER SERVICE, AFTER SALE SERVICE AND WHAT TURNED OUT TO BE THE MARKETING DIVISION, THE ONLY REPLY WAS FROM MARKETING.  I EMAILED CUSTOMER SUPPORT AT BERTAZZONI ON APRIL 14, 2023 REGARDING A COOLING FAN, WHEREBY A WIRE WAS RUBBING INTO THE BLADE, CAUSING CUTS TO THE BLADE AND THE WIRE, HENCE IT'S FAILURE.  I WROTE TO BERTAZZONI THAT THIS SHOULD HAVE BEEN PICKED UP IN THEIR INSPECTION PROCESS BECAUSE THE FAN WAS VERY LOUD.  WE HAVE NEVER OWNED ANYTHING LIKE THIS AND SIMPLY ASSUMED THAT'S THE WAY A PROFESSIONAL MODEL SOUNDS, HOWEVER I RECEIVED NO REPLY.  THE CUTTING OF THE WIRE CERTAINLY COULD HAVE CAUSED A SHORT, THIS BEING A CLEAR INDICATION OF "FAULTY WIRING" AND NOT A COMPONENT FAILURE. 

THE SECOND INCIDENT WAS WHEN THE SMALL SIDE OVEN BLEW UP AT 330 DEG. F, AS THE UNIT WAS REACHING A TEMPERATURE OF 350DEG. F, (I PLACE AN OVEN THERMOMETER IN THE UNIT, AS THIS DOESN'T HAVE ONE). I WAS STANDING IN FRONT OF THE UNIT, WHEN I HEARD A LOUD ROCKING BOOM, AND TURNED TO SEE A BRIGHT WHITE LIGHT IN THE ELECTRIC OVEN.  I IMMEDIATELY TURNED OFF THE OVEN, OPENED THE DOOR AND SMOKE BILLOWED OUT.

WE HAD THE SAME REPAIRMAN OUT AND HE INDICATED IT WAS DUE TO THE BAKING ELEMENT (COIL).  AFTER HE REMOVED THE FLOOR PLATE FROM THE OVEN, YOU COULD SEE WHERE THE INSULATION WAS BURNED THROUGH TO THE BOTTOM SPANNING A DISTANCE OF APX 11" LONG AND 2.5" WIDE. HIS HELPER INDICATED HE JUST VIEWED A SAFETY VIDEO WHERE THIS TYPE OF FIRE CAN CONTINUE TO BURN, EVEN AFTER THE UNIT IS UNPLUGGED. UPON DOING MY OWN RESEARCH, IT IS WRITTEN THAT THE PRIMARY CAUSE OF THIS INCIDENT IS "FAULTY WIRING". NEEDLESS TO SAY I WAS VERY SHAKEN, KNOWING THIS UNIT MAY BE COMPROMISED AND NOW FEELING UNSAFE USING THE PRIMARY OVEN WHICH IS MUCH LARGER. AS OF THIS WRITING, WE ARE WAITING ON THIS COMPONENT AS IT IS OUT OF STOCK AND ON A 4 WEEK BACK ORDER. THE PART IS ORDERED THROUGH BERTAZZONI. 
 I SHOULD ADD THE UNIT IS ONE YEAR OUT OF A 2 YEAR MANUFACTURERS WARRANTY, (3 YRS OLD), HOWEVER, AS PREVIOUSLY MENTIONED, THIS ISN'T PRODUCT FAILURE. IN MY OPINION, THE REASON I HAVEN'T RECEIVED ONE REPLY IS THAT NO ONE WANTS TO TOUCH THIS WITH A 10 FOOT POLE, SO THE SAYING GOES.

TO COMPLETE THE QUESTIONS, I WAS NOT HURT, I AM THE PRIMARY USER. THIS MODEL IS MANUFACTURED FOR HOME USE, NOT COMMERCIAL.

THE COMPANY ELECTROLUX WHO MAKES FRIGIDAIRE NEED'S TO CONDUCT A RECALL ON THIS PRODUCT BEFORE A KITCHEN FIRE IS STARTED AS THIS IS A MAJOR HEALTH AND SAFETY ISSUE AT THIS POINT.

A CHAMPION POWER EQUIPMENT CHIPPER/SHREDDER, MODEL 200946, BURST INTO FLAMES AFTER ABOUT FIVE HOURS OF USE FROM NEW OVER SEVERAL WEEKS.  AFTER THE FIRST COUPLE HOURS OF USE I NOTICED THAT THE AIR CLEANER ASSEMBLY, WHICH IS PLASTIC AND NEAR THE MUFFLER, HAD MELTED.  I CALLED CHAMPION SUPPORT.  THEY TOLD ME NOT TO WORRY AND SOLD ME A NEW AIR CLEANER ASSEMBLY WHICH I INSTALLED.  AFTER ANOTHER COUPLE HOURS OF USE, THE IGNITION COIL, WHICH IS ALSO NEAR THE MUFFLER, MELTED AT THE PLASTIC PART THAT CONNECTS TO THE SPARK PLUG.  AGAIN I CALLED CHAMPION SUPPORT.  AGAIN THEY TOLD ME NOT TO WORRY AND SENT ME A REPLACEMENT IGNITION COIL WHICH I INSTALLED.  AFTER 45 MINUTES OF USE THE UNIT BURST INTO FLAMES.  THERE IS A FUEL LINE THAT RUNS NEAR THE MUFFLER.  THE FUEL LINE HAD MELTED AND GASOLINE POURED ONTO THE ENGINE.  FORTUNATELY, I HAD A FULL JUG OF WATER AND WAS ABLE TO EXTINGUISH THE FLAMES BEFORE THE FUEL TANK EXPLODED OR THE FLAMES SPREAD TO THE VEGETATION OR I WAS INJURED.  MY THREE ATTEMPTS TO CONTACT CHAMPION AND ASK THAT THEY INVESTIGATE THE CAUSE OF THE FIRE HAVE GONE UNANSWERED.  IT SEEMS TO ME THAT A RESPONSIBLE CORPORATION WOULD WANT TO KNOW IF THE FIRE WAS A RESULT OF SOMETHING UNIQUE TO MY UNIT OR IS A DESIGN FLAW THAT MAY AFFECT ALL OF THEIR POWER EQUIPMENT THAT USES THIS ENGINE. ON 8/2/23, I WAS USING A PORTLAND 22" ELECTRIC BLADED HEDGE TRIMMER (SKU 62630) MANUFACTURED/SOLD BY HARBOR FREIGHT, WHEN I SUFFERED SEVERE LACERATIONS TO THE FINGERS ON MY LEFT HAND.  I WAS USING THIS TRIMMER OUTSIDE OF MY HOME, AS INTENDED, TO TRIM OVERGROWN HEDGES.  PRIOR TO MY INJURY, I HAD ENGAGED THE TRIGGER AND "SAFETY SWITCH" TO START THE TRIMMER, AS BOTH MUST BE ACTIVATED TO START THE DEVICE.  THE "SAFETY SWITCH" ON THE TRIMMER IS LOCATED ON THE FRONT HANDLE, WHERE THE SAME HAND MUST BE USED TO HOLD THE TRIMMER.  FOR THIS REASON, I CONTINUED TO ACTIVATE THE ?SAFETY SWITCH? AND TRIGGER DURING MY USE OF THE TRIMMER, AS I PRESUMED THAT DISENGAGING THE ?SAFETY SWITCH? WOULD STOP THE BLADES.

WHILE USING THE TRIMMER, MY LEFT HAND CAME OFF OF THE FRONT HANDLE AND THE ?SAFETY SWITCH,? AND THE HEDGER FELL TOWARDS MY LEFT HAND - BUT THE BLADES CONTINUED TO RUN.  THIS CAUSED SEVERE LACERATIONS TO MY FINGERS AND BLOOD LOSS, FOR WHICH I RECEIVED APPROXIMATELY 35 STITCHES AT THE EMERGENCY ROOM.  I HAVE LOST FEELING IN THE TIPS OF MY FINGERS AND, DUE TO THE SEVERITY OF THE LACERATIONS, AS WELL AS BONE FRAGMENTS, I AM AWAITING SURGERY.

THIS PRODUCT IS UNREASONABLY DANGEROUS.  UNBEKNOWNST TO USERS, THE BLADE OF THE TRIMMER CONTINUES TO RUN EVEN WHEN THE "SAFETY SWITCH" IS DISENGAGED.  THERE IS NO SUCH WARNING ON THE TRIMMER ITSELF OR IN THE PRODUCT MANUAL.  TO THE CONTRARY, THE USER IS LED TO BELIEVE (I.E. AS WITH A LAWNMOWER OR CHAINSAW) THAT IF BOTH MECHANISMS ARE REQUIRED TO START THE TRIMMER, THEN RELEASING THE "SAFETY SWITCH" WILL LIKEWISE STOP THE BLADES.  THUS, WHEN I DISENGAGED THE ?SAFETY SWITCH,? THE BLADES SHOULD HAVE STOPPED SUCH THAT MY INJURY WOULD NEVER HAVE OCCURRED.  THESE DANGERS ARE CONCEALED FROM THE USER AND THE ALLEGED ?SAFETY SWITCH? DOES NOT FUNCTION AS EXPECTED.

I WAS OPERATING A TRIGGER-START BERNZOMATIC TS4000 TORCH TO LIGHT A WOOD PELLET STOVE.  THE TORCH IS MOUNTED TO A HAND-HELD GAS CYLINDER.  NORMALLY, IN ORDER TO LIGHT THE TORCH, THE RED IGNITION KNOB MUST FIRST BE TURNED TO THE UNLOCK/ON POSITION.  THE TORCH IGNITES ONCE THE UNLOCKED IGNITION SWITCH IS DEPRESSED.  RELEASING THE IGNITION BUTTON AUTOMATICALLY EXTINGUISHES THE FLAME.  THE LOCKING FEATURE OF THE IGNITION SWITCH IS A SAFETY FEATURE PREVENTING INADVERTENT IGNITION.  ON THIS PARTICULAR EVENING, I INADVERTENTLY DEPRESSED THE LOCKED/OFF IGNITION BUTTON AND THE TORCH IGNITED.  RELEASING THE IGNITION SWITCH DID NOT EXTINGUISH THE FLAME BECAUSE THE IGNITION SWITCH WAS STILL IN A LOCKED POSITION.   I WAS HOLDING A FLAMING TORCH THAT I COULD NOT SHUT OFF.  THE TORCH IGNITION SWITCH WAS STUCK IN THE LOCKED POSITION THE ENTIRE TIME AND EVEN TO THIS DAY CANNOT BE UNLOCKED.   FINALLY, TO EXTINGUISH THE FLAME, I CHOSE THE OPTION OF UNSCREWING THE TORCH FROM THE GAS CYLINDER.
FORTUNATELY, THERE WERE NO INJURIES.  THIS EVENT SHOULD NEVER HAVE HAPPENED.   THERE SHOULD BE NO WAY TO OVERRIDE A SAFETY FEATURE AND IGNITE A GAS TORCH BY PRESSING THE IGNITION SWITCH WHICH IS CLEARLY IN THE LOCKED POSITION.   TO COMPOUND THE PROBLEM THERE WAS NO WAY TO UNLOCK THE IGNITION SWITCH.

I NOTICED THAT MY DEVICE (UBIQUITI UNIFI CLOUD KEY GEN 2 PLUS) WHICH WAS EQUIPPED WITH AN INTERNAL BATTERY NO LONGER PROVIDED BACKUP POWER.  UPON RESEARCHING THE SITUATION I SAW NUMEROUS REPORTS OF BATTERY SWELLING WITH THESE UNITS, SO I CONTACTED SUPPORT.  SUPPORT REFUSED TO DO ANYTHING ABOUT IT STATING IT WAS OUTSIDE OF THE WARRANTY PERIOD, EVEN THOUGH I WAS SIMPLY REQUESTING THAT THEY REPAIR IT FOR AN OUT-OF-WARRANTY FEE.  FRUSTRATED I DECIDED TO REMOVE THE BATTERY MYSELF AND I DISCOVERED THAT THE BATTERY WAS SEVERELY SWOLLEN, DOUBLE THE ORIGINAL THICKNESS ON ONE CELL.  THE HEAT GENERATED BY THESE DEVICES EXASPERATES THE PROBLEM AND SOONER OR LATER THE OTHER CELL WAS GOING TO SWELL AS WELL.  THIS COULD HAVE CAUSED ANYTHING FROM LEAKING ELECTROLYTE AND INTERNAL DAMAGE TO THE DEVICE TO EXTERNAL SMOKE AND HEAT DAMAGE, UP TO AND INCLUDING A FIRE HAZARD.  I HAVE REMOVED THE DEFECTIVE BATTERY AND THE UNIT IS NOW SAFE, BUT THE COMPANY REFUSED TO DO ANYTHING ABOUT IT AND THEY ARE POTENTIALLY PUTTING PEOPLE AT RISK.  THE OFFICIAL RECOMMENDATION I GOT FROM THEIR SUPPORT TEAM WAS THIS:  "AS YOU MENTIONED THE POSSIBILITY OF A SWOLLEN BATTERY, IT'S IMPORTANT TO NOTE THAT IN SUCH CASES, VISIBLE SIGNS OF SWELLING WOULD TYPICALLY BE SEEN ON THE CLOUD KEY ITSELF. SINCE YOUR CLOUD KEY IS STILL FUNCTIONAL, WE ENCOURAGE YOU TO CONTINUE USING IT."  THE CASE IS MADE OF 2MM THICK ALUMINUM AND IS INCAPABLE OF SWELLING WITH THE BATTERY SO THERE IS NO POSSIBLE WAY ASIDE OF DISASSEMBLY TO DETERMINE IF THE PROBLEM EXISTS.  ALSO THE FACT THAT THEY SUGGEST TO CONTINUE USING THE DEVICE WITH A KNOWN SAFETY DEFECT IS ALARMING.  INSTEAD THEY SHOULD BE REPAIRING THESE UNDER AN EXTENDED WARRANTY PERIOD GIVEN THEY RECOGNIZED THE PROBLEM AS A DESIGN FLAW AND NO LONGER INCLUDE BATTERIES IN NEW VERSIONS OF THE PRODUCT.

SO, OUR 60-LB DOG WAS DX?D WITH ATYPICAL HYPOTHYROIDISM THIS PAST MAY, 2023  & STARTED ON THYRO MEDS. HE DID GREAT. THEN ~5-6 WEEKS LATER, MID-JUNE, HE BEGAN DISPLAYING INCREASINGLY WORRISOME NEUROLOGICAL SYMPTOMS (SX), WHICH BEGAN WITH CONFUSION, NYSTAGMUS, AN EYE SQUINT (I?D INITIALLY THOUGHT MAYBE HE?D SCRATCHED IT ON A HIKE, BUT THEN THE OTHER SX PRESENTED & WORSENED), A SERIOUS FLINCH/HEAD DIP WHENEVER WE?D REACH TOWARD HIM AS IF HE WAS EXPERIENCING DEPTH PERCEPTION DIFFICULTY, A PRONOUNCED HEAD TILT/WOBBLE, DIFFICULTY WALKING (ATAXIA), UNCOORDINATION, WEAKNESS, BODY SORES. WHEN WE CONSULTED OUR VET, WE BOTH WONDERED IF THE NEW MEDS MAY BE THE CAUSE, SO WE STOPPED THEM. HOWEVER, THE SX ALL WORSENED THAT WEEK, TO THE POINT HE WAS CRYING FREQUENTLY, SLEEPING/STAYING IN BED A LOT, WALKING SIDEWAYS WITH A SIDEWINDER-LIKE WALK (AN INABILITY TO WALK FORWARD IN A STRAIGHT PATH AT TIMES), & FAIRLY UNABLE TO NAVIGATE HIS WORLD HERE, BUT WE NOTED HE WOULD GET A BIT BETTER ONCE WE WERE OUTSIDE ON OUR DAILY WALKS, OR JUST OUTSIDE IN GENERAL. SO, THE THYRO MEDS WERE RESTARTED, PER THE VET, ALONG W/ PREDNISONE, IN CASE IT WAS A TUMOR, OR SIMILAR, UNTIL OUR APPT WITH THE NEUROLOGIST A COUPLE OF WEEKS OUT. A FEW DAYS LATER, WE DECIDED TO ALL GO AWAY FOR 4TH OF JULY. WITHIN A DAY, HIS SX ALL RADICALLY DECREASED THERE. 1-2 DAYS LATER HIS SX WERE PRETTY MUCH GONE. WE COUNTED OUR BLESSINGS THAT HE HAD GREATLY IMPROVED, & FIGURED MAYBE HE?D HAD ANOTHER EPISODE SIMILAR TO ONE HE?D HAD LATE DECEMBER, 2022, ALTHOUGH IT WASN?T EXACTLY THE SAME EXPERIENCE (AND WE NOW SUSPECT THE DECEMBER EPISODE MAY HAVE BEEN THE FIRST ONE RELATED TO THE BATH & BODY WORKS WALLFLOWERS HOME FRAGRANCE PLUGINS B/C I STARTED USING THEM MORE REGULARLY AROUND THE EARLY WINTER HOLIDAYS). AFTER RETURNING BACK HOME A FEW DAYS LATER (AROUND 7 PM), HE AGAIN DISPLAYED THE SAME SX THE NEXT MORNING (12 HOURS!). SO, I FIGURED, IT?S SOMETHING IN THIS HOUSE PRECIPITATING THESE SX. MY FIRST THOUGHT WAS THE MULTIPLE B&BW WALLFLOWERS PLUG-INS I?D RECENTLY REPLACED. I PULLED ALL OF THEM OUT OF THE ELECTRICAL OUTLETS, AND AIRED OUT THE WHOLE HOUSE. WITHIN A DAY, HIS SX IMPROVED. 2 DAYS LATER, AND THE SX WERE VIRTUALLY GONE. I CAN?T SAY FOR CERTAIN IT WAS THE PLUG-INS, BUT MY HUSBAND & I ARE FAIRLY CONVINCED IT WAS. THE SIGNIFICANT PHYSICAL CHANGES WHEN AWAY FROM HOME, AND THEN AGAIN UPON RETURN TO THE HOME WERE SO DRAMATIC & PRONOUNCED, IT PRACTICALLY CRIED IT OUT LOUD TO US. SINCE THEN, I?VE DONE A FAIR AMOUNT OF READING ABOUT THESE TYPES OF PRODUCTS, & I?VE LEARNED THEY CONTAIN LOTS OF TOXIC CHEMICALS. THINGS LIKE (BUT NOT LIMITED TO) FORMALDEHYDE, PHTHALATES, VOLATILE ORGANIC CHEMICALS (VOCS), & PROPYLENE GLYCOL (WHICH IS BANNED IN THE EU), ALONG WITH ESSENTIAL OILS, MANY OF WHICH ARE TOXIC FOR CATS, DOGS & BIRDS. AND BTW, NONE OF THIS IS HEALTHY FOR HUMANS, EITHER, BUT I SUSPECT BC THEY ARE PLUGGED IN AT NOSE HEIGHT FOR MOST PETS, THEY GET A STRONGER DOSE OF THE AEROSOLIZED CHEMICALS/TOXIN, & THEY ALSO LIKELY GET IT ON THEIR FEET/FUR, WHICH ANIMALS THEN LICK.  I FEEL TERRIBLE FOR USING THESE UNNECESSARY THINGS IN OUR HOME & PUTTING HIM THOUGH THIS. WE DID TAKE OUR DOG TO THE NEUROLOGIST & NO ORGANIC CAUSE WAS DETERMINED TO BE PRESENT. THESE PRODUCTS ARE CLEARLY TOXIC, AND HAD OUR DOG NOT RESPONDED IN SUCH A DRAMATIC WAY, I WOULD STILL BE USING THEM. I WORRY ABOUT  THE DANGER THEY PRESENT TO CHILDREN, TOO, AS THEY SPEND FAIR AMOUNTS OF TIME ON THE FLOORS AND ALSO PUT LOTS OF THINGS IN THEIR MOUTHS. THESE PRODUCTS SHOULD NOT BE ON THE MARKET FOR US TO BRING INTO OUR VERY HOMES!  THEY COMPROMISE THE GENERAL  PUBLIC?S HEALTH!

incident_description: GE DRYER I PURCHASED 26DECEMBER2021 IS A FIRE HAZARD; THE HEATING ELEMENT STAYS ON EVEN WHEN THE DRYER'S DRUM IS NOT TURNING. THE CONSUMER HAS TO MANUALLY TURN THE CONTROL PANEL KNOB TO THE OFF POSITION IN ORDER TO TURN OFF THE DRYER'S HEATING ELEMENT, OTHERWISE, IT STAYS ON UNTIL THE NEXT USE. IT IS A GE DRYER, MODEL GTD45EASJWS. I DISCOVERED THIS HAZARD ABOUT TWO WEEKS AFTER THE DRYER WAS INSTALLED IN MY HOUSE, AND ON THAT DAY, I FIGURED OUT THAT THE CONTROL PANEL KNOB NEEDED TO BE IN THE OFF POSITION TO TURN OFF THE HEAT. THERE HAVE BEEN NO INJURIES TO DATE, HOWEVER, SOMEBODY ELSE IN THE HOUSEHOLD USED THE DRYER THIS WEEK, FORGOT TO TURN THE KNOB OFF, AND THE NEXT DAY, THE DRYER'S ROOM WAS HOT AS CAN BE...IT IS A FIRE HAZARD. HAVE HAD MULTIPLE SUPPORT CALLS WITH PELOTON REGARDING THE MATTER OVER MONTHS, LAST EMAIL TO SUPPORT ON 9/12/23, AND LAST CALLS ON  9/18/23.    OVER THE LAST 6 OR SO MONTHS THIS PROBLEMS HAS OCCURRED NUMEROUS TIMES. RANDOMLY, DURING A RIDE, THE SEAT POST LEVEL CAN SLIP GRADUALLY FROM 22.5 TO ANYWHERE FROM 17-20, OR COMPLETELY DROPS. THERE'S NO RHYME OR REASON; I CAN BE COOKING ON ANY OTHER TEMPERATURE AND THE ELEMENT WILL JUST GO TO HIGH ON IT'S OWN AND THEN I STRUGGLE TO GET IT TO TURN OFF AND USUALLY HAVE TO GO HIT THE BREAKER TO TURN IT OFF. 
IT'S A KENMORE STOVE WITH RANGE MODEL 790.96021405; SERIAL NUMBER VF64355142. THIS IS A KNOW ISSUE AS THERE WERE KENMORE ELITE STOVES RECALLED FOR THE SAME EXACT ISSUE IN 2009, BUT NEVER ISSUED FOR THE "LOWER" MODELS. THIS HAS HAPPENED CONTINUOUSLY SINCE I BOUGHT MY HOUSE IN 2009. THE LAST TIME IT HAPPENED WAS YESTERDAY AND THE PAN I WAS COOKING CAUGHT FIRE BC I DIDN'T REALIZE IT HAPPENED RIGHT AWAY AND THERE WAS BACON GREASE IN THE PAN THAT MUST HAVE POPPED AND FLAMED UP.  I WAS ABLE TO PUT THE FIRE OUT QUICKLY AS I HAVE AN EXTINGUISHER NEXT TO THE STOVE SPECIFICALLY FOR THIS REASON THOUGH THIS IS THE FIRST TIME A PAN HAS EVER CAUGHT FIRE. I'M NOT EVEN SURE HOW TO REPAIR IT.

WE RECENTLY REPLACED A 2013 BOSCH 800 SERIES DISHWASHER THAT WAS DAMAGED DUE TO A LIGHTNING STRIKE WITH A NEW 2023 BOSCH 800 SERIES DISHWASHER. IT WAS INSTALLED TWO DAYS AGO AND IMMEDIATELY WE WERE OVERTAKEN BY TOXIC FUMES EMANATING FROM THE DISHWASHER, I HAVE MULTIPLE MEDICAL CONDITIONS WHICH ARE WORSENED BY EXPOSURE TO CHEMICALS, AND I HAVE BEEN MORE ILL AND HAD MULTIPLE ADVERSE SYMPTOMS SINCE USING THIS DISHWASHER. UPON SMELLING THE TOXIC FUMES EMANATING FROM THE DISHWASHER, I RESEARCHED, AND FOUND THAT THERE ARE MANY OTHER CONSUMERS WHO HAVE HAD THIS PROBLEM, ESPECIALLY WITH BOSCH DISHWASHERS, DUE TO THE BITUMEN USED AS A NOISE INSULATOR IN DISHWASHERS. BITUMEN IS A PETROCHEMICAL SIMILAR TO ASPHALT AND IS A CARCINOGEN! APPARENTLY DISHWASHERS WITH STAINLESS STEEL TUBS AND DISHWASHERS THAT HAVE THE LOWEST NOISE OUTPUT HAVE SOME OF THE HIGHEST LEVELS OF BITUMEN USED IN THE PRODUCT. IT MAKES PERFECT SENSE TO ME SINCE WHAT WE ARE SMELLING IS A BURNING TAR LIKE ODOR. URGENT: POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD

GRACO SOOTHE-N-SWAY-LX [GRACO SWING] (MODEL NUMBER: 2140066) WITH (DATE OF MANUFACTURE: 2022/08/12) SMOKES AND IS A POTENTIAL FIRE HAZARD.

WHEN I PLUGGED MY WIFE'S BREAST PUMP (POPULAR MODEL) POWER ADAPTER (12 VOLTS - 2 AMPS) INTO SAID GRACO SWING WHICH HAS A POWER ADAPTER (5 VOLTS - 2 AMPS), SAID GRACO SWING'S MOTOR SMOKED TO THE POINT WHERE IT COULD HAVE CAUGHT ON FIRE.

SAID BREAST PUMP AND GRACO SWING USE POWER ADAPTERS WITH THE SAME SIZE AND SHAPE OF "FEMALE BARREL JACK" [BARREL JACK].

MANY PARENTS HAVE A BREAST PUMP AND GRACO SWING.  IT IS EASY TO PLACE THE WRONG POWER ADAPTER'S FEMALE  BARREL JACK INTO THE OTHER UNIT'S MALE POWER SOCKET.  WHILE THIS MAY BE USER ERROR, GRACO'S ELECTRICAL ENGINEERS SHOULD HAVE PUT SAFETY PRECAUTIONS IN PLACE.

I HAVE NOT LOOKED AT THE BOARD AS OF YET.  I FEEL THAT IT COULD BE A POWER SUPPLY ISSUE WITH THE BOARD.

THE BEST SAFETY PRECAUTION WOULD HAVE BEEN TO INCLUDE A VOLTAGE REGULATOR ON THE CONTROL BOARD TO STEP DOWN THE SUPPLIED 12 VOLTS TO THE CORRECT 5 VOLTS THAT IS NEEDED FOR THE GRACO SWING.

ANOTHER SAFETY PRECAUTION THAT COULD HAVE BEEN PLACED ON THE CONTROL BOARD WOULD BE A FUSE (STANDARD BLOWN OUT, THERMAL RESET, MANUAL RESET).

IT SEEMS THAT THERE ARE NO SAFETY PRECAUTIONS FOR THE BOARD AND/OR MOTOR WHEN INPUTTING MORE THAN 5 VOLTS, WHEN CONSIDERING THAT THE MOTOR BURNED OUT WHEN APPLYING 12 VOLTS.

I HAVE CONTACTED GRACO'S CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTER.  I ASKED IF THERE WAS A RECALL ON THE UNIT, AND I WAS TOLD THERE WAS NOT.  I EXPLAINED THE ISSUE ABOVE MULTIPLE TIMES TO CUSTOMER SERVICE.  I ASKED TO SPEAK WITH SOMEONE TO GO OVER THE POSSIBLE RECALL, AND I WAS DENIED.  THE  CUSTOMER REPRESENTATIVE "[REDACTED]" STATED THAT THE PHONE CALLS ARE RECORDED, IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO REQUEST THEM FOR THIS REPORT.

I RECENTLY PURCHASED A LECTRIC XP STEP-THRU 3.0 WHITE LONG-RANGE EBIKE. WHEN THE BIKE WAS DELIVERED, THE REAR TIRE/TUBE WAS DEFLATED AND SEPARATED FROM THE BICYCLE. UPON CONTACTING THE COMPANY ABOUT THIS ISSUE, I WAS INFORMED THAT THERE WAS A KNOWN DEFECT IN THE TUBES AND WHEELS FOR THE BICYCLE I PURCHASED. I WAS TOLD THAT A BATCH OF THE BIKES HAD WEAK TUBES PRONE TO RUPTURE, BURRS ON THE WHEEL RIMS THAT COULD LEAD TO REPEATED TUBE PUNCTURES, AND/OR SCREWS STICKING OUT ON THE RIMS THAT COULD LEAD TO REPEATED TUBE PUNCTURES. AFTER I REPORTED THE ISSUE, I RECEIVED WHAT SEEMED TO BE A FORM EMAIL ABOUT POSSIBLE FIXES FOR THESE ISSUES. I HAD NO IDEA THAT THIS WAS AN ISSUE BEFORE I PURCHASED THIS BIKE, I WAS NOT INFORMED ABOUT THIS ISSUES BEFORE I RECEIVED THE BIKE, AND I DID NOT FIND OUT UNTIL I CONTACTED CUSTOMER SERVICE. AS FAR AS I KNOW, NO WIDESPREAD NOTICE HAS BEEN SENT OUT TO CUSTOMERS ABOUT THIS ISSUE AS I HAVE NOT RECEIVED ANY SUCH PUBLIC NOTICE EVEN THOUGH THE PRODUCT I PURCHASED WAS AFFECTED. I SUPPOSE I WAS LUCKY, BECAUSE IF MY TIRE HAD NOT ARRIVED DEFLATED, I MIGHT HAVE THOUGHT THAT THE INEVITABLE FLAT TIRE WAS DUE TO USER ERROR OR ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARD. I WAS NEVER PUT IN HARMS WAY BECAUSE I HAVE BEEN UNABLE TO RIDE THE BIKE EVEN ONCE. HOWEVER, THOSE CUSTOMERS THAT ARE NOT INFORMED OF THESE DEFECTS MAY REPEATEDLY EXPERIENCE FLAT TIRES WITHOUT UNDERSTANDING THAT THE CAUSE MAY BE A DEFECT WITH THE BICYCLE WHEELS AND TUBES. LECTRIC OFFERED TO PAY FOR ME TO GET THE PROBLEMS REPAIRED, BUT IN THE END I COULD NOT ACCESS A BIKE SHOP THAT WOULD HANDLE THE ISSUE. SO THAT I COULD REPAIR THE BIKE MYSELF, LECTRIC EVENTUALLY AGREED TO SEND ME NEW FRONT AND REAR WHEELS, WHICH ARE CURRENTLY ON BACKORDER UNTIL THE END OF OCTOBER. ORIGINALLY I WAS TOLD THAT THERE WOULD BE NO POINT IN THEM SENDING ME NEW WHEELS BECAUSE THE NEW WHEELS MIGHT HAVE THE SAME PROBLEM. THIS INDICATES THAT THEY KNOW THERE IS A PROBLEM, BUT HAVE NOT FIXED IT, AND ARE NOT NECESSARILY CHECKING THE PRODUCTS THEY SEND OUT TO THE PUBLIC. I RECENTLY READ ABOUT THEIR DISC BRAKE CALIPER RECALL ON THE SAME MODEL BIKE I PURCHASED (ALBEIT DIFFERENT DATES), AND THIS MAKES ME WORRIED ABOUT THE SAFETY OF THE PRODUCT IN GENERAL.
